original: śāstraṃ praṇetukāmaḥ svasya śāstur māhātmyajñāpanārthaṃ guṇākhyānapūrvakaṃ tasmai namaskāram ārabhate / ya iti buddhaṃ bhagavantam adhikṛtyāha / hatam asyāndhakāram anena veti hatāndhakāraḥ / sarveṇa prakāreṇa sarvasmin hatāndhakāṛah sarvathā sarvahatāndhakāraḥ / ajñānaṃ hi bhūtārthadarśanapratibandhād andhakāram /

original: tac ca bhagavato buddhasya pratipakṣalābhenātyantaṃ sarvathā sarvatra jñeye punaranutpattidharmatvād dhatam / ato 'sau sarvathāsarvahatāndhakāraḥ / pratyekabuddhaśrāvakā api kāmaṃ sarvatra hatāndhakāṛaḥ, kliṣṭasaṃmohātyantavigamāt / na tu sarvathā /

original: tathā hy eṣāṃ buddhadharmeṣv ativiprakṛṣṭadeśakāleṣv(ṣu), artheṣu cānantaprabhedeṣu bhavaty evākliṣṭam ajñānam / ity ātmahitapratipattisampadā saṃstutya, punas tam eva bhagavantaṃ parahitapratipattisampadā saṃstauti, saṃsārapaṅkāj jagad ujjahāreti / saṃsāro hi jagadāsaṅgasthānatvād(t) duruttaratvāc ca paṅkabhūtaḥ /

original: tatrāvamagnaṃ jagad atrāṇam anukampamāno bhagavān saddharmadeśanāhastapradānair yathābhavyam abhyuddhṛtavān iti ya evam ātmaparahitapratipattisaṃpadā yuktas, tasmai namaskṛtyeti śirasā praṇipatya / yathārtham aviparītaṃ śāstīti yathārthaśāstā / anena parahitapratipattyupāyam asyāviṣkaroti /
analyzed: tatra avamagnam jagat atrāṇam anukampamānaḥ bhagavān saddharma deśanā hasta pradānaiḥ yathābhavyam abhyuddhṛtavān iti yaḥ evam ātma para hita pratipatti saṃpadā yuktaḥ tasmai namaskṛtya iti śirasā praṇipatya yathārtham aviparītam śāsti iti yathārtha śāstā anena para hita pratipatti upāyam asya āviṣkaroti

original: yathābhūtaśāsanāc chāstā bhavann asau saṃsārapaṅkāj jagad ujjahāra, na tv ṛddhivarapradānaprabhāveṇeti / tasmai namaskṛtya kiṃ kariṣyāmīity āha [p.2] śāstraṃ pravakṣyāmi / śiṣyaśāsanāc chāstram / katamac chāstram ity āha, abhidharmakośam / ko 'yam abhidharmo nāma /
analyzed: yathā bhūta śāsanāt śāstā bhavan asau saṃsāra paṅkāt jagat ujjahāra na tu ṛddhi vara pradāna prabhāveṇa iti tasmai namaskṛtya kim kariṣyāmi iti āha śāstram pravakṣyāmi śiṣya śāsanāt śāstram katamat śāstram iti āha abhidharma kośam kaḥ yam abhidharmaḥ nāma

original: prajñāmalā sānucarābhidharmaḥ (2a)

original: tatra prajñā dharmapravicayaḥ / amaleti anāsravā / sānucareti saparivārā / evam anāsravaḥ pañcaskandhako 'bhidharma ity uktaṃ bhavati / eṣa tāvat pāramārthiko 'bhidharmaḥ / sāṃketikas tu,

original: "yat kiṃcid rūpam atītānāgatapratyutpannam ādhyātmikabāhyam audārikaṃ vā sūkṣmaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā praṇītaṃ vā yad vā dūre yad vā antike tat sarvam aikadhyam abhisaṃkṣipya rūpaskandha iti saṃkhyāṃ gacchatī"ti vacanāt sūtre rāśyarthaḥ skandhārtha iti siddham /
analyzed: yat kiṃcid rūpam atīta anāgata pratyutpannam ādhyātmika bāhyam audārikam vā sūkṣmam vā hīnam vā praṇītam vā yat vā dūre yat vā antike tat sarvam aikadhyam abhisaṃkṣipya rūpa skandhaḥ iti saṃkhyām gacchati iti vacanāt sūtre rāśi arthaḥ skandha arthaḥ iti siddham

original: tatrātītaṃ rūpam anityatāniruddham / anāgatam anutpannam / pratyutpannam utpannāniruddham / ādhyātmikaṃ svāsāntānikaṃ bāhyam anyad āyatanato vā / audārikaṃ sapratighaṃ [ /] sūkṣmam apratigham āpekṣikaṃ vā / āpekṣikatvād asiddham iti cet / na / apekṣābhedāt / yad apekṣyaudārikaṃ na jātu tad apekṣya sūkṣmaṃ pitāputravat / hīnaṃ kliṣṭam /
analyzed: tatra atītam rūpam anitya tā niruddham anāgatam anutpannam pratyutpannam utpanna aniruddham ādhyātmikam sva asāntānikam bāhyam anyat āyatanataḥ vā audārikam sa pratigham sūkṣmam apratigham āpekṣikam vā āpekṣika tvāt asiddham iti ced na apekṣā bhedāt yat apekṣya audārikam na jātu tat apekṣya sūkṣmam pitā putra vat hīnam kliṣṭam

original: praṇītam akliṣṭam / dūram atītānāgatam / antikaṃ pratyutpannam / evaṃ yāvat vijñānam / ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ / audārikaṃ pañcendriyāśrayam sūkṣmaṃ mānasam / bhūmito veti Vaibhāṣikāḥ / Bhadanta āha "audārikarūpaṃ pañcendriyagrāhyam / sūkṣmam anyat / hīnam amanāpaṃ [ /] praṇītaṃ manāpam / dūram adṛśyadeśam / antikaṃ dṛśyadeśam /
analyzed: praṇītam akliṣṭam dūram atīta anāgatam antikam pratyutpannam evam yāvat vijñānam ayam tu viśeṣaḥ audārikam pañca indriya āśrayam sūkṣmam mānasam bhūmitaḥ vā iti Vaibhāṣikāḥ bhadanta āha audārika rūpam pañca indriya grāhyam sūkṣmam anyat hīnam amanāpam praṇītam manāpam dūram adṛśya deśam antikam dṛśya deśam

original: atītādīnāṃ svaśabdenābhihitatvāt / evaṃ vedanādayo 'pi veditavyāḥ / dūrāntikatvaṃ tu teṣām āśrayavaśāt / audārikasūkṣmatvaṃ tu pūrvavad" iti //
analyzed: atīta ādīnām sva śabdena abhihita tvāt evam vedanā ādayaḥ api veditavyāḥ dūra antika tvam tu teṣām āśraya vaśāt audārika sūkṣma tvam tu pūrvavat iti

original: cittacaittāyadvārārtha āyatanārthaḥ / nirvacanaṃ tu cittacaittānām āyaṃ tanvantīti āyatanāni / vistṛṇvantīty arthaḥ / gotrārtho dhātvarthaḥ / yathaikasmin parvate bahūny ayastāmrarūpyasuvarṇādigotrāṇi dhātava ucyante evam ekasminn āśraye santāne vā aṣṭādaśa gotrāṇi aṣṭādaśa dhātava ucyante / ākarās tatra gotrāṇy ucyante /
analyzed: āyatana arthaḥ nirvacanam tu citta caittānām āyam tanvanti iti āyatanāni vistṛṇvanti iti arthaḥ gotra arthaḥ dhātu arthaḥ yathā ekasmin parvate bahūni ayaḥ tāmra rūpya suvarṇa ādi gotrāṇi dhātavaḥ ucyante evam ekasmin āśraye santāne vā aṣṭādaśa gotrāṇi aṣṭādaśa dhātavaḥ ucyante ākarāḥ tatra gotrāṇi ucyante

original: ta ime cakṣurādayaḥ kasyākarāḥ / svasyā jāteḥ / sabhāgahetutvāt / asaṃskṛtaṃ tarhi na dhātuḥ syāt / cittacaittānāṃ tarhi jātivācako 'yaṃ dhātuśabda ity apare / aṣṭādaśadharmāṇāṃ jātayaḥ svabhāvā aṣṭādaśa dhātava iti / yadi rāśyarthaḥ skandhārthaḥ prajñaptisantaḥ skandhāḥ prāpnuvanti / anekadravyasamūhatvāt rāśipudgalavat / na /
analyzed: te ime cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ kasya ākarāḥ svasyāḥ jāteḥ sa bhāga hetu tvāt asaṃskṛtam tarhi na dhātuḥ syāt citta caittānām tarhi jāti vācakaḥ yam dhātu śabdaḥ iti apare aṣṭādaśa dharmāṇām jātayaḥ svabhāvāḥ aṣṭādaśa dhātavaḥ iti yadi rāśi arthaḥ skandha arthaḥ prajñapti santaḥ skandhāḥ prāpnuvanti aneka dravya samūha tvāt rāśi pudgala vat na anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra a

original: ekasyāpi dravyaparamāṇoḥ skandhatvāt / na tarhi rāśyarthaḥ skandhārtha iti vaktavyam / na hy ekasyāsti rāśitvam iti / kāryabhārodvahanārthaḥ skandhārtha ity apare / pracchedārtho vā / tathā hi vaktāro bhavanti tribhiḥ skandhakair deyaṃ dāsyāma iti / tad etad utsūtram /
analyzed: ekasya api dravya paramāṇoḥ skandha tvāt na tarhi rāśi arthaḥ skandha arthaḥ iti vaktavyam na hi ekasya asti rāśi tvam iti kārya bhāra udvahana arthaḥ skandha arthaḥ iti apare praccheda arthaḥ vā tathā hi vaktāraḥ bhavanti tribhiḥ skandhakaiḥ deyam dāsyāmaḥ iti tat etat utsūtram

original: sūtraṃ hi rāśyartham eva bravīti "yat kiṃcid rūpam atītānāgatapratyutpannam" iti vistaraḥ / pratyekam atītādirūpasya skandhatvaṃ tatra vijñāpyate / sarvam etad atītādi rūpam ekaśo [p.14] rūpaskandha iti / na śakyam evaṃ vijñātum / "tat sarvam aikadhyam abhisaṃkṣipye"ti vacanāt / tasmād rāśivad eva skandhāḥ prajñaptisantaḥ /
analyzed: sūtram hi rāśi artham eva bravīti yat kiṃcid rūpam atīta anāgata pratyutpannam iti vistaraḥ pratyekam atīta ādi rūpasya skandha tvam tatra vijñāpyate sarvam etat atīta ādi rūpam ekaśas rūpa skandhaḥ iti na śakyam evam vijñātum tat sarvam aikadhyam abhisaṃkṣipya iti vacanāt tasmāt rāśi vat eva skandhāḥ prajñapti santaḥ

original: rūpīṇy api tarhy āyatanāni prajñaptisanti prāpnuvanti / bahūnāṃ cakṣurādiparamāṇūnām āyadvārabhāvāt / na / ekaśaḥ samagrāṇāṃ kāraṇabhāvāt viṣayasahakāritvād vā nendriyaṃ pṛthagāyatanaṃ syāt / Vibhāṣāyāṃ tūcyate "yady ābhidharmikaḥ skandhaprajñaptim apekṣate / sa āha paramāṇur ekasya dhātor ekasyāyatanasyaikasya skandhasya pradeśaḥ /
analyzed: rūpīṇi api tarhi āyatanāni prajñapti santi prāpnuvanti bahūnām cakṣuḥ ādi paramāṇūnām āya dvāra bhāvāt na ekaśas samagrāṇām kāraṇa bhāvāt viṣaya sahakāri tvāt vā na indriyam pṛthak āyatanam syāt vibhāṣāyām tu ucyate yadi ābhidharmikaḥ skandha prajñaptim apekṣate saḥ āha paramāṇuḥ ekasya dhātoḥ ekasya āyatanasya ekasya skandhasya pradeśaḥ

original: atha nāpekṣate / sa āha / paramāṇur eko dhātur ekam āyatanam ekaḥ skandha" iti / bhavati hi pradeśe 'pi pradeśivad upacāro yathā paṭaikadeśe dagdhe "paṭo dagdha" iti /
analyzed: atha na apekṣate saḥ āha paramāṇuḥ ekaḥ dhātuḥ ekam āyatanam ekaḥ skandhaḥ iti bhavati hi pradeśe pi pradeśi vat upacāraḥ yathā paṭa eka deśe dagdhe paṭaḥ dagdhaḥ iti

original: kim arthaṃ bhagavān skandhādimukhena trividhāṃ deśanām ārabhate / āha / vineyānāṃ
analyzed: kim artham bhagavān skandha ādi mukhena trividhām deśanām ārabhate āha vineyānām

original: mohendriyarucitraidhāt tisraḥ skandhādideśanāḥ //20cd //

original: trayaḥ prakārās traidham / triprakāraḥ kila sattvānāṃ mohaḥ [ /] kecic caitteṣu saṃmūḍhāḥ piṇḍātmagrahaṇataḥ / kecid rūpa eva kecid rūpacittayoḥ / indriyāṇy api trividhāni / tīkṣṇamadhyamṛdvindriyatvāt / rucir api trividhā / saṃkṣiptamadhyavistaragrantharucitvāt / teṣāṃ yathākramamṃ tisraḥ skandhāyatana dhātudeśanā iti(Pradhan: hati) //
analyzed: trayaḥ prakārāḥ traidham tri prakāraḥ kila sattvānām mohaḥ kecid caitteṣu saṃmūḍhāḥ piṇḍa ātma grahaṇataḥ kecid rūpe eva kecid rūpa cittayoḥ indriyāṇi api trividhāni tīkṣṇa madhya mṛdu indriya tvāt ruciḥ api trividhā saṃkṣipta madhya vistara grantha ruci tvāt teṣām yathākramam tisraḥ dhātu deśanāḥ iti

original: kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ caitasikā ekatra saṃskāraskandhe nikṣiptā vedanāsaṃjñe tu pṛthak skandhī kṛte ity āha,
analyzed: kim punar kāraṇam caitasikāḥ ekatra saṃskāra skandhe nikṣiptāḥ vedanā saṃjñe tu pṛthak skandhī kṛte iti āha

original: caittebhyo vedanāsaṃjñe pṛthakskandhau niveśitau //21//

original: dve vivādamūle / kāmādhyavasānaṃ dṛṣṭyadhyavasānaṃ ca / tayor vedanāsaṃjñe yathākramaṃ pradhānahetū / vedanāsvādavaśād dhi kāmān abhiṣvajante, viparītasaṃjñāvaśāc cā dṛṣṭīr iti / saṃsārasyāpi te pradhānahetū / vedanāsvādagṛddho hi viparyastasaṃjñaḥ saṃsarati /
analyzed: dve vivāda mūle kāma adhyavasānam dṛṣṭi adhyavasānam ca tayoḥ vedanā saṃjñe yathākramam pradhāna hetū vedanā āsvāda vaśāt hi kāmān abhiṣvajante viparīta saṃjñā vaśāt dṛṣṭīḥ iti saṃsārasya api te pradhāna hetū vedanā āsvāda gṛddhaḥ hi viparyasta saṃjñaḥ saṃsarati

original: yac ca skandhakrame kāraṇam upadekṣyamāṇaṃ tato 'pi kramakāraṇād anayoḥ pṛthak skandhīkaraṇaṃ veditavyam / etac ca tredhopapādayiṣyāmaḥ /
analyzed: yat ca skandha krame kāraṇam upadekṣyamāṇam krama kāraṇāt anayoḥ pṛthak skandhīkaraṇam veditavyam etat ca tredhā upapādayiṣyāmaḥ

original: atha kasmād asaṃskṛtaṃ dhātuṣv āyataneṣu coktaṃ, na tu skandheṣu /
analyzed: atha kasmāt asaṃskṛtam dhātuṣu āyataneṣu ca uktam na tu skandheṣu

original: skandheṣv asaṃskṛtaṃ noktam arthāyogāt (22abc)
analyzed: skandheṣu a saṃskṛtam na uktam artha ayogāt

original: tad dhi skandheṣūcyamānaṃ na tāvad eteṣv evāntarṇetuṃ śakyate / arthāyogāt / na hi tad rūpaṃ nāpi [p.15] yāvad vijñānam iti / na cāpi ṣaṣṭhaḥ skandho vaktuṃ śakyate / kutaḥ / arthāyogāt / ''rāśyartho hi skandhārtha'' ity uktam /
analyzed: tat hi skandheṣu ucyamānam na tāvat eteṣu eva antarṇetum śakyate artha ayogāt na hi tat rūpam na api yāvat vijñānam iti na ca api ṣaṣṭhaḥ skandhaḥ vaktum śakyate kutas artha ayogāt rāśi arthaḥ hi skandha arthaḥ iti uktam

original: na cāsaṃskṛtam atītādibhedabhinnaṃ rūpādivad yatas tat sarvam aikadhyam abhisaṃkṣipyāsaṃskṛtaskandha iti saṃkhyāṃ gacchet / saṃkleśavastujñāpanārthaṃ khalūpādānaskandhavacanaṃ saṃkleśavyavadānavastujñāpanārthaṃ skandhavacanam / na cobhayathāpy asaṃskṛtam ity arthāyogān na teṣu vyavashāpitam /
analyzed: na ca asaṃskṛtam atīta ādi bheda bhinnam rūpa ādi vat yatas tat sarvam aikadhyam abhisaṃkṣipya asaṃskṛta skandhaḥ iti saṃkhyām gacchet saṃkleśa vastu jñāpana artham khalu upādāna skandha vacanam saṃkleśa vyavadāna vastu jñāpana artham skandha vacanam na ca ubhayathā api asaṃskṛtam iti artha ayogāt na teṣu vyavashāpitam

analyzed: rūpam hi sa pratigha tvāt sarva audārikam arūpiṇām vedanā pracāra audārika tayā tathā hi vyapadiśanti haste me vedanā pāde me vedanā iti dvābhyām ca audārikatarā saṃjñā vijñānāt saṃskārāḥ iti atas yat audārikataram tat pūrvam uktam atha vā anādimati saṃsāre strī puruṣāḥ anyonyam rūpa abhirāmāḥ te ca vedanā āsvāda garddhāte

original: tadgarddhaḥ saṃjñāviparyāsāt / tad viparyāsaḥ saṃkleśaiś cittaṃ ca tat saṃkliṣṭam iti yathāsaṃkleśaṃ ca kramaḥ / bhajanādyarthena vā / bhājanabhojanavyañjanakarttṛbhoktṛbhūtā hi rūpādayaḥ skandhāḥ / dhātuto vā / kāmaguṇarūpaprabhāvito hi kāmadhātuḥ / vedanāprabhāvitāni dhyānāni / saṃjñāprabhāvitāḥ trayaḥ ārūpyaḥ /

original: pṛthak tāvat syāc cakṣurdhātunā na cakṣurvijñānadhātunā / kāmadhātau krameṇa cakṣurindriyaṃ pratilabhamānaḥ / ārūpyadhātucyutaś ca dvitīyādiṣu dhyāneṣūpapadyamānaḥ / syāc cakṣurvijñānadhātunā na cakṣurdhātunā / dvitīyādidhyānopapannaś cakṣurvijñānasaṃmukhīkurvāṇas tatpracyutaś cādhastād upapadyamānaḥ /
analyzed: pṛthak tāvat syāt cakṣuḥ dhātunā na cakṣuḥ vijñāna dhātunā kāmadhātau krameṇa cakṣuḥ indriyam pratilabhamānaḥ ārūpya dhātu cyutaḥ ca dvitīya ādiṣu dhyāneṣu upapadyamānaḥ syāt cakṣuḥ vijñāna dhātunā na cakṣuḥ dhātunā dvitīya ādi dhyāna upapannaḥ cakṣuḥ vijñāna saṃmukhīkurvāṇaḥ tad pracyutaḥ ca adhastāt upapadyamānaḥ

original: sahāpi syād ubhayena samanvāgamaṃ pratilabhate / ārūpyadhātucyutaḥ kāmadhātau brahmaloke copapadyamānaḥ / nobhayena / etān ākārān sthāpayitvā / yaś cakṣurdhātunā samanvāgataś cakṣurvijñānadhātunā 'pi saḥ / catuṣkoṭikaḥ / prathamā koṭir, dvitīyādiṣu dhyāneṣūpapannaś cakṣurvijñānāsaṃmukhīkurvāṇaḥ / dvitīyā, kāmadhātāv alabdhavihīnacakṣuḥ //
analyzed: saha api syāt ubhayena samanvāgamam pratilabhate ārūpya dhātu cyutaḥ kāmadhātau brahma loke ca upapadyamānaḥ na ubhayena etān ākārān sthāpayitvā yaḥ cakṣuḥ dhātunā samanvāgataḥ cakṣuḥ vijñāna dhātunā saḥ catuṣkoṭikaḥ prathamā koṭiḥ dvitīya ādiṣu dhyāneṣu upapannaḥ cakṣuḥ vijñāna a saṃmukhīkurvāṇaḥ dvitīyā kāmadhātau a labdha vihīna cakṣuḥ

original: tṛtīyā, kāmadhātau labdhāvihīnacakṣuḥ, prathamadhyānopapanno dvitīyādidhyānopapannaś ca paśyan / caturthy, etān ākārān sthāpayitvā / evaṃ cakṣurdhāturūpadhātvoś cakṣurvijñānarūpadhātvoś ca pratilambhasamanvāgamau yathāyogam abhyūhitavyau / etasya prasaṅgasya samuccayārthaś caśabdaḥ sahāpi ca iti / [p.27]
analyzed: tṛtīyā kāmadhātau labdha a vihīna cakṣuḥ prathama dhyāna upapannaḥ dvitīya ādi dhyāna upapannaḥ ca paśyan caturthī etān ākārān sthāpayitvā evam cakṣuḥ dhātu rūpadhātvoḥ cakṣuḥ vijñāna rūpadhātvoḥ ca pratilambha samanvāgamau yathāyogam abhyūhitavyau etasya prasaṅgasya samuccaya arthaḥ caśabdaḥ saha api ca iti

original: uktaṃ bhavati, yaḥ svakarmakṛt sa sabhāga iti / tatra yena cakṣuṣā rūpāṇy apaśyat paśyati drakṣyati vā tad ucyate sabhāgaṃ cakṣuḥ / evaṃ yhāvan manaḥ svena viṣayakāritreṇa vaktavyam / tatsabhāgaṃ cakṣuḥ Kāśmīrāṇāṃ caturvidham / yad dṛṣṭvā rūpāṇi niruddhaṃ nirudhyate nirotsyate vā yac cānutpattidharmi / Pāścāttyānāṃ punaḥ pañcavidham /

original: tad evānutpattidharmi dvidhā kṛtvā vijñānasamāyuktaṃ cāsamāyuktaṃ ca / evaṃ yāvat kāyo veditavyaḥ / manas tv anutpattidharmakam eva tatsabhāgam / rūpāṇi ca yāni cakṣuṣā 'paśyat paśyati drakṣyati vā tāni sabhāgāni / tatsabhāgāni caturvidhāni / yāny adṛṣāny eva niruddhāni nirudhyante nirotsyante vā yāni cānutpattidharmīṇi / evaṃ yāvat spraṣṭavyāni /
analyzed: tat eva anutpatti dharmi dvidhā kṛtvā vijñāna samāyuktam ca asamāyuktam ca evam yāvat kāyaḥ veditavyaḥ manaḥ tu anutpatti dharmakam eva tat sa bhāgam rūpāṇi ca yāni cakṣuṣā paśyat paśyati drakṣyati vā tāni sa bhāgāni tad sa bhāgāni caturvidhāni yāni adṛṣāni eva niruddhāni nirudhyante nirotsyante vā yāni ca anutpatti dharmīṇi evam yāvat spraṣṭavyāni

original: svendriyakāritreṇa sabhāgatatsabhāgāni veditavyāni / yad ekasya cakṣuḥ sabhāgaṃ tatsarveṣām / evaṃ tatsabhāgam api / tathā yāvan manaḥ / rūpaṃ tu yaḥ paśyati tasya sabhāgaṃ yo na paśyati tasya tatsabhāgam / kiṃ kāraṇam / asti hi saṃbhavo yad rūpam ekaḥ paśyati, tad bahavo 'pi paśyeyur yathā candranaṭamallaprekṣāsu /
analyzed: sva indriya kāritreṇa sabhāga tad sabhāgāni veditavyāni yat ekasya cakṣuḥ sabhāgam tat sarveṣām evam tat sabhāgam api tathā yāvat manaḥ rūpam tu yaḥ paśyati tasya sabhāgam yaḥ na paśyati tasya tat sabhāgam kim kāraṇam asti hi saṃbhavaḥ yat rūpam ekaḥ paśyati tat bahavaḥ pi paśyeyuḥ yathā candra naṭa malla prekṣāsu

original: na tu saṃbhavo 'sti yad ekena cakṣuṣā dvau paśyetām / ato 'syāsādhāraṇatvād ekasantānavaśena vyavasthānam / rūpasya tu sādhāraṇatvāt anekasantānavaśena / yathā rūpam evaṃ śabdagandharasaspraṣṭavyadhātavo veditavyaḥ / bhavatu śabda evam /

analyzed: gandha ādayaḥ tu ye ekena gṛhyante na te nyena prāpta grahaṇāt iti asādhāraṇa tvāt eṣām cakṣuḥ ādi vat atideśaḥ nyāyyaḥ asti etat evam api tu eṣām api saṃbhavam prati sādhāraṇa tvam asti hi eṣa saṃbhavaḥ ye eva gandha ādayaḥ ekasya ghrāṇa ādi vijñānam utpādayeyuḥ te eva anyeṣām api na tu evam cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ tasmāt eṣām rūpa ādi vat atideśaḥ

original: pañcavijñānasahajā dhīr na dṛṣṭir atīraṇāt //41cd //
analyzed: pañca vijñāna sahajā dhīḥ na dṛṣṭiḥ ati īraṇāt

original: santīrikā hi dṛṣṭir upadhyānapravṛttatvāt / na caivaṃ pañcavijñānasahajā prajñā / tasmād asau na [p.30] dṛṣṭiḥ / ata eva cānyāpi kliṣṭākliṣṭā vā prajñā na dṛṣṭiḥ / cakṣur idānīm asantīrakatve kathaṃ dṛṣṭiḥ / rūpālocanārthena / yasmāt,
analyzed: santīrikā hi dṛṣṭiḥ upadhyāna pravṛtta tvāt na ca evam pañca vijñāna sahajā prajñā tasmāt asau na dṛṣṭiḥ atas eva ca anyā api kliṣṭa akliṣṭā vā prajñā na dṛṣṭiḥ cakṣuḥ idānīm a santīraka tve katham dṛṣṭiḥ rūpa ālocanā arthena yasmāt

original: cakṣuḥ paśyati rūpāṇi (42a)
analyzed: cakṣuḥ paśyati rūpāṇi

original: yadi cakṣuḥ paśyed anyavijñānasamaṅgino 'pi paśyet / na vai sarvaṃ cakṣuḥ paśyati / kiṃ tarhi,
analyzed: yadi cakṣuḥ paśyet anya vijñāna samaṅginaḥ paśyet na vai sarvam cakṣuḥ paśyati kim tarhi

original: sabhāgaṃ (42b)
analyzed: sa bhāgam 42a

original: savijñānakaṃ yadā bhavati, tadā paśyaty anyadā nety / evaṃ tarhi tad eva cakṣurāśritaṃ vijñānaṃ paśyatīty astu /
analyzed: sa vijñānakam yadā bhavati tadā paśyati anyadā na iti evam tarhi tat eva cakṣuḥ āśritam vijñānam paśyati iti astu

original: na tadāśritam /
analyzed: na tad āśritam

original: vijñānaṃ (42bc)
analyzed: vijñānam

original: paśyatīti śakyam avijñātum / kiṃ kāraṇam /
analyzed: paśyati iti śakyam a vijñātum kim kāraṇam

original: dṛśyate rūpaṃ na kilāntaritaṃ yataḥ //42cd //
analyzed: dṛśyate rūpam na kila antaritam yatas

original: yasmāt kila rūpaṃ kuḍyādivyavahitaṃ na dṛśyate / yadi hi vijñānaṃ paśyet tasyāpratighatvāt kuḍyādiṣu pratighāto nāsti ity āvṛtam api rūpaṃ paśyet / naiva hy āvṛte cakṣurvijñānam utpadyata ity anutpannaṃ kathaṃ drakṣyati / kiṃ khalu notpadyate /
analyzed: yasmāt kila rūpam kuḍya ādi vyavahitam na dṛśyate yadi hi vijñānam paśyet tasya apratigha tvāt kuḍya ādiṣu pratighātaḥ na asti iti āvṛtam api rūpam paśyet na eva hi āvṛte cakṣuḥ vijñānam utpadyate iti anutpannam katham drakṣyati kim khalu nā utpadyate

original: yasya tu cakṣuḥ paśyati tasya cakṣuṣaḥ sapratighatvād vyavahite vṛttyabhāva iti vijñānasyānutpattir āśrayeṇaikaviṣayapravṛtttatvāt yujyate / kiṃ nu vai cakṣuḥ prāptaviṣayaṃ kāyendriyavat yata āvṛtaṃ na paśyet / sapratighatvāt / kācābhrapaṭalasphaṭikāmbubhiś cāntaritaṃ kathaṃ dṛśyate / tasmān na sapratighatvāc cakṣuṣa āvṛtasya rūpasyādarśanam /
analyzed: yasya tu cakṣuḥ paśyati tasya cakṣuṣaḥ sa pratigha tvāt vyavahite vṛtti abhāvaḥ iti vijñānasya anutpattiḥ āśrayeṇa eka viṣaya pravṛtta tvāt yujyate kim nu vai cakṣuḥ prāpta viṣayam kāya indriya vat yatas āvṛtam na paśyet sa pratigha tvāt kāca abhra paṭala sphaṭika ambubhiḥ ca antaritam katham dṛśyate tasmāt na sa pratigha tvāt cakṣuṣaḥ āvṛtasya rūpasya adarśanam

original: kiṃ tarhi / yatrālokasyāpratibandha āvṛte 'pi rūpe tatropapadyata eva cakṣurvijñānam / yatra tu pratibandhas tatra notpadyata ity anutpannatvād āvṛtaṃ nekṣate / yat tarhi sūtra uktaṃ ''cakṣuṣā rūpāṇi dṛṣṭve''ti / tenāśrayeṇety ayam atrābhisandhir yathā ''manasā dhārmān vijñāye''ty āha / na ca mano dharmān vijānāti / atītatvāt / kiṃ tarhi /
analyzed: kim tarhi yatra ālokasya apratibandhaḥ āvṛte rūpe tatra upapadyate eva cakṣuḥ vijñānam yatra tu pratibandhaḥ tatra na utpadyate iti anutpanna tvāt āvṛtam na īkṣate yat tarhi sūtre uktam cakṣuṣā rūpāṇi dṛṣṭvā iti tena āśrayeṇa iti ayam atra abhisandhiḥ yathā manasā dhārmān vijñāya iti āha na ca manaḥ dharmān vijānāti atīta tvāt kim tarhi

original: manovijñānam / āśritakarma vā āśrayasyopacaryate / yathā mañcāḥ krośantīti / yathā ca sūtra uktaṃ '' cakṣurjñeyāni rūpāṇīṣṭāni kāntānī''ti / na ca tāni cakṣuṣā vijñāyante / uktaṃ ca sūtre ''cakṣur brāhmaṇa dvāraṃ yāvad eva rūpāṇāṃ darśanāya'' ity ato gamyate cakṣuṣā dvāreṇa vijñānaṃ paśyatīti / darśane tatra dvārākhyā / na hy etad yujyate /
analyzed: manaḥ vijñānam āśrita karma vā āśrayasya upacaryate yathā mañcāḥ krośanti iti yathā ca sūtre uktam cakṣuḥ jñeyāni rūpāṇi iṣṭāni kāntāni iti na ca tāni cakṣuṣā vijñāyante uktam ca sūtre cakṣuḥ brāhmaṇa dvāram yāvat eva rūpāṇām darśanāya iti atas gamyate cakṣuṣā dvāreṇa vijñānam paśyati iti darśane tatra dvāra ākhyā na hi etat yujyate

original: cakṣur darśanaṃ rūpāṇāṃ darśanāyeti / [p.31] yadi vijñānaṃ paśyati ko vijānāti, kaś cānayor viśeṣaḥ / tad eva hi rūpasya vijñānaṃ tad evāsya darśanam iti / tadyathā kācit prajñā paśyatīty apy ucyate prajānātīty apy evaṃ kiṃcid vijñānaṃ paśyatīty apy ucyate / vijānātīty api / anye punar āhuḥ /
analyzed: cakṣuḥ darśanam rūpāṇām darśanāya iti yadi vijñānam paśyati kaḥ vijānāti kaḥ ca anayoḥ viśeṣaḥ tat eva hi rūpasya vijñānam tat eva asya darśanam iti tat yathā kācid prajñā paśyati iti api ucyate prajānāti iti api evam kiṃcid vijñānam paśyati iti api ucyate vijānāti iti api anye punar āhuḥ

original: ''yadi cakṣuḥ paśyati karttṛbhūtasya cakṣuṣaḥ kānyā dṛśikriye''ti vaktavyam / tad etad acodyam / yadi hi vijñānaṃ vijānātītīṣyate / na ca tatra karttṛkriyābhedaḥ / evam atrāpi / apare punar bruvate / ''cakṣurvijñānaṃ darśanaṃ tasyāśrayabhāvāc cakṣuḥ paśyatīty ucyate / yathā nādasyāśrayabhāvāt ghaṇṭā nadatīty ucyata'' iti /
analyzed: yadi cakṣuḥ paśyati karttṛ bhūtasya cakṣuṣaḥ kā anyā dṛśi kriyā iti vaktavyam tat etat acodyam yadi hi vijñānam vijānāti iti iṣyate na ca tatra karttṛ kriyā bhedaḥ evam atra api apare punar bruvate cakṣuḥ vijñānam darśanam tasya āśraya bhāvāt cakṣuḥ paśyati iti ucyate yathā nādasya āśraya bhāvāt ghaṇṭā nadati iti ucyate iti

original: nanu caivaṃ vijñānasyāśrayabhāvāc cakṣurvijānātīti prāpnoti / na prāpnoti / tadvijñānaṃ darśanam iti rūḍhaṃ loke / tathā hi tasminn utpanne rūpaṃ dṛṣṭam ity ucyate, na vijñātam / Vibhāṣāyām apy uktaṃ ''cakṣuh saṃprāptaṃ cakṣurvijñānānubhūtaṃ dṛṣṭam ity ucyata'' iti / tasmāc cakṣuḥ paśyatīty evocyate, na vijānātīti /
analyzed: nanu ca evam vijñānasya āśraya bhāvāt cakṣuḥ vijānāti iti prāpnoti na prāpnoti tat vijñānam darśanam iti rūḍham loke tathā hi tasmin utpanne rūpam dṛṣṭam iti ucyate na vijñātam vibhāṣāyām api uktam cakṣuḥ saṃprāptam cakṣuḥ vijñāna anubhūtam dṛṣṭam iti ucyate iti tasmāt cakṣuḥ paśyati iti eva ucyate na vijānāti iti

original: vijñānaṃ tu sānidhyamātreṇa rūpaṃ vijānātīty ucyate / yathā sūryo divasakara iti / atra Sautrāntikā āhuḥ / kim idam ākāśaṃ khādyate / cakṣur hi pratītya rūpāṇi cotpadyate cakṣurvijñānam / tatra kaḥ paśyati, ko vā dṛśyate / nirvyāpāraṃ hīdaṃ dharmamātraṃ hetuphalamātraṃ ca / tatra vyavahārārthaṃ cchandata upacārāḥ kriyante /
analyzed: vijñānam tu sānidhya mātreṇa rūpam vijānāti iti ucyate yathā sūryaḥ divasakaraḥ iti atra sautrāntikāḥ āhuḥ kim idam ākāśam khādyate cakṣuḥ hi pratītya rūpāṇi ca utpadyate cakṣuḥ vijñānam tatra kaḥ paśyati kaḥ vā dṛśyate nirvyāpāram hi idam dharma mātram hetu phala mātram ca tatra vyavahāra artham chandataḥ upacārāḥ kriyante

original: cakṣuḥ paśyati vijñānaṃ vijānātīti nātrābhiniveṣṭavyam / uktaṃ hi bhagavatā ''janapadaniruktiṃ nābhiniviśeta saṃjñāṃ ca lokasya nābhidhāved '' iti / eṣa tu Kāśmīravaibhāṣikāṇāṃ siddhantaḥ / cakṣuḥ paśyati, śrotraṃ śṛṇoti, ghrāṇaṃ jighrati, jihvā āsvādayati, kāyaḥ sprśati, mano vijānātīti /
analyzed: cakṣuḥ paśyati vijñānam vijānāti iti na atra abhiniveṣṭavyam uktam hi bhagavatā janapada niruktim na abhiniviśeta saṃjñām ca lokasya na abhidhāvet iti eṣa tu kāśmīra vaibhāṣikāṇām siddhantaḥ cakṣuḥ paśyati śrotram śṛṇoti ghrāṇam jighrati jihvā āsvādayati kāyaḥ sprśati manaḥ vijānāti iti

original: tad yadi cakṣuḥ paśyati, kim ekena cakṣuṣā rūpāṇi paśyaty āhosvid ubhābhyām / nātra niyamaḥ /
analyzed: tat yadi cakṣuḥ paśyati kim ekena cakṣuṣā rūpāṇi paśyati āhosvit ubhābhyām na atra niyamaḥ

original: ubhābhyām api cakṣurbhyāṃ paśyati vyaktadarśanāt / (43ab)
analyzed: ubhābhyām api cakṣurbhyām paśyati vyakta darśanāt

original: ubhābhyām api cakṣurbhyāṃ paśyatīty ābhidhārmikāḥ / tathā hi dvayor vivṛtayoḥ pariśuddhataraṃ darśanaṃ bhavati / ekasmiṃś conmīlite cakṣuṣi dvitīye cārddhanimīlite dvicandrādigrahaṇaṃ bhavati / naikatarānyathībhāvāt / nacāśrayavicchedād vicchedaprasaṅgo vijñānasya deśāpratiṣṭhitatvād rūpavad iti /
analyzed: ubhābhyām api cakṣurbhyām paśyati iti ābhidhārmikāḥ tathā hi dvayoḥ vivṛtayoḥ pariśuddhataram darśanam bhavati ekasmin ca unmīlite cakṣuṣi dvitīye ca arddha nimīlite dvi candra ādi grahaṇam bhavati na ekatara anyathībhāvāt na ca āśraya vicchedāt viccheda prasaṅgaḥ vijñānasya deśa a pratiṣṭhita tvāt rūpa vat iti

original: yadi cakṣuḥ paśyati śrotraṃ śṛṇoti yāvan mano vijānāti, kim eṣāṃ prāpto viṣaya āhosvid aprāptaḥ / [p.32]
analyzed: yadi cakṣuḥ paśyati śrotram śṛṇoti yāvat manaḥ vijānāti kim eṣām prāptaḥ viṣayaḥ āhosvit a prāptaḥ

original: cakṣuḥ śrotramano 'prāptaviṣayaṃ (43cd)
analyzed: cakṣuḥ śrotra manaḥ prāpta viṣayam

original: tathā hi dūrād rūpaṃ paśyaty akṣistham añjanaṃ na paśyati / dūrāc chabdaṃ śṛṇoti / sati ca prāptaviṣayatve divyaṃ cakṣuḥśrotram iha dhyāyināṃ nopajāyeta / ghrāṇādivat / yady aprāptaviṣayapṃ cakṣuḥ kasmān na sarvam aprāptaṃ paśyati, dūraṃ tiraskṛtaṃ ca / kathaṃ tāvad ayaskānto na sarvam aprāptam ayaḥ karṣati / prāptaviṣayatve 'pi caitat samānaṃ /
analyzed: tathā hi dūrāt rūpam paśyati akṣi stham añjanam na paśyati dūrāt śabdam śṛṇoti sati ca prāpta viṣaya tve divyam cakṣuḥ śrotram iha dhyāyinām na upajāyeta ghrāṇa ādi vat yadi aprāpta viṣayapam cakṣuḥ kasmāt na sarvam aprāptam paśyati dūram tiraskṛtam ca katham tāvat ayaskāntaḥ na sarvam aprāptam ayaḥ karṣati prāpta viṣaya tve ca etat samānam

original: kasmān na sarvam prāptaṃ paśyaty añjanaṃ śalākām vā / yathā ca ghrāṇādīnāṃ prāpto viṣayo na tu sarvaḥ / sahabhūgandhādy agrahaṇāt / evaṃ cakṣuṣo 'py aprāptaḥ syān na tu sarvaḥ / manas tv arūpitvāt prāptum evāśaktam / kecit punaḥ śrotraṃ prāptāprāptaviṣayaṃ manyante / karṇābhyantare 'pi śabdaśravaṇāt / śeṣaṃ tu ghrāṇaijihvākāyākhyam /
analyzed: kasmāt na sarvam prāptam paśyati añjanam śalākām vā yathā ca ghrāṇa ādīnām prāptaḥ viṣayaḥ na tu sarvaḥ agrahaṇāt evam aprāptaḥ syāt na tu sarvaḥ manaḥ tu arūpi tvāt prāptum eva aśaktam kecid punar śrotram prāpta aprāpta viṣayam manyante karṇa abhyantare śabda śravaṇāt śeṣam tu ghrāṇaiḥ jihvā kāya ākhyam

original: trayam anyathā //43d //
analyzed: trayam anyathā

original: prāptaviṣayam ity arthaḥ / ghrāṇaṃ kathaṃ prāptviṣayam / nirucchvāsasya gandhāgrahaṇāt / keyaṃ prāptir nāma / niroantarotpattiḥ / kiṃ punaḥ paramāṇavaḥ / spṛśanty anyonyam āhosvin na / na spṛśantīti Kāśmīrakāḥ / kiṃ kāraṇam / yadi tāvat sarvātmanā spṛśeyur miśrībhaveyur dravyāṇi / athaika deśena sāvayavāḥ prasajyeran / niravayavāś ca paramāṇavaḥ /
analyzed: prāpta viṣayam iti arthaḥ ghrāṇam katham prāpta viṣayam nirucchvāsasya gandha agrahaṇāt kā iyam prāptiḥ nāma niro antara utpattiḥ kim punar paramāṇavaḥ spṛśanti anyonyam āhosvit na na spṛśanti iti kāśmīrakāḥ kim kāraṇam yadi tāvat sarva ātmanā spṛśeyuḥ miśrībhaveyuḥ dravyāṇi deśena sa avayavāḥ prasajyeran niravayavāḥ ca paramāṇavaḥ

original: kathaṃ tarhi śabdābhiniṣpattir bhavati /ata eva yadi hi spṛśeyur hasto hasto'bhyāhataḥ sajyetopalaś copale / kathaṃ citaṃ pratyāhataṃ na viśīryate / vāyu dhātusaṃdhāritatvāt / kaścid vāyudhātur vikiraṇāya pravṛtto, yathā saṃvarttanyāṃ kaścit saṃdhāraṇāya, yathā vivarttanyām iti / katham idānīṃ niruttaraprāptyā prāptaviṣayaṃ trayam ucyate /
analyzed: katham tarhi śabda abhiniṣpattiḥ bhavati atas eva yadi hi spṛśeyuḥ hastaḥ hasta abhyāhataḥ sajyeta upalaḥ ca upale katham citam pratyāhatam na viśīryate vāyu dhātu saṃdhārita tvāt kaścid vāyu dhātuḥ vikiraṇāya pravṛttaḥ yathā saṃvarttanyām kaścid saṃdhāraṇāya yathā vivarttanyām iti katham idānīm niruttara prāptyā prāpta viṣayam trayam ucyate

original: tade vaiṣāṃ niruttaratvaṃ yan madhye nāsti kiṃcit / api khalu saṃghātāḥ sāvayavatvāt sprśantīty adoṣaḥ / evaṃ ca kṛtvāyam api grantha upapanno bhavati Vibhāṣāyām / kiṃ nu spṛṣṭahetukaṃ sprṣṭam utpadyate āhosvid aspṛṣṭahetukam iti praśnayitvāha ''kāraṇaṃ prati kadācit spṛṣṭahetukam aspṛṣṭam utpadyate yadā viśīryate /
analyzed: tat e vā eṣām niruttara tvam yat madhye na asti kiṃcid api khalu saṃghātāḥ sāvayava tvāt sprśanti iti adoṣaḥ evam ca kṛtvā ayam api granthaḥ upapannaḥ bhavati vibhāṣāyām kim nu spṛṣṭa hetukam sprṣṭam utpadyate āhosvit a spṛṣṭa hetukam iti praśnayitvā āha kāraṇam prati kadācid spṛṣṭa hetukam a spṛṣṭam utpadyate yadā viśīryate

original: kadācid aspṛṣṭahetukaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ yadā cayaṃ gacchati / [p.33] kadācit spṛṣṭahetukaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ yadā cayvatāṃ cayaḥ / kadācid aspṛṣṭahetukam āspṛṣṭaṃ yadā vātāyatanarajaḥ'' iti / yadi paramāṇavaḥ spṛśeyur uttarakṣaṇāvasthānaṃ syād iti BhadantaVasumitraḥ / na spṛśanti nirantare tu spṛṣṭasaṃjñeti Bhadantaḥ / Bhadantamatam caiṣṭavyam /
analyzed: kadācid a spṛṣṭa hetukam spṛṣṭam yadā cayam gacchati kadācid spṛṣṭa hetukam spṛṣṭam yadā cayvatām cayaḥ kadācid a spṛṣṭa hetukam āspṛṣṭam yadā vāta āyatana rajaḥ iti yadi paramāṇavaḥ spṛśeyuḥ uttara kṣaṇa avasthānam syāt iti Bhadanta Vasumitraḥ na spṛśanti nirantare tu spṛṣṭa saṃjñā iti Bhadantaḥ Bhadanta matam ca eṣṭavyam

original: anyathā hi sāntarāṇāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ śūnyeṣu antareṣu gatiḥ kena pratibādhyeta / yataḥ sapratighā iṣyante / na ca paramāṇubhyo 'nye saṃghātā iti / ta eva te saṃghātāḥ spṛśyante, yathā rūpyante / yadi ca paramāṇor digghāgabhedaḥ kalpyate spṛṣṭasyāspṛṣṭasya vā sāvayavatvaprasaṅgaḥ / no cet spṛṣṭasyāpy aprasaṅgaḥ //
analyzed: anyathā hi sāntarāṇām paramāṇūnām śūnyeṣu antareṣu gatiḥ kena pratibādhyeta yatas sa pratighāḥ iṣyante na ca paramāṇubhyaḥ nye saṃghātāḥ iti te eva te saṃghātāḥ spṛśyante yathā rūpyante yadi ca paramāṇoḥ diś hāga bhedaḥ kalpyate spṛṣṭasya a spṛṣṭasya vā sāvayava tva prasaṅgaḥ no ced spṛṣṭasya api aprasaṅgaḥ

original: kiṃ punar ebhiś cakṣurādibhir ātmaparimāṇatulyasyārthasya grahaṇaṃ bhavaty āśuvṛttyā ca parvatādīnām alātacakrādivad āhosvit tulyātulyasya / yāni tāvad etāni prāptaviṣayāṇy uktāny ebhiḥ,
analyzed: kim punar ebhiḥ cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ ātma parimāṇa tulyasya arthasya grahaṇam bhavati āśu vṛttyā ca parvata ādīnām alāta cakra ādi vat āhosvit tulya atulyasya yāni tāvat etāni prāpta viṣayāṇi uktāni ebhiḥ

original: tribhir ghrāṇādibhis tulyaviṣayagrahaṇaṃ matam / (44ab)
analyzed: tribhiḥ ghrāṇa ādibhiḥ tulya viṣaya grahaṇam matam

original: yāvanto hīndriyaparamāṇavas tāvanto hi viṣayaparamāṇavaḥ sametya vijñānaṃ janayanti / cakṣuḥśrotrābhyāṃ tv aniyamaḥ / kadācid alpīyāṃso yadā bālāgraṃ paśyati / kadācit samā yadādrākṣāphalaṃ paśyati / kādācit bhūyāṃso , yadā yadā mahāntaṃ parvataṃ paśyaty unmiṣitamātreṇa / evaṃ śrotreṇa maśakameghādiśabdapravaṇe ghoṣam /
analyzed: yāvantaḥ hi indriya paramāṇavaḥ tāvantaḥ hi viṣaya paramāṇavaḥ sametya vijñānam janayanti cakṣuḥ śrotrābhyām tu aniyamaḥ kadācid alpīyāṃsaḥ yadā bālāgram paśyati kadācid samāḥ yadā adrākṣā phalam paśyati kādācid bhūyāṃsaḥ yadā yadā mahāntam parvatam paśyati unmiṣita mātreṇa evam śrotreṇa maśaka megha ādi śabda pravaṇe ghoṣam

original: manas tv amūrttivad eveti nāsya parimāṇaparicchedaḥ saṃpradhāryate /
analyzed: manaḥ tu amūrttivat eva iti na asya parimāṇa paricchedaḥ saṃpradhāryate

original: kathaṃ punar eṣāṃ cakṣurādīndriyaparamāṇūnāṃ saṃniveśaḥ / cakṣurindriyaparamāṇavas tāvad akṣitārakāyām ajājīpuṣpavad avasthitāḥ / acchacarmāvacchāditās tu na vikīryante / adharauttaryeṇa piṇḍavad avasthitā ity apare / na cānyonyam āvṛṇvanti sphaṭikavad acchatvāt / śrotrendriyaparamāṇavo bhūrjābhyantarāvasthitāḥ /
analyzed: katham punar eṣām cakṣuḥ ādi indriya paramāṇūnām saṃniveśaḥ cakṣuḥ indriya paramāṇavaḥ tāvat akṣi tārakāyām ajājī puṣpa vat avasthitāḥ accha carma avacchāditāḥ tu na vikīryante adhara auttaryeṇa piṇḍa vat avasthitāḥ iti apare na ca anyonyam āvṛṇvanti sphaṭika vat accha tvāt śrotra indriya paramāṇavaḥ bhūrja abhyantara avasthitāḥ

original: ghrāṇendriyaparamāṇavo ghaṭābhyantagareṇa śalākāvat / ādyāni trīṇīndriyāṇi mālāvad avasthitāni / jihvendriyaparamāṇavo 'rdhacandravat / bālāgramātraṃ kila madhyajihvāyāṃ jihvendriyaparamāṇubhir asphuṭam / kāyendriyaparamāṇavaḥ kāyavad avasthitāḥ / strīndriyaparamāṇavo bherīkaṭāhavat / puruṣendriyaparamāṇavo ṅguṣṭhavat /
analyzed: ghrāṇa indriya paramāṇavaḥ śalākā vat ādyāni trīṇi indriyāṇi mālā vat avasthitāni jihvā indriya paramāṇavaḥ ūrdhva candra vat bālāgra mātram kila madhya jihvāyām jihvā indriya paramāṇubhiḥ asphuṭam kāya indriya paramāṇavaḥ kāya vat avasthitāḥ strī indriya paramāṇavaḥ bherī kaṭāha vat puruṣa indriya paramāṇavaḥ ṅguṣṭha vat

original: tatra cakṣurindriyaparamāṇavaḥ kadācit sarve sabhāgā bhavanti, kadācit tatsabhāgāḥ / kacācid eke sabhāgāḥ eke tatsabhāgāḥ / evaṃ yāvaj jihvendriyaparamāṇavaḥ / kāyendriyaparamāṇavas tu sarve sabhāgā na bhavanti / pradīptanarakābhyantarāvaruddhānām api hy aparimāṇāḥ kāyendiryaparamāṇavas tatsabhāgā bhavanti /
analyzed: tatra cakṣuḥ indriya paramāṇavaḥ kadācid sarve sa bhāgāḥ bhavanti kadācid tad sa bhāgāḥ eke sa bhāgāḥ eke tad sa bhāgāḥ evam yāvat jihvā indriya paramāṇavaḥ kāya indriya paramāṇavaḥ tu sarve sa bhāgāḥ na bhavanti pradīpta naraka abhyantara avaruddhānām api hi aparimāṇāḥ kāya indirya paramāṇavaḥ tad sa bhāgāḥ bhavanti

original: sarvaiḥ kila vijñānotpattāv āśrayo [p.34] viśīryeta / na caika indriyaparamāṇur viṣayaparamāṇur vā vijñānaṃ janayati / saṃcitāśrayālambanatvāt pañcānāṃ vijñānakāyānām / ata evānidarśanaḥ paramāṇur adṛśyatvāt //
analyzed: sarvaiḥ kila vijñāna utpattau āśrayaḥ prati viśīryeta na ca ekaḥ indriya paramāṇuḥ viṣaya paramāṇuḥ vā vijñānam janayati saṃcita āśraya ālambana tvāt pañcānām vijñānakāyānām atas eva anidarśanaḥ paramāṇuḥ adṛśya tvāt

original: ya ime ṣaḍvijñānadhātava uktās, cakṣurvijñānaṃ yāvan manovijñānaṃ kim eṣāṃ yathā viṣayo varttamānaḥ pañcānāṃ caramasya trikāla evam āśrayo 'pi / nety āha / kiṃ tarhi /
analyzed: ye ime ṣaṭ vijñāna dhātavaḥ uktāḥ cakṣuḥ vijñānam yāvat manaḥ vijñānam kim eṣām yathā viṣayaḥ varttamānaḥ pañcānām caramasya tri kāle evam na iti āha kim tarhi

original: caramasyāśrayo 'tītaḥ (44c)
analyzed: caramasya āśrayaḥ tītaḥ

original: manovijñānadhātoḥ samanantaraniruddhaṃ mana āśrayaḥ /
analyzed: manaḥ vijñāna dhātoḥ samanantara niruddham manaḥ āśrayaḥ

original: pañcānāṃ sahajaś ca taiḥ //44d //
analyzed: pañcānām sahajaḥ ca taiḥ

original: atītaś ceti caśabdaḥ / tatra cakṣurvijñānasya cakṣuḥ sahaja āśrayo yāvat kāyavijñānasya kāyaḥ / atītaḥ punar eṣām āśrayo mana ity apy ete pañca vijñānakāyā indriyadvayāśrayāḥ / ata evocyate ''yaś cakṣurvijñānasyāśrayabhāvena samanantarapratyayabhāvenāpi sa tasyeti / catuṣkoṭikaḥ / prathamā koṭiś cakṣuḥ /
analyzed: atītaḥ ca iti caśabdaḥ tatra cakṣuḥ vijñānasya cakṣuḥ sahajaḥ āśrayaḥ yāvat kāya vijñānasya kāyaḥ atītaḥ punar eṣām āśrayaḥ manaḥ iti api ete pañca vijñānakāyāḥ indriya dvaya āśrayāḥ atas eva ucyate yaḥ cakṣuḥ vijñānasya āśraya bhāvena samanantara pratyaya bhāvena api sa tasya iti catuṣkoṭikaḥ prathamā koṭiḥ cakṣuḥ

original: dvitīyā samanantarātītaś caitasiko dharmadhātuḥ / tṛtīyā samanantarātītaṃ manaḥ / caturthī koṭir uktanirmuktā dharmāḥ / evaṃ yāvat kāyavijñānasya svam indriyaṃ vaktavyam / manovijñānasya pūrvapādakaḥ / yas tāvad āśrayabhāvena samanantarapratyayabhāvenāpi saḥ / syāt samanantarapratyayabhāvena nāśrayabhāvena /
analyzed: dvitīyā samanantara atītaḥ caitasikaḥ dharmadhātuḥ tṛtīyā samanantara atītam manaḥ caturthī koṭiḥ ukta nirmuktāḥ dharmāḥ evam yāvat kāya vijñānasya svam indriyam vaktavyam manaḥ vijñānasya pūrva pādakaḥ yaḥ tāvat āśraya bhāvena samanantara pratyaya bhāvena api saḥ syāt samanantara pratyaya bhāvena na āśraya bhāvena

original: samanantarābhyatītaś caitasiko dharmadhātur iti /
analyzed: samanantara abhyatītaḥ caitasikaḥ dharmadhātuḥ iti

original: kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam ubhayādīnāyāṃ vijñānotpattau cakṣurādayaḥ evāśrayā ucyante na rūpādayaḥ /
analyzed: kim punar kāraṇam ubhaya ādīnāyām vijñāna utpattau cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ eva āśrayāḥ ucyante na rūpa ādayaḥ

original: tadvikāravikāritvād āśrayāś cakṣurādayaḥ (45ab)
analyzed: tad vikāra vikāri tvāt āśrayāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ

original: dhātava ity adhikāraḥ / cakṣurādīnāṃ hi vikāreṇa tadvijñānānāṃ vikāro bhavaty anugrahopaghātapaṭumandatānuvidhānāt, na tu rūpādīnāṃ vikāreṇa tadvikāraḥ / tasmāt sādhīyas tadadhīnatvāt ta evāśrayā na rūpādayaḥ /
analyzed: dhātavaḥ iti adhikāraḥ cakṣuḥ ādīnām hi vikāreṇa tad vijñānānām vikāraḥ bhavati anugraha upaghāta paṭu manda tā anuvidhānāt na tu rūpa ādīnām vikāreṇa tad vikāraḥ tasmāt sādhīyaḥ tad adhīna tvāt te eva āśrayāḥ na rūpa ādayaḥ

original: kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ rūpādayaś ca tair vijñāyante cakṣurvijñānaṃ cocyate yāvan manovijñānam / na punā rūpavijñānaṃ yāvad dharmavijñānam iti / ya ete cakṣurādaya āśrayā eṣām,
analyzed: kim punar kāraṇam rūpa ādayaḥ ca taiḥ vijñāyante cakṣuḥ vijñānam ca ucyate yāvat manaḥ vijñānam na punar rūpa vijñānam yāvat dharma vijñānam iti ye ete cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ āśrayāḥ eṣām

original: ato 'sādhāraṇatvād dhi vijñānaṃ tair nirucyate //45cd //
analyzed: atas sādhāraṇa tvāt hi vijñānam taiḥ nirucyate

original: katham asādhāraṇatvam / na hi cakṣuranyasya vijñānasyāśrayībhavitum utsahate / rūpaṃ tu manovijñānasyālambanībhavaty anyacakṣurvijñānasyāpīti / evaṃ yāvat kāyo veditavyaḥ / tasmād āśrayabhāvād asādāraṇatvāc ca vijñānaṃ tenaiva nirdiśyate na rūādibhiḥ / yathā bherīśabdo yavāṅkura iti / [p.35]
analyzed: katham a sādhāraṇa tvam na hi cakṣuḥ anyasya vijñānasya āśrayībhavitum utsahate rūpam tu manaḥ vijñānasya ālambanībhavati anya cakṣuḥ vijñānasya api iti evam yāvat kāyaḥ veditavyaḥ tasmāt āśraya bhāvāt a sādāraṇa tvāt ca vijñānam tena eva nirdiśyate na rū ādibhiḥ yathā bherī śabdaḥ yava aṅkure iti

original: atha yatra kāye sthitaś cakṣuṣā rūpāṇi paśyati, kiṃ tāni kāyacakṣūrūpavijñānāny ekabhūmikāny eva bhavanty āhosvid anyabhūmikāny api / āha / sarveṣāṃ bhedaḥ / kāmadhātūpapannasya svena cakṣuṣā svāni rūpāṇi paśyataḥ sarvaṃ svabhūmikaṃ bhavati / tasyaiva svāni rūpāṇi prathamadhyānacakṣuṣā paśyataḥ kāyarūpe svabhūmike vijñānacakṣuṣi tadbhūmike /
analyzed: atha yatra kāye sthitaḥ cakṣuṣā rūpāṇi paśyati kim tāni kāya cakṣuḥ rūpa vijñānāni eka bhūmikāni eva bhavanti āhosvit anya bhūmikāni api āha sarveṣām bhedaḥ kāmadhātu upapannasya svena cakṣuṣā svāni rūpāṇi paśyataḥ sarvam sva bhūmikam bhavati tasya eva svāni rūpāṇi prathama dhyāna cakṣuṣā paśyataḥ kāya rūpe sva bhūmike vijñāna cakṣuṣi tad bhūmike

original: prathamadhyānabhūmīni paśyato rūpāṇi trīṇy api tadbhūmikāni / dvitīyadhyānacakṣuṣā svāni rūpāṇi paśyataḥ kāyarūpe svabhūmike cakṣustadbhūmikaṃ vijñānaṃ prathamadhyānabhūmikam /prathamadhyānabhūmīni paśyato vijñānarūpe tadbhūmike kāyaḥ kāmāvacaraś (Pradhan:avacāraś) cakṣur dvitīyadhyānabhūmikam /
analyzed: prathama dhyāna bhūmīni paśyataḥ rūpāṇi trīṇi api tad bhūmikāni dvitīya dhyāna cakṣuṣā svāni rūpāṇi paśyataḥ kāya rūpe sva bhūmike cakṣuḥ tad bhūmikam vijñānam prathama dhyāna bhūmikam prathama dhyāna bhūmīni paśyataḥ vijñāna rūpe tad bhūmike kāyaḥ kāmāvacaraḥ pradhana avacāraḥ cakṣuḥ dvitīya dhyāna bhūmikam

original: dvitīyadhyānabhūmikāni paśyataś cakṣūrūpe tadbhūmike kāyaḥ kāmāvacaro vijñānaṃ prathamadhyānabhūmikam / evaṃ tṛtīyacaturthadhyānabhūmikena cakṣuṣā tadbhūmikādharabhūmikāni rūpāṇi paśyato yojayitavyam / prathamadhyānopapannasya svena cakṣuṣā svāni rūpāṇi paśyataḥ sarvaṃ svabhūmikādharāṇi paśyataḥ trayaṃ svabhūmikam /
analyzed: dvitīya dhyāna bhūmikāni paśyataḥ cakṣuḥ rūpe tad bhūmike kāyaḥ kāmāvacaraḥ vijñānam prathama dhyāna bhūmikam evam tṛtīya caturtha dhyāna bhūmikena cakṣuṣā tad bhūmika adhara bhūmikāni rūpāṇi paśyataḥ yojayitavyam prathama dhyāna upapannasya svena cakṣuṣā svāni rūpāṇi paśyataḥ sarvam sva bhūmika adharāṇi paśyataḥ trayam sva bhūmikam

original: dvitīyadhyānacakṣuṣā svāni rūpāṇi paśyatās trayaṃ svabhūmikaṃ cakṣus tadbhūmikam / kāmāvacarāṇi paśyataḥ kāyavijñāne svabhūmike rūpāṇy adharāṇi cakṣus tadbhūmikam / dvitīyadhyānabhūmīni paśyatas cakṣūrūpe tadbhūmike śeṣaṃ svabhūmikam / evaṃ tṛtīyadhyānacakṣuṣā yojyam /
analyzed: dvitīya dhyāna cakṣuṣā svāni rūpāṇi paśyatāḥ trayam sva bhūmikam cakṣuḥ tad bhūmikam kāmāvacarāṇi paśyataḥ kāya vijñāne sva bhūmike rūpāṇi adharāṇi cakṣuḥ tad bhūmikam dvitīya dhyāna bhūmīni paśyataḥ cakṣuḥ rūpe tad bhūmike śeṣam sva bhūmikam evam tṛtīya dhyāna cakṣuṣā yojyam

original: dvitīyādidhyānopapannasya svaparacakṣurbhyāṃ svaparabhūmikāni rūpāṇi paśyato yathāyogaṃ yojayitavyam /
analyzed: dvitīya ādi dhyāna upapannasya sva para cakṣurbhyām sva para bhūmikāni rūpāṇi paśyataḥ yathāyogam yojayitavyam

original: ayaṃ tu niyamaḥ /
analyzed: ayam tu niyamaḥ

original: na kāyasyādharaṃ cakṣuḥ (46a)
analyzed: na kāyasya adharam cakṣuḥ

original: pañcabhūmikāni hi kāyacakṣūrūpāṇi kāmāvacarāṇi yāvac caturthadhyānabhūmikāni / dvibhūmikaṃ cakṣurvijñānaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ prathamadhyānabhūmikaṃ ca / tatra yadbhūmikaḥ kāyas tadbhūmikaṃ cakṣur ūrdhvabhūmikaṃ vā cakṣur bhavati, na tv adharabhūmikam / yadbhūmikaṃ cakṣus tadbhūmikam adharabhūmikaṃ vā rūpaṃ viṣayo bhavati /
analyzed: pañca bhūmikāni hi kāya cakṣū rūpāṇi kāmāvacarāṇi yāvat caturtha dhyāna bhūmikāni dvi bhūmikam cakṣuḥ vijñānam kāmāvacaram prathama dhyāna bhūmikam ca tatra yad bhūmikaḥ kāyaḥ tad bhūmikam cakṣuḥ ūrdhva bhūmikam vā cakṣuḥ bhavati na tu adhara bhūmikam yad bhūmikam cakṣuḥ tad bhūmikam adhara bhūmikam vā rūpam viṣayaḥ bhavati

original: ūrdhvaṃ rūpaṃ na cakṣuṣaḥ / (46b)
analyzed: ūrdhvam rūpam na cakṣuṣaḥ

original: na hi kadācid ūrdhvabhūmikaṃ rūpam adhobhūmikena cakṣuṣā draṣṭuṃ śakyate /
analyzed: na hi kadācid ūrdhva bhūmikam rūpam adhaḥ bhūmikena cakṣuṣā draṣṭum śakyate

original: vijñānaṃ ca (46c)
analyzed: vijñānam ca 46c

original: ūrdhvaṃ na cakṣuṣo rūpavat / [p.36]
analyzed: ūrdhvam na cakṣuṣaḥ rūpavat

original: asya rūpaṃ tu kāyasyobhe ca sarvataḥ //46cd //
analyzed: asya rūpam tu kāyasya ubhe ca sarvatas

original: asyety anantaroktasya cakṣurvijñānasya rūpaṃ sarvato viṣayaḥ ūrdhvam adhaḥ svabhūmau ca / kāyasyobhe rūpavijñāne sarvato bhavataḥ /
analyzed: asya iti anantara uktasya cakṣuḥ vijñānasya rūpam sarvatas viṣayaḥ ūrdhvam adhas sva bhūmau ca kāyasya ubhe rūpa vijñāne sarvatas bhavataḥ

original: yathā cedaṃ cakṣur uktaṃ vistareṇa veditavyam,
analyzed: yathā ca idam cakṣuḥ uktam vistareṇa veditavyam

original: tathā śrotraṃ (47a)
analyzed: tathā śrotram

original: na kāyasyādharaṃ śrotram, ūrdhvaṃ śabdo na ca śruteḥ /
analyzed: na kāyasya adharam śrotram ūrdhvam śabdaḥ na ca śruteḥ

original: vijñānaṃ cāsya śabdas tu, kāyasyobhe ca sarvataḥ
analyzed: vijñānam ca asya śabdaḥ tu kāyasya ubhe ca sarvatas

original: iti vistareṇa yojyam /
analyzed: iti vistareṇa yojyam

original: trayāṇāṃ tu sarvam eva svabhūmikam / (47ab)
analyzed: trayāṇām tu sarvam eva sva bhūmikam

original: ghrāṇajihvākāyadhātūnāṃ kāyaviṣayavijñānāni svabhūmikāny eva / ity utsargam aviśeṣeṇa kṛtvā punar viśeṣaṇārtham apavāda ārabhyate /
analyzed: ghrāṇa jihvā kāya dhātūnām kāya viṣaya vijñānāni sva bhūmikāni eva iti utsargam aviśeṣeṇa kṛtvā punar viśeṣaṇa artham apavādaḥ ārabhyate

original: kāyavijñānam adharasvabhūmi (47cd)
analyzed: kāya vijñānam adhara sva bhūmi

original: kāyaḥ kāyadhātuḥ spraṣṭavyaṃ ca svabhūmikāny eva nityaṃ bhavanti / kāyavijñānaṃ tu keṣāṃcit svabhūmikaṃ yathā kāmadhātuprathamadhyānopapannānām / keṣāṃ cid adharabhūmikaṃ yathā dvitīyādidhyānopapannānām iti /
analyzed: kāyaḥ kāyadhātuḥ spraṣṭavyam ca sva bhūmikāni eva nityam bhavanti kāya vijñānam tu keṣāṃcid sva bhūmikam yathā kāmadhātu prathama dhyāna upapannānām keṣām cit adhara bhūmikam yathā dvitīya ādi dhyāna upapannānām iti

original: aniyataṃ manaḥ //47d //
analyzed: aniyatam manaḥ

original: kadācit kāyamanovijñānadharmaiḥ samānabhūmikaṃ mano bhavati kadācid 'rudhvādhobhūmikam / pañcabhūmike 'pi hi kāye sarvabhūmikāni manāadīni bhavanti samāpattyupapattikāle yathāyogam iti vistareṇa samāpattinirdeśe koṣasthāna etad ākhyāyiṣyate / atibahugranthabhāraparihārārthaṃ tu nedānīṃ punar ākhyāyate /
analyzed: kadācid kāya manaḥ vijñāna dharmaiḥ samāna bhūmikam manaḥ bhavati kadācid rudhvā adhas bhūmikam pañca bhūmike hi kāye sarva bhūmikāni manā adīni bhavanti samāpatti upapatti kāle yathāyogam iti vistareṇa samāpatti nirdeśe koṣa sthāne etat ākhyāyiṣyate ati bahu grantha bhāra parihāra artham tu na idānīm punar ākhyāyate

original: tadyathā prītiḥ prītisthānīyāś ca dharmāḥ prītisaṃbodhyaṅgam uktaṃ bhagavatā | pratighaḥ pratighanimittaṃ ca vyāpādanivaraṇam uktam | samyakdṛṣṭisaṃkalpavyāyāmāś ca prajñāskandha uktāḥ | na ca saṃkalpavyāyāmau prajñāsvabhāvau tasyās tv anuguṇāv iti tācchabdyaṃ labhete | evaṃ kāyapraśrabdhir api bodhyaṅgānuguṇyād bodhyaṅgaśabdaṃ labhate |
analyzed: tat yathā prītiḥ prīti sthānīyāḥ ca dharmāḥ prīti saṃbodhi aṅgam uktam bhagavatā pratighaḥ pratigha nimittam ca vyāpāda nivaraṇam uktam samyakdṛṣṭi saṃkalpa vyāyāmāḥ ca prajñā skandhe uktāḥ na ca saṃkalpa vyāyāmau prajñā svabhāvau tasyāḥ tu anuguṇau iti tācchabdyam labhete evam kāya praśrabdhiḥ api bodhyaṅga ānuguṇyāt bodhyaṅga śabdam labhate

original: upekṣā cittasamatā cittānābhogatā | katham idānīm etad yokṣyate | ''tatraiva citte ābhogātmako manaskāro 'nābhogātmikā copekṣeti | nanu coktaṃ durjñāna eṣāṃ viśeṣa'' iti | asti hi nāma durjñānam api jñāyate | idaṃ tu khalv atidurjñānaṃ yad virodhe 'py avirodha iti | anyatrābhogo 'nyatrānābhoga iti ko 'tra virodhaḥ |
analyzed: upekṣā citta sama tā citta anābhogatā katham idānīm etat yokṣyate tatra eva citte ābhoga ātmakaḥ manaskāraḥ na ābhoga ātmikā ca upekṣā iti nanu ca uktam durjñānaḥ eṣām viśeṣaḥ iti asti hi nāma durjñānam api jñāyate idam tu khalu ati durjñānam yat virodhe pi avirodhe iti anyatra ābhogaḥ nyatra anābhogaḥ iti kaḥ tra virodhaḥ

original: na tarhīdānīm ekālambanaḥ sarve saṃprayuktāḥ prāpnuvanti | evaṃjātīyakam atrānyad apy āyāsyatīti yas tasya nayaḥ so 'syāpi veditavyaḥ | hrīr apatrāpyaṃ ca paścād vakṣyate | mūladvayaṃ dve kuśalamūle lalobhādveṣau | amoho 'py asti sa tu prajñātmakaḥ | prajñā ca mahābhūmiketi nāsau kuśalamahābhūmika evocyate |
analyzed: na tarhi idānīm eka ālambanaḥ sarve saṃprayuktāḥ prāpnuvanti evaṃjātīyakam atra anyat api āyāsyati iti yaḥ tasya nayaḥ veditavyaḥ hrīḥ apatrāpyam ca paścāt vakṣyate mūla dvayam dve kuśalamūle asti sa tu prajñā ātmakaḥ prajñā ca mahā bhūmikā iti na asau kuśala mahā bhūmikaḥ eva ucyate

original: avihiṃsā aviheṭhanā vīryaṃ cetaso 'bhyutsāhaḥ | [p.56] uktāḥ kuśalamahābhūmikāḥ |
analyzed: avihiṃsā a viheṭhanā vīryam cetasaḥ bhyutsāhaḥ uktāḥ kuśala mahā bhūmikāḥ

original: mahatī bhūmir mahābhūmiḥ | kleśā mahābhūmir eṣāṃ ta ime kleśamahābhumikā ye dharmāḥ sadaiva kliṣṭe cetasi bhavanti | ke punas te sadaiva kliṣṭe cetasi bhavanti |
analyzed: mahatī bhūmiḥ mahā bhūmiḥ kleśāḥ mahā bhūmiḥ eṣām te ime kleśa mahābhumikāḥ ye dharmāḥ sadā eva kliṣṭe cetasi bhavanti ke punar te sadā eva kliṣṭe cetasi bhavanti

original: mohaḥ pramādaḥ kauśīdyamāśraddhyaṃ styānam uddhavaḥ |
analyzed: mohaḥ pramādaḥ kauśīdyam āśraddhyam styānam uddhavaḥ

original: kliṣṭe sadaiva (26abc)
analyzed: kliṣṭe sadā eva

original: tatra moho nāmāvidyā 'jñānam asaṃprakhyānam | pramādaḥ kuśalānāṃ dharmāṇām abhāvanā 'pramādavipakṣo dharmaḥ | kauśīdyam cetaso nābhyutsāho vīryavipakṣaḥ | āśraddhyaṃ cetaso 'prasādaḥ śraddhāvipakṣaḥ | styānaṃ katamat | yā kāyagurutā cittagurutā kāyākarmaṇyatā cittākarmaṇyatā | kāyikaṃ styānaṃ caitasikaṃ styānam ity uktam abhidharme |
analyzed: tatra mohaḥ nāma avidyā jñānam asaṃprakhyānam pramādaḥ kuśalānām dharmāṇām abhāvanā pramāda vipakṣaḥ dharmaḥ kauśīdyam cetasaḥ na abhyutsāhaḥ vīrya vipakṣaḥ āśraddhyam cetasaḥ prasādaḥ śraddhā vipakṣaḥ styānam katamat yā kāya guru tā citta guru tā kāya akarmaṇya tā citta akarmaṇya tā kāyikam styānam caitasikam styānam iti uktam abhidharme

original: kathaṃ caitasiko dharmaḥ kāyika ity ucyate | yathā kāyikī vedanā | auddhatyaṃ punaś cetaso 'vyupaśamaḥ | itīme ṣaṭ kleśamahābhūmikāḥ | nanu cābhidharme daśa kleśamahābhūmikāḥ paṭhyante | āśraddhyaṃ kauśīdyaṃ muṣitasmṛtitā cetaso vikṣepaḥ avidyā asaṃprajanyam ayoniśomanaskāro mithyāadhimokṣa auddhatyaṃ prasādaś ceti |
analyzed: katham caitasikaḥ dharmaḥ kāyikaḥ iti ucyate yathā kāyikī vedanā auddhatyam punar cetasaḥ vyupaśamaḥ iti ime ṣaṭ kleśa mahā bhūmikāḥ nanu ca abhidharme daśa kleśa mahā bhūmikāḥ paṭhyante āśraddhyam kauśīdyam muṣita smṛti tā cetasaḥ vikṣepaḥ avidyā asaṃprajanyam a yoni śomanaskāraḥ mithyā adhimokṣaḥ auddhatyam prasādaḥ ca iti

original: prāptijño devānāṃ priyo na tv iṣṭijñaḥ | kā punar atreṣṭiḥ | muṣitasmṛtivikṣepāsaṃprajanyāyoniśomanasikāramithyāadhimokṣā mahābhūjmikatvāt na kleśamahābhūmikā evāvadhāryante | yathaivāmohaḥ kuśalamahābhūmiko nāvadhāryate prajñāsvabhāvatvāt | smṛtir eva hi kliṣṭā muṣitasmṛtitā | samādhir eva kliṣṭo vikṣepa ity evamādi |
analyzed: prāpti jñaḥ devānām priyaḥ na tu iṣṭi jñaḥ kā punar atra iṣṭiḥ muṣita smṛti vikṣepa asaṃprajanya ayoni śo manasikāra mithyā adhimokṣāḥ mahā bhūjmika tvāt na kleśa mahā bhūmikāḥ eva avadhāryante yathā eva amohaḥ kuśala mahā bhūmikaḥ na avadhāryate prajñā svabhāva tvāt smṛtiḥ eva hi kliṣṭā muṣita smṛti tā samādhiḥ eva kliṣṭaḥ vikṣepaḥ iti evamādi

original: ata evocyate, ye mahābhūmikā kleśamahābhūmikā api ta iti | catuṣkoṭikaḥ | prathamā koṭir vedanā cetanā saṃjñā cchandaḥ sparśaś ca | dvitīyāśraddhyaṃ kauśīdyam avidyā auddhatyaṃ pramādaś ca | tṛtīyā muṣitasmṛtyādayaḥ pañca kliṣṭā yathoktāḥ | caturthe etān ākārān sthāpayitveti | kecit tu mithyāsamādher anyacetaso vikṣepam icchanti |
analyzed: atas eva ucyate ye mahā bhūmikā kleśa mahā bhūmikāḥ api te iti catuṣkoṭikaḥ prathamā koṭiḥ vedanā cetanā saṃjñā chandaḥ sparśaḥ ca dvitīyā aśraddhyam kauśīdyam avidyāḥ auddhatyam pramādaḥ ca tṛtīyā muṣita smṛti ādayaḥ pañca kliṣṭāḥ yathā uktāḥ caturthe etān ākārān sthāpayitvā iti kecid tu mithyā samādheḥ anya cetasaḥ vikṣepam icchanti

original: teṣām anyathā catuṣkoṭikaḥ | styānaṃ punari iṣyate sarvakleśasaṃprayogīti kleśamahābhūmikeṣu tsyāpāṭhe kasyāparādhaḥ | evaṃ tv āhuḥ paṭhitavyaṃ bhavet samādhyanuguṇatvāt tu na paṭhitam | kṣiprataraṃ kila styānacaritaḥ samādhim utpādayen nauddhatyacarita iti | kaḥ punas styānacarito yo nauddhatyacaritaḥ ko vā auddhatyacarito yo na styānacaritaḥ |
analyzed: teṣām anyathā catuṣkoṭikaḥ styānam iṣyate sarva kleśa saṃprayogī iti kleśa mahābhūmikeṣu kasya aparādhaḥ evam tu āhuḥ paṭhitavyam bhavet samādhi anuguṇa tvāt tu na paṭhitam kṣiprataram kila styāna caritaḥ samādhim utpādayet na auddhatya caritaḥ iti kaḥ punar styāna caritaḥ yaḥ na auddhatya caritaḥ kaḥ vā auddhatya caritaḥ yaḥ na styāna caritaḥ

original: na hy ete jātu sahacariṣṇutāṃ jahītaḥ | tathāpi yady asyādhimātraṃ sa taccarito jñātavyaḥ | ataḥ ṣaḍ eva kleśamahābhūmikāḥ sidhyanti | ete hi sadā kliṣṭa eva cetasi bhavanti nānyatra || [p.57]
analyzed: na hi ete jātu sahacariṣṇu tām jahītaḥ tathā api yadi asya adhimātram sa tad caritaḥ jñātavyaḥ atas ṣaḍ eva kleśa mahā bhūmikāḥ sidhyanti ete hi sadā kliṣṭe eva cetasi bhavanti na anyatra

original: akuśale tv āhrīkyam anapatrapā ||26cd ||
analyzed: akuśale tu āhrīkyam anapatrapā

original: akuśale tu cetasy āhrīkyam anapatrāpyaṃ ca nityaṃ bhavata ity etau dvau dharmāv akuśalamahābhūmikāv ucyete | tayoś ca paścāl lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate |
analyzed: akuśale tu cetasi āhrīkyam anapatrāpyam ca nityam bhavataḥ iti etau dvau dharmau akuśala mahābhūmikau ucyete tayoḥ ca paścāt lakṣaṇam vakṣyate

original: krodhopanāhaśāṭhyerṣyāprasādamrakṣamatsarāḥ |
analyzed: krodha upanāha śāṭhya īrṣyā prasāda mrakṣa matsarāḥ

original: māyāmadavihiṃsāś ca parittakleśabhūmikāḥ ||27||
analyzed: māyā mada vihiṃsāḥ ca paritta kleśa bhūmikāḥ 27

original: pareīttakleśā bhūmir eṣāṃ ta ime parittakleśabhūmikā avidyāmātreṇa bhāvanaheyena manobhūmikenaiva ca saṃprayogāt | eṣāṃ tu nirddeśa upakleśeṣu kariṣyate |
analyzed: pareītta kleśāḥ bhūmiḥ eṣām te ime paritta kleśa bhūmikāḥ avidyā mātreṇa bhāvana heyena manaḥ bhūmikena eva ca saṃprayogāt eṣām tu nirddeśaḥ upakleśeṣu kariṣyate

original: uktā ime pañcaprakāraś caittāḥ | anye pi cāniyatāḥ santi vitarkavicārakaukṛtyamiddhādayaḥ | tatra vaktavyaṃ kasmiṃś citte kati caittā avaśyaṃ bhavatīti | kāmāvacaraṃ tāvat pañcavidhaṃ cittam | kuśalam akuśalam | tatrākuśalaṃ dvividham āveṇikam anyakleśasaṃprayuktaṃ ca | avyākṛtaṃ dvividhaṃ nivṛtāvyākṛtam anivṛtāvyākṛtaṃ ca |
analyzed: uktāḥ ime pañca prakāraḥ caittāḥ anye ca aniyatāḥ santi vitarka vicāra kaukṛtya middha ādayaḥ tatra vaktavyam kasmin citte kati caittāḥ avaśyam bhavati iti kāma avacaram tāvat pañcavidham cittam kuśalam akuśalam tatra akuśalam dvividham āveṇikam anya kleśa saṃprayuktam ca avyākṛtam dvividham nivṛta avyākṛtam anivṛta avyākṛtam ca

original: tatra tāvat kāmāvacaracittam avaśyaṃ savitarkaṃ savicāraṃ | ato 'tra
analyzed: tatra tāvat kāma avacara cittam avaśyam sa vitarkam sa vicāram

original: savitarkavicāratvāt kuśale kāmacetasi |
analyzed: sa vitarka vicāra tvāt kuśale kāma cetasi

original: dvāviṃśatiś caitasikāḥ (28abc)
analyzed: dvāviṃśatiḥ ca aitasikāḥ

original: avaśyaṃ bhavanti | daśa mahābhūmikā daśa kuśalamahābhūmikā vitarko vicāraś ca |
analyzed: avaśyam bhavanti daśa mahābhūmikāḥ daśa kuśala mahābhūmikāḥ vitarkaḥ vicāraḥ ca

original: kaukṛtyam adhikaṃ kvacit ||28d ||
analyzed: kaukṛtyam adhikam kvacid

original: na hi sarvatra kuśale cetasi kaukṛtyam asti | yatra tv asti tatra tad evādhikaṃ kṛtvā trayoviṃśatiś caittā bhavanti | kim idaṃ kaukṛtyaṃ nāma | kukṛtasya bhāvaḥ kaukṛtyam | iha tu punaḥ kaukṛtyālambano dharmaḥ kaukṛtyam ucyate cetaso vipratisāraḥ | tadyathā śūnyatāalambanaṃ vimokṣamukhaṃ śūnyatety ucyate aśubhāalambanaś cālobho 'śubha iti |
analyzed: na hi sarvatra kuśale cetasi kaukṛtyam asti yatra tu asti tatra tat eva adhikam kṛtvā trayoviṃśatiḥ caittāḥ bhavanti kim idam kaukṛtyam nāma kukṛtasya bhāvaḥ kaukṛtyam iha tu punar kaukṛtya ālambanaḥ dharmaḥ kaukṛtyam ucyate cetasaḥ vipratisāraḥ tat yathā śūnyatā a lambanam vimokṣa mukham śūnyatā iti ucyate aśubha a lambanaḥ ca a lobhaḥ śubhaḥ iti

original: loke 'pi ca dṛṣṭaḥ sthānena sthāninām atideśaḥ sarvo grāma āgataḥ sarvo deśa āgata iti | sthānabhūtaṃ ca kaukṛtyaṃ vipratisārasya | phale vā hetūpacāro 'yam | yathoktaṃ ṣaḍ imāni sparśāayatanāni paurāṇaṃ karma veditavyam iti | yat tarhi akṛtālambanaṃ tat kathaṃ kaukṛtyam | akṛte 'pi kṛtākhyā bhavati | [p.58] na mayā sādhu kṛtaṃ yan na kṛtam iti |
analyzed: loke ca dṛṣṭaḥ sthānena sthāninām atideśaḥ sarvaḥ grāmaḥ āgataḥ sarvaḥ deśaḥ āgataḥ iti sthāna bhūtam ca kaukṛtyam vipratisārasya phale vā hetu upacāraḥ yam yathoktam ṣaḍ imāni sparśa āayatanāni paurāṇam karma veditavyam iti yat tarhi akṛta ālambanam tat katham kaukṛtyam akṛte pi kṛta ākhyā bhavati na mayā sādhu kṛtam yat na kṛtam iti

original: katamat kaukṛtyaṃ kuśalam | yat kuśalam akṛtvā tapyate akuśalaṃ ca kṛtvā | viparyayād akuśalaṃ kaukṛtyam | tad etad ubhayam apy ubhayādhiṣṭhānam |
analyzed: katamat kaukṛtyam kuśalam yat kuśalam a kṛtvā tapyate akuśalam ca kṛtvā viparyayāt akuśalam kaukṛtyam tat etat ubhayam api ubhaya adhiṣṭhānam

original: āveṇike tv akuśale dṛṣṭiyukte ca viṃśatiḥ | (29ab)
analyzed: āveṇike tu akuśale dṛṣṭi yukte ca viṃśatiḥ

original: yad akuśalaṃ cittam āveṇikaṃ tatra viṃśatiś caittāḥ | daśa mahābhūmikāḥ ṣaḍ kleśamahābhūmikā dvāv akuśalamahābhūmikau vitarko vicāraś ca | āveṇikaṃ nāma cittaṃ yatrāvidyaiva kevalā nānyaḥ kleśo 'sti rāgādiḥ | dṛṣṭiyukte 'py akuśale viṃśatir ya evāveṇike | nanu ca drṣṭyadhikatvād ekaviṃśatir bhavanti | na bhavanti |
analyzed: yat akuśalam cittam āveṇikam tatra viṃśatiḥ caittāḥ daśa mahābhūmikāḥ ṣaḍ kleśa mahābhūmikāḥ dvau akuśala mahābhūmikau vitarkaḥ vicāraḥ ca āveṇikam nāma cittam yatra avidyā eva kevalā na anyaḥ kleśaḥ sti rāga ādiḥ dṛṣṭi yukte pi akuśale viṃśatiḥ ye eva āveṇike nanu ca drṣṭi adhika tvāt ekaviṃśatiḥ bhavanti na bhavanti

original: yasmān mahābhūjmika eva kaścit prajñāviśeṣo dṛṣṭir ity ucyate | tatrākuśalaṃ dṛṣṭiyuktaṃ yatra mithyādṛṣitir vā dṛṣṭiparāmarśo vā śīlavrataparāmarśo vā |
analyzed: yasmāt eva kaścid prajñā viśeṣaḥ dṛṣṭiḥ iti ucyate tatra akuśalam dṛṣṭi yuktam yatra mithyā dṛṣitiḥ vā dṛṣṭi parāmarśaḥ vā śīla vrata parāmarśaḥ vā

original: keleśaiś caturbhiḥ krodhādyaiḥ
analyzed: keleśaiḥ caturbhiḥ krodha ādyaiḥ

original: kaukṛtyenaikaviṃśatiḥ ||29cd ||
analyzed: kaukṛtyena ekaviṃśatiḥ 29cd

original: yatra punaś caturbhh kleśaiḥ saṃprayuktam akuśalaṃ cittaṃ rāgeṇa vā pratighena vā mānena vā vicikitsayā vā tatraikaviṃśatir bhavanti | sa ca kleśaḥ āveṇikoktāś ca viṃśatiḥ | krodhādibhir apy upakleśair yathoktaiḥ saṃprayukte citte ete ca viṃśatiḥ sa copakleśa ity ekaviṃśatir bhavanti | kaukṛtyenāpy ekaviṃśatiḥ |
analyzed: yatra punar kleśaiḥ saṃprayuktam akuśalam cittam rāgeṇa vā pratighena vā mānena vā vicikitsayā vā tatra ekaviṃśatiḥ bhavanti sa ca kleśaḥ āveṇika uktāḥ ca viṃśatiḥ krodha ādibhiḥ api upakleśaiḥ yathā uktaiḥ saṃprayukte citte ete ca viṃśatiḥ sa ca upakleśaḥ iti ekaviṃśatiḥ bhavanti kaukṛtyena api ekaviṃśatiḥ

original: tad eva kaukṛtyam ekaviṃśatitamaṃ bhavati | samāsata āveṇike cetasy akuśale dṛṣṭiyukte ca viṃśatiḥ | anyakleśopakleśasaṃprayūkte tv ekaviṃśatiḥ |
analyzed: tat eva kaukṛtyam ekaviṃśatitamam bhavati samāsatas āveṇike cetasi akuśale dṛṣṭi yukte ca viṃśatiḥ anya kleśa upakleśa saṃprayūkte tu ekaviṃśatiḥ

original: nivṛte 'ṣṭādaśa (30a)
analyzed: nivṛte ṣṭādaśa

original: satkāyāntagrāhadṛṣṭisaṃprayuktaṃ cittaṃ kāmadhātau nivṛtāvyākṛtam | tatrāṣṭādaśa caittāḥ | daśa mahābhūmikāh ṣaṭ kleśamahābhūmikāḥ vitarkavicārau ca | dṛṣṭiḥ pūrvavad eva nādhikā bhavati |
analyzed: satkāya anta grāha dṛṣṭi saṃprayuktam cittam kāmadhātau nivṛta avyākṛtam tatra aṣṭādaśa caittāḥ daśa mahābhūmikāḥ ṣaṭ kleśa mahābhūmikāḥ vitarka vicārau ca dṛṣṭiḥ pūrvavat eva na adhikā bhavati

original: anyatra dvādaśāvyākṛte matāḥ | (30ab)
analyzed: anyatra dvādaśa avyākṛte matāḥ

original: nivṛtād anyad avyākṛtam anivṛtāvyākṛtam | tatra dvādaśa caittā iṣṭāḥ | daś mahābhūmikā vitarkavicārau ca | bahirdeśakā avyākṛtam api kaukṛtyam icchanti | teṣāṃ tatsaṃprayukte cetasi trayodaśa bhavanti |
analyzed: nivṛtāt anyat avyākṛtam anivṛta avyākṛtam tatra dvādaśa caittāḥ iṣṭāḥ daśa mahābhūmikāḥ vitarka vicārau ca bahirdeśakāḥ avyākṛtam api kaukṛtyam icchanti teṣām tad saṃprayukte cetasi trayodaśa bhavanti

original: middhaṃ sarvāvirodhitvād yatra syād adhikaṃ hi tat ||30cd ||
analyzed: middham sarva avirodhi tvāt yatra syāt adhikam hi tat

original: sarvair ebhir yathoktaiś caittair middham aviruddhaṃ kuśalākuśalāvyākṛtatvāt | ato yatra tat syāt tatrādhikaṃ [p.59] tad veditavyam | yatra dvāviṃśatis tatra trayoviṃśatir yatra trayoviṃśatis tatra caturviṃśatir ity evamādi | ya eva[ṃ'] kāmadhātau caittānāṃ niyama uktaḥ

original: tena tarhi asattvākhyair api samanvāgamaḥ prāpnoti parasattvaiś ca | kiṃ kāraṇam | sūtravacanāt | rājā bhikṣavaś cakravarttī saptabhī ratnaiḥ samanvāgata iti vistaraḥ | vaśitvam atra samanvāgamaśabdenoktam | tasya teṣu ratneṣu vaśitvaṃ kāmacāra iti | atra vaśitvaṃ samanvāgamo 'nyatra punar dravyāntaram iti kuta etat | kaḥ punar evam ayogaḥ |
analyzed: tena tarhi asattva ākhyaiḥ api samanvāgamaḥ prāpnoti para sattvaiḥ ca kim kāraṇam sūtra vacanāt rājā bhikṣavaḥ cakravarttī saptabhiḥ ratnaiḥ samanvāgataḥ iti vistaraḥ vaśitvam atra samanvāgama śabdena uktam tasya teṣu ratneṣu vaśi tvam kāmacāraḥ iti atra vaśi tvam samanvāgamaḥ nyatra punar dravya antaram iti kutas etat kaḥ punar evam ayogaḥ

original: ayam ayogaḥ yad asyā naiva svabhāvaḥ prajñāyate rūpaśabdādivad rāgadveṣādivad vā, na cāpi kṛtyaṃ cakṣuḥśrotrādivat | tasmāt dravyadharmāsaṃbhavād ayogaḥ | utpattihetur dharmāṇāṃ prāptir iti cet | asaṃskṛtasya na syāt | ye ca charmā aprāptā ye ca pratyaktā bhūmisaṃcāravairāgyatas teṣāṃ katham utpattiḥ syāt | sahajaprāptihetukā cet |
analyzed: ayam ayogaḥ yat asyāḥ na eva svabhāvaḥ prajñāyate rūpa śabda ādi vat rāga dveṣa ādi vat vā na ca api kṛtyam cakṣuḥ śrotra ādi vat tasmāt dravya dharma asaṃbhavāt ayogaḥ utpatti hetuḥ dharmāṇām prāptiḥ iti ced asaṃskṛtasya na syāt ye ca aprāptāḥ ye ca pratyaktāḥ bhūmi saṃcāra vairāgyataḥ teṣām katham utpattiḥ syāt sahaja prāpti hetukā ced

original: jātir idānīṃ kiṃkarī jātijātir vā | sakalabandhanānāṃ khalv api mṛdumadhyādhimātrakleśotpattibhedo na syāt prāptyabhedāt | yato vā sa bhedas tata evāstu tadutpattiḥ | tasmān notpattihetuḥ prāptiḥ | kaścaivam āhotpattihetuḥ prāptir iti | kiṃ tarhi | vyavasthāhetuḥ |
analyzed: jātiḥ idānīm kiṃkarī jāti jātiḥ vā sakala bandhanānām khalu api mṛdu madhya adhimātra kleśa utpatti bhedaḥ na syāt prāpti abhedāt yatas vā sa bhedaḥ tatas evā astu tad utpattiḥ tasmāt na utpatti hetuḥ prāptiḥ kaḥ ca evam āha utpatti hetuḥ prāptiḥ iti kim tarhi vyavasthā hetuḥ

original: asatyāṃ hi prāptau laukikamānasānāṃ āryapṛthagjanānāṃ āryā ime, pṛthagjanā ima iti na syād vyavasthānam | prahīṇāprahīṇakleśatāviśeṣād etat bhavitum arhati | etac caiva kathaṃ bhaviṣyaty eṣāṃ prahīṇaḥ kleśa eṣām aprahīṇa iti | prāptau satyām etat sidhyati tadvigamāvigamāt | āśrayaviśeṣād etat sidhyati |
analyzed: asatyām hi prāptau laukika mānasānām ārya pṛthagjanānām āryāḥ ime pṛthagjanāḥ ime iti na syāt vyavasthānam prahīṇa aprahīṇa kleśa tā viśeṣāt etat bhavitum arhati etat ca eva katham bhaviṣyati eṣām prahīṇaḥ kleśaḥ eṣām aprahīṇaḥ iti prāptau satyām etat sidhyati tad vigama avigamāt āśraya viśeṣāt etat sidhyati

original: āśrayo hi sa āryāṇāṃ darśanabhāvanāmārgasāmarthyāt tathā parāvṛtto bhavati, yathā na punas tatpraheyāṇāṃ kleśānāṃ prarohasamartho bhavati | ato 'gnidagdhab rīhivad abījībhūte āśraye kleśānāṃ prahīṇakleśa ity ucyate | upahatabījabhāve vā laukikena mārgeṇa | viparyayād aprahīṇakleśaḥ |
analyzed: āśrayaḥ hi saḥ āryāṇām darśana bhāvanā mārga sāmarthyāt tathā parāvṛttaḥ bhavati yathā na punar tad praheyāṇām kleśānām praroha samarthaḥ bhavati atas gni dagdha p rīhi vat abījībhūte āśraye kleśānām prahīṇa kleśaḥ iti ucyate upahata bīja bhāve vā laukikena mārgeṇa viparyayāt a prahīṇa kleśaḥ

original: yaś cāprahīṇas tena samanvāgato, yaḥ prahīṇas tenāsamanvāgata iti prajñapyate | kuśalā api dharmā dviprakārā ayatnabhāvino yatnabhāvinaś ca, ye ta ucyante utpattipratilambhikāḥ prāyogikāś ceti | tatrāyatnabhāvibhir āśrayasya tadbījabhāvānupaghātāt samanvāgata upaghātād asamanvāgata ucyate samucchinnakuśalamūlaḥ |
analyzed: yaḥ ca aprahīṇaḥ tena samanvāgataḥ yaḥ prahīṇaḥ tena a samanvāgataḥ iti prajñapyate kuśalāḥ api dharmāḥ dvi prakārāḥ ayatna bhāvinaḥ yatna bhāvinaḥ ca ye te ucyante utpatti pratilambhikāḥ prāyogikāḥ ca iti tatra ayatna bhāvibhiḥ āśrayasya tad bīja bhāva anupaghātāt samanvāgataḥ upaghātāt a samanvāgataḥ ucyate samucchinna kuśala mūlaḥ

original: tasya [p.64] tūpaghāto mithyādṛṣṭyā veditavyaḥ | na tu khalu kuśalānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ bījabhāvasyātyantaṃ santatau samudghātaḥ | ye punar yatnabhāvinas tair utpannais tadutpattir vaśitvāavighātāt santateḥ samanvāgata ucyate | tasmād bījam evātrānapoddhrṭam anupahataṃ paripṛṣṭaṃ ca vaśitvakāle samanvāgamākhyāṃ labhate, nānyad dravyam |
analyzed: tasya tu upaghātaḥ mithyādṛṣṭyā veditavyaḥ na tu khalu kuśalānām dharmāṇām bīja bhāvasya atyantam santatau samudghātaḥ ye punar yatna bhāvinaḥ taiḥ utpannaiḥ tad utpattiḥ vaśitvā avighātāt santateḥ samanvāgataḥ ucyate tasmāt bījam eva atra anapoddhrṭam anupahatam paripṛṣṭam ca vaśitva kāle samanvāgama ākhyām labhate na anyat dravyam

original: kiṃ punar idaṃ bījaṃ nāma | yan nāmarūpaṃ phalotpattau samarthaṃ sākṣāt pāraṃparyeṇa vā | santatipariṇāmaviśeṣāt | ko 'yaṃ pariṇāmo nāma | santater anyathātvam | kā ceyaṃ santatiḥ | hetu phalabhūtās traiyadhvikāḥ saṃskārāḥ | yat tūktaṃ lobhena samanvāgato 'bhavyaś catvāri smṛtyupasthānāni bhāvayitum iti |
analyzed: kim punar idam bījam nāma yat nāma rūpam phala utpattau samartham sākṣāt pāraṃparyeṇa vā santati pariṇāma viśeṣāt kaḥ yam pariṇāmaḥ nāma santateḥ anyathātvam kā ca iyam santatiḥ phala bhūtāḥ traiyadhvikāḥ saṃskārāḥ yat tu uktam lobhena samanvāgataḥ bhavyaḥ catvāri smṛti upasthānāni bhāvayitum iti

original: tatrādhivāsanaṃ lobhasyāvinodanaṃ vā samanvāgamaḥ | yāvad dhi tasyādhivāsako 'vinodako bhavati, tāvat bhavyas tāni bhāvayitum | evam ayaṃ samanvāgamaḥ sarvathā prajñaptidharmo na tu dravyadharmaḥ | tasya ca pratiṣedho 'samanvāgama iti | dravyam eva tu vaibhāṣikāḥ ubhayaṃ varṇayanti | kiṃ kāraṇam eṣa hi naḥ siddhanta iti |
analyzed: tatra adhivāsanam lobhasya avinodanam vā samanvāgamaḥ yāvat hi tasya adhivāsakaḥ vinodakaḥ bhavati tāvat bhavyaḥ tāni bhāvayitum evam ayam samanvāgamaḥ sarvathā prajñapti dharmaḥ na tu dravya dharmaḥ tasya ca samanvāgamaḥ iti dravyam eva tu vaibhāṣikāḥ ubhayam varṇayanti kim kāraṇam eṣa hi naḥ siddhantaḥ iti

original: sā kilaiṣa prāptiḥ,
analyzed: sā kila eṣa prāptiḥ

analyzed: aśaikṣāṇām dharmāṇām śaikṣā eva prāptiḥ aśaikṣāṇām aśaikṣā eva na eva śaikṣa anāśaikṣāṇām tu bhedaḥ sa nirdiśyate

original: tridhā naśaikṣāśaikṣāṇāṃ (38a)

original: naivaśaikṣānāśaikṣā dharmā ucyante sāravā dharmā asaṃskṛtaṃ ca | teṣāṃ śaikṣādibhedena trividhā prāptiḥ | sāsravāṇāṃ tāvat naivaśaikṣānāśaikṣī prāptiḥ | sāsravāṇāṃ tāvat naivaśaikṣānāśaikṣī prāptiḥ | apratisaṃkhyānirodhasya ca pratisaṃkhyānirodhasya cānāryeṇa prāptasya | tasyaiva śaikṣeṇa mārgeṇa prāptasya śaikṣī aśaikṣeṇāśaikṣī |

analyzed: pṛthagjana tvam katamat ārya dharmāṇām alābhaḥ iti śāstra pāṭhaḥ alābhaḥ ca nāma aprāptiḥ na ca pṛthagjana tvam anāsravam bhavitum arhati katameṣām ārya dharmāṇām alābhaḥ sarveṣām aviśeṣa vacanāt sa tu yaḥ vinā lābhena alābhaḥ anyathā hi śrāvaka pratyekabuddha gotrakaiḥ a samanvāgamāt anāryaḥ syāt eva śabdaḥ tarhi paṭhitavyaḥ

original: na paṭhitavyaḥ | ekapadāny api hy avadhāraṇāni bhavanti | tadyathā abbhakṣo vāyubhakṣa iti | duḥkhe dharmajñānakṣāntitatsahabhuvām alābha ity apare | na ca tadyogād anāryatvaprasaṅgaḥ | tadalābhasyātyantaṃ hatatvāt | te tarhi trigotrā iti katameṣām alābhaḥ | sarveṣām | evaṃ tarhi sa eva doṣaḥ | punaḥ sa eva parihāraḥ | yatnas tarhi vyarthaḥ |
