original: na vai labhyate [p.74] kāmacāro yat kvacid evoṣmā vijñānasyādhāro bhaviṣyati, kvacid eva karmeti | uktaṃ cātra | kim uktam | mā bhūt sarvaṃ vijñānam āmaraṇād vipāka iti | tasmād asty eva tayor ādhārabhūtam āyuḥ | na hi nāstīti brūmo na tu dravyāntaram | kiṃ tarhi | traidhātukena karmaṇā nikāyasabhāgasya sthitikālāvedhaḥ |
analyzed: na vai labhyate kāmacāraḥ yat kvacid eva ūṣmā vijñānasya ādhāraḥ bhaviṣyati kvacid eva karma iti uktam ca atra kim uktam mā bhūt sarvam vijñānam ā maraṇāt vipākaḥ iti tasmāt asti eva tayoḥ ādhāra bhūtam āyuḥ na hi na asti iti brūmaḥ na tu dravya antaram kim tarhi traidhātukena karmaṇā nikāya sa bhāgasya sthiti kāla āvedhaḥ

original: yāvad dhi karmaṇā nikāyasabhāgasyāvedhaḥ kṛto bhavaty etāvantaṃ kālam avasthātavyam iti tāvat so 'vatiṣṭhate tad āyur ity ucyate | sasyānāṃ pākakālāvedhavat kṣipteṣusthitikālāvedhavac ca | yas tu manyate saṃskāro nāma kaścid guṇaviśeṣa iṣau jāyate yadvaśād gamanam āpatanād bhavatīti |
analyzed: yāvat hi karmaṇā nikāya sa bhāgasya āvedhaḥ kṛtaḥ bhavati etāvantam kālam avasthātavyam iti tāvat saḥ vatiṣṭhate tat āyuḥ iti ucyate sasyānām pāka kāla āvedhavat kṣipta iṣu sthiti kāla āvedhavat ca yaḥ tu manyate saṃskāraḥ nāma kaścid guṇa viśeṣaḥ iṣau jāyate yad vaśāt gamanam āpatanāt bhavati iti

original: tasya tad ekatvāt pratipannābhāvāc ca deśāntaraiḥ śīghrataratamaprāptikālabhedānupapattiḥ patanānupapattiś ca | vāyunā tatpratibandha iti cet | arvākpatanaprasaṅgo na vā kadācid vāyor aviśeṣāt | evaṃ tu varṇayanti dravyāntaram āyur astīti |
analyzed: tasya tat eka tvāt pratipanna abhāvāt ca deśa antaraiḥ śīghrataratama prāpti kāla bheda anupapattiḥ patana anupapattiḥ ca vāyunā tad pratibandhaḥ iti ced arvākpatana prasaṅgaḥ na vā kadācid vāyoḥ aviśeṣāt evam tu varṇayanti dravya antaram āyuḥ asti iti

original: atha kim āyuḥkṣayād eva maraṇaṃ bhavaty āhosvid anyathāapi | prajñāptāv uktam āyuḥkṣayān maraṇaṃ, na puṇyakṣayād iti | catuṣkoṭiḥ | prathamā koṭir āyurvipākasya karmaṇaḥ paryādānāt | dvitīyā bhogavipākasya | tṛtīyobhayoḥ | caturthī viṣamāparihāreṇa | āyurutsargāc ceti vaktavyam | na vaktavyam | āyuḥkṣayād eva tanmaraṇam | prathamakoṭyantargamāt |
analyzed: atha kim āyuḥ kṣayāt eva maraṇam bhavati āhosvit anyathā api prajñāptau uktam āyuḥ kṣayāt maraṇam na puṇya kṣayāt iti catuṣkoṭiḥ prathamā koṭiḥ āyuḥ vipākasya karmaṇaḥ paryādānāt dvitīyā bhoga vipākasya tṛtīyā ubhayoḥ caturthī viṣama a parihāreṇa āyuḥ utsargāt ca iti vaktavyam na vaktavyam āyuḥ kṣayāt eva tat maraṇam prathama koṭi antargamāt

original: kṣīṇe tv āyuṣi puṇyakṣayasya maraṇe nāsti sāmarthyam | tasmād ubhayakṣaye sati maraṇam āyuḥkṣayād ity uktam | jñānaprasthāne 'py uktam āyuḥ santatyupanibaddhaṃ varttata iti vaktavyam | asakṛdutpannaṃ tiṣṭhatīti vaktavyam | āha | kāmāvacarāṇāṃ sattvānām asaṃjñisamāpattiṃ nirodhasamāpattiṃ ca samāpannānāṃ santatyupanibaddhaṃ varttata iti vaktavyam |
analyzed: kṣīṇe tu āyuṣi puṇya kṣayasya maraṇe na asti sāmarthyam tasmāt ubhaya kṣaye sati maraṇam āyuḥ kṣayāt iti uktam jñānaprasthāne pi uktam āyuḥ santati upanibaddham varttate iti vaktavyam asakṛt utpannam tiṣṭhati iti vaktavyam āha kāmāvacarāṇām sattvānām asaṃjñi samāpattim nirodha samāpattim ca samāpannānām santati upanibaddham varttate iti vaktavyam

original: samāpannānāṃ rūpārūpyāvacarāṇāṃ ca sattvānāṃ sakṛdutpannaṃ tiṣṭhatīti vaktavyam | ko 'sya bhāṣitasyārthaḥ | yasyāśrayopaghātād upaghātas tatsantatyadhīnatvāt prathamam | yasya tv āśrayopaghāta eva nāsti tadyathotpannāvasthānāt dvitīyam | sāntarāyaṃ prathamaṃ nirantarāyaṃ dvitīyam iti kāśmīrāḥ | tasmād asty akālamṛtyuḥ |
analyzed: samāpannānām rūpārūpya avacarāṇām ca sattvānām sakṛt utpannam tiṣṭhati iti vaktavyam kaḥ sya bhāṣitasya arthaḥ yasya āśraya upaghātāt upaghātaḥ tad santati adhīna tvāt prathamam yasya tu āśraya upaghātaḥ eva na asti tat yathā utpanna avasthānāt dvitīyam sa antarāyam prathamam nirantarāyam dvitīyam iti kāśmīrāḥ tasmāt asti akāla mṛtyuḥ

original: sūtra uktam catvāra ātmabhāvapratilambhaḥ | asty ātmabhāvapratilambho yatrātmasaṃcetanā kramate na parasaṃcetaneti | catuṣkoṭikaḥ | ātmasaṃcetanaiva kramate, kāmadhātau krīḍāpramoṣakāṇāṃ devānāṃ manaḥpradūṣakāṇāṃ ca | teṣāṃ hi praharṣamanaḥpradoṣābhyāṃ tasmāt sthānāc cyutir bhavati, nānyathā | buddhānāṃ ceti vaktavyam | [p.75] svayaṃmṛtyutvāt |
analyzed: sūtre uktam catvāraḥ ātma bhāva pratilambhaḥ asti ātma bhāva pratilambhaḥ yatra ātma saṃcetanā kramate na para saṃcetanā iti catuṣkoṭikaḥ ātma saṃcetanā eva kramate kāmadhātau krīḍā pramoṣakāṇām devānām manaḥ pradūṣakāṇām ca teṣām hi praharṣa manaḥ pradoṣābhyām tasmāt sthānāt cyutiḥ bhavati na anyathā buddhānām ca iti vaktavyam p75 svayam mṛtyu tvāt

original: parasaṃcetanaiva kramate garbhāṇḍagatānām | ubhayam apy eṣāṃ kāmāvacarāṇāṃ prāyeṇa | nobhayaṃ sarveṣām antarābhavikānāṃ rūpārūpyāvacarāṇām ekajātīyānāṃ kāmāvacarāṇāṃ tadyathā nārakānām uttarakauravāṇāṃ darśanamārgamaitrīnirodhāsaṃjñisamāpattisamāpannānāṃ rājarṣijinadūtajinādiṣṭadharmilottaragaṅgilaśreṣthiputrayaśaḥkumārajīvakādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ
analyzed: para saṃcetanā eva kramate garbhāṇḍa gatānām ubhayam api eṣām kāmāvacarāṇām prāyeṇa na ubhayam sarveṣām antarābhavikānām rūpārūpya avacarāṇām eka jātīyānām kāmāvacarāṇām tat yathā nārakānām uttara kauravāṇām darśana mārga maitrī nirodha asaṃjñi samāpatti samāpannānām rājarṣi jina dūta jina ādiṣṭa dharmila uttara gaṅgila śreṣthi putra yaśaḥ kumāra jīvaka ādīnām sarveṣām

original: caramabhāvikānāṃ bodhisattvānāṃ bodhisattvamātus tadgarbhāyāḥ cakravarttinaś cakravarttimātuś ca tadgarbhāyāḥ | atha kasmāt sūtra uktaṃ katame te bhadanta sattvā yeṣāṃ nātmasaṃcetanā kramate na parasaṃcetanā | naivasaṃjñānāsaṃjñāyatanopagāḥ śāriputreti |
analyzed: carama bhāvikānām bodhisattvānām bodhisattva mātuḥ tad garbhāyāḥ cakravarttinaḥ cakravartti mātuḥ ca tad garbhāyāḥ atha kasmāt sūtre uktam katame te bhadanta sattvāḥ yeṣām na ātma saṃcetanā kramate na para saṃcetanā na eva saṃjñā na asaṃjñā āyatana upagāḥ śāriputra iti

original: anyeṣu kila dhyānārūpyeṣv ātmasaṃcetanāasvabhūmika āryamārgaḥ parasaṃcetanā uttarabhūmisāmantakas tatra cobhayaṃ nāstīti | nanu caivaṃ tatrāpi parabhūmika āryamārgaḥ parasaṃcetanā prāpnoti | paryantagrahaṇāt tarhi tadādisaṃpratyayaḥ | kvacid ādisaṃpratyayaḥ, kvacid ādinā paryanto 'pi pratīyate | yad āha | tadyathā devā ābhāsvarāḥ |
analyzed: anyeṣu kila dhyāna ārūpyeṣu ātma saṃcetanā asva bhūmikaḥ ārya mārgaḥ para saṃcetanā uttara bhūmi sāmantakaḥ tatra ca ubhayam na asti iti nanu ca evam tatra api para bhūmikaḥ ārya mārgaḥ para saṃcetanā prāpnoti paryanta grahaṇāt tarhi tad ādi saṃpratyayaḥ kvacid ādi saṃpratyayaḥ kvacid ādinā paryantaḥ pi pratīyate yat āha tat yathā devāḥ ābhāsvarāḥ

original: iyaṃ dvitīyā sukhopapattir iti | kvacit paryantenādir api pratīyate | yad āha | tadyathā devā ābhāsvarāḥ | iyaṃ dvitīyā sukhopapattir iti | ayam atra tadyathāśabdo dṛṣṭāntavācaka iti yukta etasmāc cheṣasaṃpratyayaḥ | eṣa hi dṛṣṭāntadharmo yad ekam api tajjātīyakaṃ dṛśyate | sa ceha tadyathāśabdo nāstīty anupasaṃhāra eṣaḥ |
analyzed: iyam dvitīyā sukha upapattiḥ iti kvacid paryantena ādiḥ api pratīyate yat āha tat yathā devāḥ ābhāsvarāḥ iyam dvitīyā sukha upapattiḥ iti ayam atra tad yathā śabdaḥ dṛṣṭānta vācakaḥ iti yuktaḥ etasmāt śeṣa saṃpratyayaḥ eṣa hi dṛṣṭānta dharmaḥ yat ekam api tad jātīyakam dṛśyate sa ca iha tad yathā śabdaḥ na asti iti anupasaṃhāraḥ eṣaḥ

original: yady ayaṃ tadyathāśabdo dṛṣṭāntavācakaḥ syād iha na prāpnuyāt | santi sattvā nānātvakāyā nānātvasaṃjñinas tadyathā manuṣyās tad ekatyāś ca devā iti | tasmād upadarśanāartha evāyaṃ draṣṭavya ity alam atiprasaṅgena | uktaṃ jīvitam ||
analyzed: yadi ayam tat yathā śabdaḥ dṛṣṭānta vācakaḥ syāt iha na prāpnuyāt santi sattvāḥ nānātva kāyāḥ nānātva saṃjñinaḥ tat yathā manuṣyāḥ tat ekatyāḥ ca devāḥ iti tasmāt upadarśana arthaḥ eva ayam draṣṭavyaḥ iti alam atiprasaṅgena uktam jīvitam

original: lakṣaṇāni punar jātijarāsthitir anityatā ||45cd ||
analyzed: lakṣaṇāni punar jāti jarā sthitiḥ anitya tā

original: etāni hi saṃskṛtasya catvāri lakṣaṇāni | yatraitāni bhavanti, sa dharmaḥ saṃskṛto lakṣyate | viparyayād asaṃskṛtaḥ | tatra jātis taṃ dharmaṃ janayati, sthitiḥ sthāpayati, jarā jarayati, anityatā vināśayati | nanu trīṇīmāni saṃskṛtasya saṃskṛtalakṣanānīti sūtra uktam | caturtham apy anyatra vaktavyaṃ syāt | kiṃ cātra noktam | āha | sthitiḥ |
analyzed: etāni hi saṃskṛtasya catvāri lakṣaṇāni yatra etāni bhavanti sa dharmaḥ saṃskṛtaḥ lakṣyate viparyayāt a saṃskṛtaḥ tatra jātiḥ tam dharmam janayati sthitiḥ sthāpayati jarā jarayati anitya tā vināśayati nanu trīṇi imāni saṃskṛtasya saṃskṛta lakṣanāni iti sūtre uktam caturtham api anyatra vaktavyam syāt kim ca atra na uktam āha sthitiḥ

original: yat tarhi idaṃ sthityanyathātvam iti | jarāyā eṣa paryāyas tadyathā jāter utpāda ity anityatāyāś ca vyaya iti | ye hi dharmāḥ saṃskārāṇām [p.76] adhvasaṃcārāya pravṛttās ta eva sūtre lakṣaṇāny uktāny udvejanārtham | jātir hi yā saṃskārān anāgatād adhvanaḥ pratyutpannam adhvānaṃ saṃcārayati |
analyzed: yat tarhi idam sthiti anyathātvam iti jarāyāḥ eṣa paryāyaḥ tat yathā jāteḥ utpādaḥ iti anitya tāyāḥ ca vyayaḥ iti ye hi dharmāḥ saṃskārāṇām adhva saṃcārāya pravṛttāḥ te eva sūtre lakṣaṇāni uktāni udvejana artham jātiḥ hi yā saṃskārān anāgatāt adhvanaḥ pratyutpannam adhvānam saṃcārayati

original: jarānityate punaḥ pratyutpannād atītaṃ durbalīkṛtya pratighātāt | tadyathā kila gahanapraviṣṭasya puruṣasya trayaḥ śatravaḥ | tata eka enaṃ gahanād ākarṣet, dvaupunar jīvitād vyavaropayetāṃ tadvad iti | sthitis tu tān saṃskārān upaguhya tiṣṭhaty aviyogam ivecchantī | ato 'sau saṃskṛtalakṣaṇaṃ na vyavasthāpitā |
analyzed: jarā nityate punar pratyutpannāt atītam durbalīkṛtya pratighātāt tat yathā kila gahana praviṣṭasya puruṣasya trayaḥ śatravaḥ tatas ekaḥ enam gahanāt ākarṣet dvau punar jīvitāt vyavaropayetām tadvat iti sthitiḥ tu tān saṃskārān upaguhya tiṣṭhati aviyogam iva icchantī saṃskṛta lakṣaṇam na vyavasthāpitā

original: asaṃskṛtasyāpi c a svalakṣaṇe sthitibhāvāt | anye punaḥ kalpayanti sthitiṃ jarāṃ cābhisamasya sthityanyathātvam ity ekaṃ lakṣaṇam uktaṃ sūtre | kiṃ prayojanam | eṣā hy eṣu saṅgāspadam ataḥ śriyam ivaināṃ kālakarṇīsahitāṃ darśayām āsa tasyām anāsaṅgārtham iti | ataś catvāry eva saṃskṛtalakṣaṇāni |
analyzed: asaṃskṛtasya api c a sva lakṣaṇe sthiti bhāvāt anye punar kalpayanti sthitim jarām ca abhisamasya sthiti anyathātvam iti ekam lakṣaṇam uktam sūtre kim prayojanam eṣā hi eṣu saṅga āspadam atas śriyam iva enām kālakarṇī sahitām darśayām āsa tasyām anāsaṅga artham iti atas catvāri eva saṃskṛta lakṣaṇāni

original: teṣām api nāmajātyādīnāṃ saṃskṛtatvād anyair jātyādibhir bhavitavyam | bhavanty eva |
analyzed: teṣām api nāma jāti ādīnām saṃskṛta tvāt anyaiḥ jāti ādibhiḥ bhavitavyam bhavanti eva

original: jātijātyādayas teṣāṃ (46a)
analyzed: jāti jāti ādayaḥ teṣām

original: teṣām api catvāry anulakṣaṇāni bhavanti | jātijātiḥ sthitisthitiḥ jarājarā anityatānityatā iti | nanu caikaikasya caturlakṣaṇī prāpnoti aparyavasānadoṣaś ca | teṣāṃ punar anyajātyādiprasaṅgāt na prāpnoti | yasmāt
analyzed: teṣām api catvāri anulakṣaṇāni bhavanti jāti jātiḥ sthiti sthitiḥ jarā ajarā anitya tā anityatā iti nanu ca ekaikasya catur lakṣaṇī prāpnoti aparyavasāna doṣaḥ ca teṣām punar anya jāti ādi prasaṅgāt na prāpnoti yasmāt

original: te 'ṣṭadharmaikavṛttayaḥ | (46b)
analyzed: te ṣṭa dharma eka vṛttayaḥ

original: teṣāṃ jātyādīnām aṣṭāsu dharmeṣu vṛttih | kim idaṃ vṛttir iti | kāritraṃ puruṣakāraḥ | jātijātyādīnāṃ caikatra dharme | kathaṃ kṛtvā | ātmanā navamo hi dharma utpadyate | sārdhaṃ lakṣaṇānulakṣaṇair aṣṭābhiḥ | tatra jātir ātmānaṃ virahayyānyān aṣṭau dharmān janayati | jātijātiḥ punas tām eva jātim |
analyzed: teṣām jāti ādīnām aṣṭāsu dharmeṣu vṛttiḥ kim idam vṛttiḥ iti kāritram puruṣakāraḥ jāti jāti ādīnām ca ekatra dharme katham kṛtvā ātmanā navamaḥ hi dharmaḥ utpadyate sārdham lakṣaṇa anulakṣaṇaiḥ aṣṭābhiḥ tatra jātiḥ ātmānam virahayya anyān aṣṭau dharmān janayati jāti jātiḥ punar tām eva jātim

original: tadyathā kila kācit kukkuṭī bahūny apatyāni prajāyate kācid alpāni, tadvat | sthitir apy ātmānaṃ varjayitvānyān aṣṭau dharmān sthāpayati, sthitisthitis tu tām eva sthitim | evaṃ jarānityate api yathāyogyaṃ yojye | tasmān na bhavaty anavasthāprasaṅgaḥ | tad etad ākāśaṃ pāṭyata iti sautrāntikāḥ |
analyzed: tat yathā kila kācid kukkuṭī bahūni apatyāni prajāyate kācid alpāni tadvat sthitiḥ api ātmānam varjayitvā anyān aṣṭau dharmān sthāpayati sthiti sthitiḥ tu tām eva sthitim evam jarā nityate api yathāyogyam yojye tasmāt na bhavati anavasthā prasaṅgaḥ tat etat ākāśam pāṭyate iti sautrāntikāḥ

original: na hy ete jātyādayo dharmā dravyataḥ saṃvidyante, yathāabhivyajyante | kiṃ kāraṇam | pramāṇābhāvāt | na hy eṣāṃ dravyato 'stitve kiṃcid api pramāṇam asti pratyakṣam anumānam āptāgamo vā, yathā rūpādīnāṃ dharmānām iti | yat tarhi sūtra uktaṃ saṃskṛtasyotpādo 'pi prajñāyate vyayo 'pi sthityanyathātvam apīti |
analyzed: na hi ete jāti ādayaḥ dharmāḥ dravyataḥ saṃvidyante yathā abhivyajyante kim kāraṇam pramāṇa abhāvāt na hi eṣām dravyataḥ ustitve kiṃcid api pramāṇam asti pratyakṣam anumānam āpta āgamaḥ vā yathā rūpa ādīnām dharmānām iti yat tarhi sūtre uktam saṃskṛtasya utpādaḥ pi prajñāyate vyayaḥ pi sthiti anyathātvam api iti

original: granthajño devānāṃ priyo na tv arthajñaḥ | arthaś ca pratiśaraṇam uktaṃ bhagavatā | kā punar asyārthaḥ | avidyāandhā hi bālāḥ saṃskārapravāham ātmata ātmīyataś cādhimuktā abhiṣvajante |
analyzed: grantha jñaḥ devānām priyaḥ na tu artha jñaḥ arthaḥ ca pratiśaraṇam uktam bhagavatā kā punar asya arthaḥ avidyā andhāḥ hi bālāḥ saṃskāra pravāham ātmataḥ ātmīyataḥ ca adhimuktāḥ abhiṣvajante

original: tasya mithyādhimokṣasya vyāvarttanārthaṃ bhagavāṃs tasya [p.77] saṃskārapravāhasya saṃskṛtatvaṃ pratītyasamutpannatāṃ dyotayitukāma idam āha ''trīṇīmāni saṃskṛtasya saṃskṛtalakṣaṇāni'' | na tu kṣaṇasya | na hi kṣaṇasyotpādādayaḥ prajñāyante | na cāprajñāyamānā ete lakṣaṇaṃ bhavitum arhanti |
analyzed: tasya mithyā adhimokṣasya vyāvarttana artham bhagavān tasya saṃskāra pravāhasya saṃskṛta tvam pratītyasamutpanna tām dyotayitu kāmaḥ idam āha trīṇi imāni saṃskṛtasya saṃskṛta lakṣaṇāni na tu kṣaṇasya na hi kṣaṇasya utpāda ādayaḥ prajñāyante na ca a prajñāyamānāḥ ete lakṣaṇam bhavitum arhanti

original: ata evātra sūtre saṃskṛtasyotpādo 'pi prajñāyata ity uktam | punaḥ saṃskṛtagrahaṇaṃ saṃskṛtatve lakṣaṇānīti yathā vijñāyeta | maivaṃ vijñāyi sasṃskṛtasya vastuno 'stitve lakṣaṇāni jalavalākāvat, sādhvasādhutve vā kanyālakṣaṇavad iti | tatra pravāhasyādir utpādo nivṛttir vyayaḥ | sa eva pravāho 'nuvarttamānaḥ sthitiḥ |
analyzed: atas eva atra sūtre prajñāyate iti uktam punar saṃskṛta grahaṇam saṃskṛta tve lakṣaṇāni iti yathā vijñāyeta mā evam vijñāyi sa sṃskṛtasya vastunaḥ stitve lakṣaṇāni jala valākā vat sādhu asādhu tve vā kanyā lakṣaṇa vat iti tatra pravāhasya ādiḥ utpādaḥ nivṛttiḥ vyayaḥ saḥ eva pravāhaḥ nuvarttamānaḥ sthitiḥ

original: tasya pūrvāparaviśeṣaḥ sthityanyathātvam | evaṃ ca kṛtvoktaṃ viditā eva nandasya kulaputrasya vedanā utpadyante viditā avatiṣṭhante, viditā astaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gacchantīti | āha cātra
analyzed: tasya pūrva apara viśeṣaḥ sthiti anyathātvam evam ca kṛtvā uktam viditāḥ eva nandasya kula putrasya vedanāḥ utpadyante viditāḥ avatiṣṭhante viditāḥ astam parikṣayam paryādānam gacchanti iti āha ca atra

original: jātir ādiḥ prvāhasya, vyayaś cchedaḥ sthitistu saḥ |
analyzed: jātiḥ ādiḥ prvāhasya vyayaḥ chedaḥ sthitiḥ tu saḥ

original: sthityanyathātvaṃ tasyaiva, pūrvāparaviśiṣṭatā ||
analyzed: sthiti anyathātvam tasya eva pūrva apara viśiṣṭa tā

original: jātir apūrvo bhāvaḥ, sthitiḥ prabandho vyayas taducchedaḥ |
analyzed: jātiḥ apūrvaḥ bhāvaḥ sthitiḥ prabandhaḥ vyayaḥ tad ucchedaḥ

original: sthityanyathātvam iṣṭaṃ prabandhapūrvāparaviśeṣa iti |
analyzed: sthiti anyathātvam iṣṭam prabandha pūrva apara viśeṣaḥ iti

original: kṣaṇikasya hi dharmasya, vinā sthityā vyayo bhavet |
analyzed: kṣaṇikasya hi dharmasya vinā sthityā vyayaḥ bhavet

original: na ca vyety eva tenāsya, vṛthā tatparikalpanā ||
analyzed: na ca vyeti eva tena asya vṛthā tad parikalpanā

original: tasmāt pravāha eva sthitiḥ | evaṃ ca kṛtvāyam apy abhidharmanirdeśa upapanno bhavati | sthitiḥ katamā | utpannānāṃ saṃskārāṇām avināśa iti | na hi kṣaṇasyotpannasyāvināśo 'stīti | yad api ca jñānaprasthāna uktam, ekasmiṃś citte ka utpādaḥ | āha | jātiḥ | ko vyayo maraṇam | kiṃ sthityanyathātvaṃ careti | tatrāpi nikāyasabhāgacittaṃ yujyate |
analyzed: tasmāt pravāhaḥ eva sthitiḥ evam ca kṛtvā ayam api abhidharma nirdeśaḥ upapannaḥ bhavati sthitiḥ katamā utpannānām saṃskārāṇām avināśaḥ iti na hi kṣaṇasya utpannasya avināśaḥ sti iti yat api ca jñānaprasthāne uktam ekasmin citte kaḥ utpādaḥ āha jātiḥ kaḥ vyayaḥ maraṇam kim sthiti anyathātvam cara iti tatra api nikāya sabhāga cittam yujyate

original: pratikṣaṇaṃ cāpi saṃskṛtasyaitāni lakṣaṇāni yujyante vināapi dravyāntarakalpanayā | katham iti | pratikṣaṇam abhūtvābhāva utpādaḥ | bhūtvābhāvo vyayaḥ | pūrvasya pūrvasyottararakṣaṇānubandhaḥ ( 21) sthitiḥ | tasyāvisadṛśatvaṃ sthityanyathātvam iti | yadā tarhi sadṛśā utpadyante | na te nirviśeṣā bhavanti | katham idaṃ jñāyate |
analyzed: pratikṣaṇam ca api saṃskṛtasya etāni lakṣaṇāni yujyante vinā api dravya antara kalpanayā katham iti pratikṣaṇam a bhūtvā abhāvaḥ utpādaḥ bhūtvā abhāvaḥ vyayaḥ pūrvasya pūrvasya uttara rakṣaṇa anubandhaḥ sthitiḥ tasya a visadṛśa tvam sthiti anyathātvam iti yadā tarhi sadṛśāḥ utpadyante na te nirviśeṣāḥ bhavanti katham idam jñāyate

original: kṣiptākṣiptabalidurbalakṣiptasya vajrādeś cirāśutarapātakālabhedāt tanmahābhūtānāṃ pariṇāmaviśeṣasiddheḥ | nātibahuviśeṣabhinnās tu saṃskārāḥ saty apy anyathātve sadṛśā eva dṛśyante | antimasya tarhi śabdārciḥkṣaṇasya parinirvāṇakāle ca ṣaḍāyatanasyottarakṣaṇāabhāvāt sthityanyathātvaṃ nāstīty avyāpinī lakṣaṇavyavasthā prāpnoti |
analyzed: kṣipta ākṣipta bali durbala kṣiptasya vajra ādeḥ cira āśutara pāta kāla bhedāt tad mahābhūtānām pariṇāma viśeṣa siddheḥ na ati bahu viśeṣa bhinnāḥ tu saṃskārāḥ sati api anyathātve sadṛśāḥ eva dṛśyante antimasya tarhi śabda arciḥ kṣaṇasya parinirvāṇa kāle ca ṣaṣ āyatanasya uttara kṣaṇa abhāvāt sthiti anyathātvam na asti iti avyāpinī lakṣaṇa vyavasthā prāpnoti

original: na vai saṃskṛtasya sthitir evocyate | [p.78] lakṣaṇam api tu sthityanyathātvam | ato yasyāsti sthitis tasyāvaśyam anyathātvaṃ bhavatīti nāsti lakṣaṇavyavasthābhedaḥ samāsatas tv atra sūtre saṃskṛtasyedaṃ lakṣaṇam iti dyotitaṃ bhagavatā, saṃskṛtaṃ nāma yad bhūtvā bhavati, bhūtvā ca punar na bhavati, yaś cāstya sthitisaṃjñakaḥ prabandhaḥ so 'nyathā
analyzed: na vai saṃskṛtasya sthitiḥ evā ucyate lakṣaṇam api tu sthiti anyathātvam atas yasya asti sthitiḥ tasya avaśyam anyathātvam bhavati iti na asti lakṣaṇa vyavasthā bhedaḥ samāsatas tu atra sūtre saṃskṛtasya idam lakṣaṇam iti dyotitam bhagavatā saṃskṛtam nāma yat bhūtvā bhavati bhūtvā ca punar na bhavati yaḥ sthiti saṃjñakaḥ prabandhaḥ saḥ nyathā

original: cānyathā ca bhavatīti | kim atra dravyāntarair jātyādibhiḥ katham idānīṃ sa eva dharmo lakṣyas tasyaiva lakṣaṇaṃ yokṣyate | kathaṃ tāvan mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇāni mahāpuruṣān nānyāni sāsnālāṅgūlakakudaśaphaviṣāṇādīni ca gotvalakṣaṇāni gor nānyāni kāṭhinyādīni ca pṛthivī dhātvādīnāṃ lakṣaṇāni tebhyo nānyāni |
analyzed: ca anyathā ca bhavati iti kim atra dravya antaraiḥ jāti ādibhiḥ katham idānīm saḥ eva dharmaḥ lakṣyaḥ tasya eva lakṣaṇam yokṣyate katham tāvat mahāpuruṣa lakṣaṇāni mahāpuruṣāt na anyāni sāsnā lāṅgūla kakuda śapha viṣāṇa ādīni ca go tva lakṣaṇāni goḥ na anyāni kāṭhinya ādīni ca pṛthivī dhātu ādīnām lakṣaṇāni tebhyaḥ na anyāni

original: yathā cordhvagamanena dūrād dhūmasya dhūmatvaṃ lakṣyate na ca tat tasmād anyat | sa evātra nyāyaḥ syāt | na ca saṃskṛtānāṃ rūpādīnāṃ tāvat saṃskṛtatvaṃ lakṣyate | gṛhṇātāpi svabhāvaṃ yāvat prāgabhāvo na jñāyate paścāc ca santateś ca viśeṣaḥ | tasmān na tenaiva tallakṣitaṃ bhavati, na ca tebhyo dravyāntarāṇy eva jātyādīni vidyante |
analyzed: yathā ca ūrdhva gamanena dūrāt dhūmasya dhūma tvam lakṣyate na ca tat tasmāt anyat saḥ eva atra nyāyaḥ syāt na ca saṃskṛtānām rūpa ādīnām tāvat saṃskṛta tvam lakṣyate gṛhṇātā api svabhāvam yāvat prāgabhāvaḥ na jñāyate paścāt ca santateḥ ca viśeṣaḥ tasmāt na tena eva tat lakṣitam bhavati na ca tebhyaḥ dravya antarāṇi eva jāti ādīni vidyante

original: athāpi nāma dravyāntarāṇy eva jātyādīni bhaveyuḥ | kim ayuktaṃ syāt | eko dharmaḥ ekasminn eva kāle jātaḥ sthito jīrṇo naṣṭaḥ syād eṣāṃ sahabhūtatvāt | na | kāritrakālabhedāt | anāgatā hi jātiḥ kāritraṃ hi karoti |
analyzed: atha api nāma dravya antarāṇi eva jāti ādīni bhaveyuḥ kim ayuktam syāt ekaḥ dharmaḥ ekasmin eva kāle jātaḥ sthitaḥ jīrṇaḥ naṣṭaḥ syāt eṣām sahabhūta tvāt na kāritra kāla bhedāt anāgatā hi jātiḥ kāritram hi karoti

original: yasmān na jātaṃ janyate janite tu dharme varttamānāḥ kṣityādayaḥ kāritraṃ kurvantīti na yadā jāyate tadā tiṣṭhati jīryate vinaśyate vā | idaṃ tāvad iha saṃpradhāryaṃ bhavet | kim anāgataṃ dravyato 'sti nāstīti paścāj janayati vā na veti sidhyet | saty api tu tasmin jātiḥ kāritraṃ kurvatī katham anāgatā sidhyatīty anāgatalakṣaṇaṃ vaktavyam |
analyzed: yasmāt na jātam janyate janite tu dharme varttamānāḥ kṣiti ādayaḥ kāritram kurvanti iti na yadā jāyate tadā tiṣṭhati jīryate vinaśyate vā idam tāvat iha saṃpradhāryam bhavet kim anāgatam sti na asti iti paścāt janayati vā na veti sidhyet satī api tu tasmin jātiḥ kāritram kurvatī katham anāgatā sidhyati iti anāgata lakṣaṇam vaktavyam

original: uparatakāritrā cotpannā kathaṃ ekakṣaṇa eva dharmasya sthitajīrṇavinaṣṭatāṃ prasañjeyuḥ | yadaiva hy enaṃ sthitiḥ sthāpayati tadaiva jarā jarayati anityatā vināśayatīti | kim ayaṃ tatra kāle tiṣṭhatv āhosvij jīryatu vinaśyatu vā yo 'pi hi brūyāt sthityādīnām api kāritraṃ krameṇeti, tasya kṣaṇikatvaṃ bādhyate |
analyzed: uparata kāritrā ca utpannā katham eka kṣaṇe eva dharmasya sthita jīrṇa vinaṣṭa tām prasañjeyuḥ yadā eva hi enam sthitiḥ sthāpayati tadā eva jarā jarayati anitya tā vināśayati iti kim ayam tatra kāle tiṣṭhatu āhosvit jīryatu vinaśyatu vā hi brūyāt sthiti ādīnām api kāritram krameṇa iti tasya kṣaṇika tvam bādhyate

original: athāpy evaṃ brūyāt eṣa eva hi naḥ kṣaṇo yāvataitat sarvaṃ samāpyata iti | evam api tābhyāṃ sahotpannā sthitis tāvat sthāpayati, na jarā jarayati anityatā vā vināśayatīti, kuta eta | sthiter balīyastvāt | punaḥ kenābalīyastvam | yadaināṃ saha dharmeṇānityatā hanti | kṛtakṛtyā punaḥ karttuṃ notsahate jātivat | sthātur yuktam anutsoḍhum |
analyzed: atha api evam brūyāt eṣaḥ eva hi naḥ kṣaṇaḥ yāvatā etat sarvam samāpyate iti evam api tābhyām saha utpannā sthitiḥ tāvat sthāpayati na jarā jarayati anitya tā vā vināśayati iti kutas eta sthiteḥ balīyaḥ tvāt punar kena a balīyaḥ tvam yadā enām saha dharmeṇa anitya tā hanti kṛtakṛtyā punar karttum na utsahate jāti vat sthātuḥ yuktam an utsoḍhum

original: na hi śakyaṃ jātyādijanyaṃ varttamānatām ānītaṃ punar ānetum | śakyaṃ tu khalu sthityā sthāpyam atyantam api sthāpayitum | ato [p.79] na yuktaṃ notsahate | ko vātra pratibandhaḥ | te eva jarānityate | yadi hi te balīyasyau syātāṃ pūrvam eva sthātām |
analyzed: na hi śakyam jāti ādi janyam varttamāna tām ānītam punar ānetum śakyam tu khalu sthityā sthāpyam atyantam api sthāpayitum atas na yuktam na utsahate kaḥ vā atra pratibandhaḥ te eva jarā nityate yadi hi te balīyasyau syātām pūrvam eva sthātām

original: nivṛttakāritrāyāṃ khalv api sthitau te cāpi na tiṣṭhataḥ, sa cāpi dharma iti kathaṃ kutra vā kāritraṃ karttum utsahiṣyete, kiṃ vā punas tābhyāṃ karttavyam | sthitiparigrahād dhi sa dharma utpannamātro na vyanaśyat | sa tu tayā vyupekṣyamāṇo niyataṃ na sthāsyaty ayam evāsya vināśaḥ |
analyzed: nivṛtta kāritrāyām khalu api sthitau te ca api na tiṣṭhataḥ sa ca api dharmaḥ iti katham kutra vā kāritram karttum utsahiṣyete kim vā punar tābhyām karttavyam sthiti parigrahāt hi sa dharmaḥ utpanna mātraḥ na vyanaśyat sa tu tayā vyupekṣyamāṇaḥ niyatam na sthāsyati ayam eva asya vināśaḥ

original: syāc ca tāvad ekasya dharmasyotpannasyāvināśaḥ sthitiḥ vināśo 'nityatā | jarā tu khalu sarvathātvena na tathā | pūrvāparaviśeṣāt vipariṇāmāc ca | atas tadanyathātve' 'nya eva | uktaṃ hi
analyzed: syāt ca tāvat ekasya dharmasya utpannasya avināśaḥ sthitiḥ vināśaḥ nitya tā jarā tu khalu sarvathātvena na tathā pūrva apara viśeṣāt vipariṇāmāt ca atas tad anyathātve eva uktam hi

original: tathātvena jarāasiddhir anyathātve 'nya eva saḥ |
analyzed: tathātvena jarā asiddhiḥ anyathātve nyaḥ eva saḥ

original: tasmān naikasya bhāvastha, jarā nāmopapadyate |
analyzed: tasmāt na ekasya jarā nāma upapadyate

original: yo 'py āha nikāyāntarīyo, vināśakāraṇaṃ prāpyānityatā vināśayatīti, tasya harītakīṃ prāpya devatā virecayatīty āpannaṃ bhavati, kiṃ punas tāṃ kalpayitvā |
analyzed: yaḥ u pi āha nikāya antarīyaḥ vināśa kāraṇam prāpya anitya tāḥ vināśayati iti tasya harītakīm prāpya devatāḥ virecayati iti āpannam bhavati kim punar tām kalpayitvā

original: tata evāstu vināśakāraṇād vināśaḥ cittacaittānāṃ ca kṣaṇikatvābhyupagamāt tadanityatāyā vināśakāraṇānapekṣatvāt sthity anityate kāritram abhinnakālaṃ kuryātām ity ekasyaikatra kāle sthitavinaṣṭatā saṃprasajyeta | tasmāt pravāhaṃ praty etāni saṃskṛtalakṣaṇāny uktānīty evam etat sūtraṃ sunītaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: tatas eva astu vināśa kāraṇāt vināśaḥ citta caittānām ca kṣaṇika tva abhyupagamāt tad anitya tāyāḥ vināśa kāraṇa anapekṣa tvāt sthitī anitya te kāritram abhinna kālam kuryātām iti ekasya ekatra kāle sthita vinaṣṭa tā saṃprasajyeta tasmāt pravāham prati etāni saṃskṛta lakṣaṇāni uktāni iti evam etat sūtram su nītam bhavati

original: api ca yady anāgatā jātir janyasya janikā kim arthaṃ sarvam anāgataṃ yugapannotpadyate | yasmāt
analyzed: api ca yadi anāgatā jātiḥ janyasya janikā kim artham sarvam anāgatam yugapad na utpadyate yasmāt

original: janyasya janikā jātir na hetupratyayair vinā ||46c'd ||
analyzed: janyasya janikā jātiḥ na hetu pratyayaiḥ vinā

original: na hi vinā hetupratyayasāmagryā jātir janikā bhavati | hetupratyayānām eva tarhi sāmarthyaṃ paśyāmaḥ | sati sāmagrye bhāvād asati cābhāvān na jāter iti hetupratyayā eva janakāḥ santaḥ | kiṃ ca bhoḥ sarvaṃ vidyamānam upalabhyate | sūkṣmā api dharmaprakṛtayaḥ saṃvidyante | jātam ity eva tu na syād asatyāṃ jātau ṣaṣṭīvacanaṃ ca rūpasya saṃyoga iti |
analyzed: na hi vinā hetu pratyaya sāmagryā jātiḥ janikā bhavati hetu pratyayānām eva tarhi sāmarthyam paśyāmaḥ sati sāmagrye bhāvāt asati ca abhāvāt na jāteḥ iti hetu pratyayāḥ eva janakāḥ santaḥ kim ca bhoḥ sarvam vidyamānam upalabhyate sūkṣmāḥ api dharma prakṛtayaḥ saṃvidyante jātam iti eva tu na syāt asatyām jātau ṣaṣṭī vacanam ca rūpasya saṃyogaḥ iti

original: eṣā ca ṣaṣṭhī kathaṃ kalpyate | rūpasya svabhāva iti | tasmāt prajñaptimātram evaitad abhūtvā [p.80] bhāvajñāpanārthaṃ kriyate jātam iti | sa cābhūtvābhāvalakṣaṇa utpādo bahuvikalpaḥ | tasya viśeṣārthaṃ rūpasyotpāda iti ṣaṣṭhīṃ kurvanti yathā rūpasaṃjñaka evotpādaḥ pratīyeta mānyaḥ pratyāyīti |
analyzed: eṣā ca ṣaṣṭhī katham kalpyate rūpasya svabhāvaḥ iti tasmāt prajñapti mātram eva etat a bhūtvā bhāva jñāpana artham kriyate jātam iti sa ca a bhūtvā abhāva lakṣaṇaḥ utpādaḥ bahu vikalpaḥ tasya viśeṣa artham rūpasya utpādaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhīm kurvanti yathā rūpa saṃjñakaḥ eva utpādaḥ pratīyeta mānyaḥ pratyāyī iti

original: tadyathā candanasya gandhādayaḥ śilāputrakasya śarīram iti | evaṃ sthityādayo 'pi yathāyogaṃ veditavyāḥ | yadi jātyā vinā jāyate, kasmād asaṃskṛtam apu ākāśādikaṃ na jāyate |	jāyata ity abhūtvā bhavati | asaṃskṛtaṃ ca nityam astīti na jāyate | yathā ca dharmatayā na sarvaṃ jātimad iṣyate, tathā na sarvaṃ jāyata ity eṣṭavyam |
analyzed: tat yathā candanasya gandha ādayaḥ śilāputrakasya śarīram iti evam sthiti ādayaḥ api yathāyogam veditavyāḥ yadi jātyā vinā jāyate kasmāt asaṃskṛtam ākāśa ādikam na jāyate jāyate iti a bhūtvā bhavati asaṃskṛtam ca nityam asti iti na jāyate yathā ca dharmatayā na sarvam jātimat iṣyate tathā na sarvam jāyate iti eṣṭavyam

original: yathā ca tulye jātimattve tadanye pratyayās tadanyasyotpādane na samarthā bhavanty, evam evāsaṃskṛtasyotpādane sarve 'py asamarthāḥ syuḥ | siddhā eva tu dravyabhāvena jātyādaya iti vaibhāṣikāḥ | na hi dūṣakāḥ santīty āgamā apāsyante na hi mṛgāḥ santīti, yavā nopyante, na hi makṣikāḥ patantīti modakā na bhakṣyante |

original: daśānāṃ mahābhūmikānāṃ catvāriṃśatas talllakṣaṇānām aṣṭānāṃ ca svalakṣaṇānulakṣaṇānām | tasya punaś catuḥjpañcāśad dharmāḥ sahabhūhetuḥ | svāny anulakṣaṇāni sthāpayitvā | caturdaśety apare | daśa mahābhūmiāḥ svāny eva ca lakṣaṇānīti | tad etan narṇayanti | prakaraṇagrantho hy evaṃ virudhyeta |

original: syād duḥkhasatyaṃ satkāyadṛṣṭihetukaṃ na satkāyadṛṣṭer hetuḥ | satkāyadṛṣṭes tatsaṃprayuktānāṃ ca dharmānāṃ jātiṃ jarāṃ sthitim anityatāṃ ca sthāpayitvā yat tadanyat kliṣṭaṃ duḥkhasatyaṃ satkāyadṛṣṭihetukaṃ na satkāyadṛṣṭer hetuḥ | satkāyadṛṣṭeś ca hetur yad etat sthāpitam iti |
analyzed: syāt duḥkha satyam satkāya dṛṣṭi hetukam na satkāya dṛṣṭeḥ hetuḥ satkāya dṛṣṭeḥ tad saṃprayuktānām ca dharmānām jātim jarām sthitim anitya tām ca sthāpayitvā yat tad anyat kliṣṭam duḥkha satyam satkāya dṛṣṭi hetukam na satkāya dṛṣṭeḥ hetuḥ satkāya dṛṣṭeḥ ca hetuḥ yat etat sthāpitam iti

original: ye tarhi tatsaṃprayuktānāṃ ca dharmāṇām ity etan na paṭhanti tair apy etat paṭhitavyam arthato vaivaṃ boddhavyam iti kāśmīrāḥ | yat tāvat sahabhūhetunā hetuḥ sahabhv api tat | syāt tu sahabhūr na sahabhūhetunā hetuḥ | dharmasyānulakṣaṇāni | tāni cānyonyam |
analyzed: ye tarhi tad saṃprayuktānām ca dharmāṇām iti etat na paṭhanti taiḥ api etat paṭhitavyam arthataḥ vā evam boddhavyam iti kāśmīrāḥ yat tāvat sahabhū hetunā hetuḥ sahabhu api tat syāt tu sahabhūḥ na sahabhū hetunā hetuḥ dharmasya anulakṣaṇāni tāni ca anyonyam

original: anuparivarttyanulakṣaṇāni caivaṃ cittasya tāni cānyonyaṃ sapratighaṃ copādāyarūpam anyonyam apratighaṃ ca kiṃcit sarvaṃ ca bhūtaiḥ prāptayaś ca sahajāḥ prāptimataqḥ sahabhuvo na sahabhūhetur anekaphalavipākaniṣyandatvāt | na caitāḥ sahacariṣṇavaḥ pūrvam apy utpatteḥ paścād apīti | sarvam apy etat syāt |
analyzed: anuparivarti anu lakṣaṇāni ca evam cittasya tāni ca anyonyam sa pratigham ca upādāya rūpam anyonyam apratigham ca kiṃcid sarvam ca bhūtaiḥ prāptayaḥ ca sahajāḥ sahabhuvaḥ na sahabhū hetuḥ aneka phala vipāka nisyanda tvāt na ca etāḥ sahacariṣṇavaḥ pūrvam api utpatteḥ paścāt api iti sarvam api etat syāt

original: kiṃ tu prasiddhahetuphalabhāvānāṃ bījādīnām eṣa nyāyo na dṛṣṭa iti vaktavyam etat kathaṃ sahotpannānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ hetuphalab hāva iti | tadyathā pradīpaprabhayor aṅkuracchāyayoś ca | saṃpradhāryaṃ tāvad etat kiṃ prabhāyāḥ pradīpo hetur, āhosvit pūrvotpannaiva sāmagrī saprabhasya pradīpasya sacchāyasyāṅkurasyotpattau hetur iti |
analyzed: kim tu prasiddha hetu phala bhāvānām bīja ādīnām eṣa nyāyaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ iti vaktavyam etat katham saha utpannānām dharmāṇām hāvaḥ iti tat yathā pradīpa prabhayoḥ aṅkura chāyayoḥ ca saṃpradhāryam tāvat etat kim prabhāyāḥ pradīpaḥ hetuḥ āhosvit pūrva utpannā eva sāmagrī sa prabhasya pradīpasya sa chāyasya aṅkurasya utpattau hetuḥ iti

original: itas tarhi bhāvābhāvayos tadvattvāt | etad dhi hetuhetumato lakṣaṇam ācakṣate haitukāḥ | yasya bhāvābhāvayoḥ yasya bhāvābhāvau niyamataḥ sa hetur itaro hetumān iti | sahabhūvāṃ ca dharmaṇām ekasya bhāve sarveṣāṃ bhāva ekasyābhāve [p.85] sarveṣām abhāva iti yukto hetuphalabhāvaḥ | syāt tāvat sahotpannānāṃ parasparaṃ tu katham |
analyzed: itas tarhi bhāva abhāvayoḥ tadvat tvāt etat hi hetu hetumataḥ lakṣaṇam ācakṣate haitukāḥ yasya bhāva abhāvayoḥ yasya bhāva abhāvau niyamataḥ sa hetuḥ itaraḥ hetumān iti ca dharmaṇām ekasya bhāve sarveṣām bhāve ekasya abhāve sarveṣām abhāve iti yuktaḥ hetu phala bhāvaḥ syāt tāvat saha utpannānām parasparam tu katham

original: ata evāha evaṃ tarhy avinirbhāviṇo 'py upādāyarūpasyānyonyam eṣa prasaṅgaḥ bhūtaiś ca sārdhaṃ cittānulakṣaṇādīnāṃ ca cittādibhiḥ | tridaṇḍānyonyabalāvasthānavat tarhi sahabhūvāṃ hetuphalab hāvaḥ sidhyati | mīmāṃsyaṃ tāvad etat |
analyzed: atas eva āha evam tarhi upādāya rūpasya anyonyam eṣa prasaṅgaḥ bhūtaiḥ ca sārdham citta anulakṣaṇa ādīnām ca citta ādibhiḥ tridaṇḍa anyonya bala avasthāna vat tarhi hetu phalam hāvaḥ sidhyati mīmāṃsyam tāvat etat

original: kim eṣāṃ sahotpannabalenāvasthānam, āhosvit pūrvasāmagrīvaśāt tathaivotpāda iti anyad api ca tatra kiṃcid bhavati sūtrakaṃ śaṅkuko vā pṛthivī vā dhārikā | eṣām api nāmānye 'pi sabhāgahetutvādayo bhavantīti siddhaḥ sahabhūhetuḥ |

original: anyeṣu tu samānajātīyeṣu daśāpy avasthā daśānām | bāhyeṣv api yavo yavasya śāliḥ śāler iti vistareṇa yojyam | ye tu rūpaṃ rūpasya necchanti, sabhāgahetuṃ teṣām eṣa granthaḥ icchāvighātāya saṃpravarttate atītāni mahābhūtāny anāgatānāṃ mahābhūtānāṃ hetur adhipatir iti |

original: te 'pi kāmāvacārāḥ kāmāvacarāṇāṃ prathamadhyānabhūmikāḥj prathamadhyānabhūmikānāṃ yāvat bhavāgrabhūmikās tadbhūmikānām eva nānyeṣām | te 'pi na sarve | kiṃ tarhi |

original: pūrvotpannāḥ paścimānām utpannānutpannānāṃ sabhāgahetuḥ | anāgatā naivasabhāgahetuḥ | evam atīte | kuta etat | āha | śāstrāt | sabhāgahetuḥ katamaḥ | pūrvotpannāni kuśalamūlāni paścād utpannānāṃ [p.86] kuśalamūlānāṃ tatsaṃprayuktānāṃ ca dharmāṇāṃ svadhātau sabhāgahetunā hetuḥ | evamatītāny atītapratyutpannānām |
analyzed: pūrva utpannāḥ paścimānām utpanna anutpannānām sa bhāga hetuḥ anāgatāḥ na eva sa bhāga hetuḥ evam atīte kutas etat āha śāstrāt sa bhāga hetuḥ katamaḥ pūrva utpannāni kuśala mūlāni paścāt utpannānām kuśala mūlānām tad saṃprayuktānām ca dharmāṇām sva dhātau sa bhāga hetunā hetuḥ evam atītāni atīta pratyutpannānām

original: atītapratyutpannāny anāgatānām iti vaktavyam | idam api śāstraṃ, ''yo dharmo yasya dharmasya hetuḥ kadācit sa dharmas tasya dharmasya na hetuḥ | āha | na kadācid'' iti | sahabhūsaṃprayuktakavipākahetvabhisandhivacanād adoṣaḥ eṣaḥ |
analyzed: atīta pratyutpannāni anāgatānām iti vaktavyam idam api śāstram yaḥ dharmaḥ yasya dharmasya hetuḥ kadācid sa dharmaḥ tasya dharmasya na hetuḥ āha na kadācid iti saha bhū saṃprayuktaka vipāka hetu abhisandhi vacanāt adoṣaḥ eṣaḥ

original: yas tu manyate anāgato 'pi sa dharma utpadyamānāvasthāyāṃ sabhāgahetutve niyatībhūto bhavaty atas tāṃ caramāvasthām abhisaṃdhāyoktaṃ, na kadācin na hetur iti | tasyāyam aparihāro yasmāt sa dharma utpadyamānāvasthāyāḥ pūrvaṃ sabhāgahetur abhūtvā paścāt bhavati |
analyzed: yaḥ tu manyate anāgataḥ sa dharmaḥ utpadyamāna avasthāyām sa bhāga hetu tve niyatībhūtaḥ bhavati atas tām carama avasthām abhisaṃdhāya uktam na kadācid na hetuḥ iti tasya ayam aparihāraḥ yasmāt sa dharmaḥ utpadyamāna avasthāyāḥ pūrvam sa bhāga hetuḥ a bhūtvā paścāt bhavati

original: ihāpi ca praśne yo dharmo yasya dharmasya samanantaraḥ kadācit sa dharmas tasya dharmasya na samanantara iti śakyam anayā kalpanayā vaktuṃ syān na kadācid iti | kasmād evam āha | yadi sa dharmo notpanno bhavatīti dvimukhasaṃdarśanārthaṃ yathā tatra tathehāpi karttavyam | yathā ceha tathā tatreti |
analyzed: iha api ca praśne yaḥ dharmaḥ yasya dharmasya samanantaraḥ kadācid sa dharmaḥ tasya dharmasya na samanantaraḥ iti śakyam anayā kalpanayā vaktum syāt na kadācid iti kasmāt evam āha yadi sa dharmaḥ na utpannaḥ bhavati iti dvi mukha saṃdarśana artham yathā tatra tathā iha api karttavyam yathā ca iha tathā tatra iti

original: evaṃ sati ko guṇo labhyata ity akauśalam evātra śāstrakārasyaiva saṃbhāvyeta | tasmāt pūrvaka evātra parihāraḥ sādhuḥ |
analyzed: evam sati kaḥ guṇaḥ labhyate iti akauśalam evā atra śāstra kārasya eva saṃbhāvyeta tasmāt pūrvakaḥ evā atra parihāraḥ sādhuḥ

original: yat tarhīdam uktam anāgatānāṃ satkāyadṛṣṭiṃ tatsaṃprayuktaṃ ca duḥkhasatyaṃ thāpayitvā yat tad anyat kliṣṭaṃ tuḥkhasatyaṃ tat satkāyadṛṣṭihetukaṃ na satkāyadṛṣṭer hetur yat tu sthāpitaṃ tat satkāyadṛṣṭihetukaṃ satkāyadṛṣṭeś ca hetur iti |
analyzed: yat tarhi idam uktam anāgatānām satkāyadṛṣṭim tad saṃprayuktam ca duḥkha satyam thāpayitvā yat tat anyat kliṣṭam tuḥkha satyam tat satkāyadṛṣṭi hetukam na satkāyadṛṣṭeḥ hetuḥ yat tu sthāpitam tat satkāyadṛṣṭi hetukam satkāyadṛṣṭeḥ ca hetuḥ iti

original: anāgatasatkāyadṛṣṭisaṃprayuktaṃ duḥkhasatyaṃ sthāpayitvety evam etat karttavyam arthato 'pi caivaṃ boddhavyam iti | idaṃ tarhi prajñaptibhāṣyaṃ kathaṃ nīyate, sarvadharmāś catuṣke niyatā hetau phale āśraye ālambane niyatā iti | hetur atra saṃprayuktakahetuḥ sahabhūhetuś ca | phalaṃ puruṣsakāraphalam adhipatiphalaṃ ca |

analyzed: akuśalāḥ kuśala sa āsravāḥ ca dharmāḥ vipāka hetuḥ vipāka dharma tvāt kasmāt avyākṛtāḥ dharmāḥ vipākam na nirvarttayanti durbala tvāt pūti bīja vat kasmāt na anāsravāḥ tṛṣṇā an abhiṣyandita tvāt an abhsyandita sāra bīja vat apratisaṃyuktāḥ hi kiṃpratisaṃyuktam vipākam abhinirvarttayeyuḥ śeṣāḥ tu ubhayavidha tvāt nirvarttayanti sāra abhsyandita bīja vat

original: katham idaṃ vijñātavyaṃ vipākasya hetur vipākahetur āhosvid vipāka eva hetur vipākahetuḥ | kiṃ cātaḥ | yadi vipākasya hetur vipākahetuḥ, vipākajaṃ cakṣur iti etan na prāpnoti | atha vipāka eva hetur vipākahetuḥ, karmaṇo vipāka ity etan na prāpnoti | naiṣa doṣaḥ | ubhayathāpi yoga ity uktaṃ prāk | atha vipāka iti ko 'rthaḥ |
analyzed: katham idam vijñātavyam vipākasya hetuḥ vipāka hetuḥ āhosvit vipākaḥ eva hetuḥ vipāka hetuḥ kim ca atas yadi vipākasya hetuḥ vipāka hetuḥ vipāka jam cakṣuḥ iti etat na prāpnoti atha vipākaḥ eva hetuḥ vipāka hetuḥ karmaṇaḥ vipākaḥ iti etat na prāpnoti na eṣa doṣaḥ ubhayathā api yogaḥ iti uktam prāk atha vipākaḥ iti kaḥ rthaḥ

original: visadṛśaḥ pāko vipākaḥ | anyeṣāṃ tu [p.90] hetūnāṃ sadṛśaḥ pākaḥ | ekasyobhayatheti vaibhāṣikāḥ | naiva tu teṣāṃ pāko yuktaḥ | pāko hi nāma santatipariṇāmaviśeṣajaḥ phalaparyantaḥ | na ca sahabhūsaṃprayuktaka'hetvoḥ santatipariṇāmaviśeṣajaṃ phalam asti | na cāpi sabhāgahetvādīnāṃ phalaparyanto 'sti | punaḥ punaḥ kuśalādyāsaṃsārphalatvāt |
analyzed: visadṛśaḥ pākaḥ vipākaḥ anyeṣām tu hetūnām sadṛśaḥ pākaḥ ekasya ubhayathā iti vaibhāṣikāḥ na eva tu teṣām pākaḥ yuktaḥ pākaḥ hi nāma santati pariṇāma viśeṣa jaḥ phala paryantaḥ na ca saha bhū saṃprayuktaka hetvoḥ santati pariṇāma viśeṣa jam phalam asti na ca api sa bhāga hetu ādīnām phala paryantaḥ sti punar punar kuśala ādi āsaṃsārphalatvāt

original: kāmadhātāv ekaskandhako vipākahetur ekaphalaḥ pratyayas tajjātyādayaś ca | dviskandhaka ekaphalaḥ kāyavākkarma tajjātyādayaś ca | catuḥ'skandhaka ekaphalaḥ prathame dhyāne vijñaptiḥ saha jātyādibhh | catuḥskandhaka ekaphalaḥ kuśale cetasy asamāhite | pañcaskandhaka ekaphalaḥ samāhite ||
analyzed: kāmadhātau eka skandhakaḥ vipāka hetuḥ eka phalaḥ pratyayaḥ tad jāti ādayaḥ ca dvi skandhakaḥ eka phalaḥ kāya vāc karma tad jāti ādayaḥ ca catur skandhakaḥ eka phalaḥ prathame dhyāne vijñaptiḥ saha jāti ādibhiḥ catur skandhakaḥ eka phalaḥ kuśale cetasi asamāhite pañca skandhakaḥ eka phalaḥ samāhite

original: ārūpyadhātāv ekaskandhako vipākahetur ekaphalaḥ prāptir nirodhasamāpattiś ca saha jātyādibhiḥ | catuḥskandhakaḥ kuśalāś cittacaittāḥ tajjātyādayaś ca | asti karma yasyaikam eva dharmāyatanaṃ vipāko vipacyate, yasya jīvitendriyam | yasya manāyatanaṃ, tasya dve manodharmāyatane |
analyzed: ārūpya dhātau eka skandhakaḥ vipāka hetuḥ eka phalaḥ prāptiḥ nirodha samāpattiḥ ca saha jāti ādibhiḥ catur skandhakaḥ kuśalāḥ citta caittāḥ tad jāti ādayaḥ ca asti karma yasya ekam eva dharma āyatanam vipākaḥ vipacyate yasya jīvita indriyam yasya manāyatanam tasya dve manaḥ dharma āyatane

original: evaṃ yasya spraṣṭavyāyatanaṃ yasya kāyāayatanaṃ, tasya trīṇi kāyaspraṣṭavyadharmāyatanāni | evaṃ yasya rūpagandharasāyatanāni | yasya cakṣurāyatanaṃ tasya catvāri cakṣuḥkāyaspraṣṭavyadharmāyatanāni | evaṃ yasya śrotraghrāṇajihvāayatanāni | asti tat karma yasya pañca ṣaṭ saptāṣṭau nava daśaikādaśāyatanāni vipāko vipacyate |
analyzed: evam yasya spraṣṭavya āyatanam yasya kāya āyatanam tasya trīṇi kāya spraṣṭavya dharma āyatanāni evam yasya rūpa gandha rasa āyatanāni yasya cakṣuḥ āyatanam tasya catvāri cakṣuḥ kāya spraṣṭavya dharma āyatanāni evam yasya śrotra ghrāṇa jihvā ayatanāni asti tat karma yasya pañca ṣaḍ sapta aṣṭau nava daśa ekādaśa āyatanāni vipākaḥ vipacyate

original: vicitrāvicitraphalatvāt karmaṇo bāhyabījavat | tadyathā bāhyāni bījāni kācid vicitraphalāni bhavanti | tadyathā padmadāḍimanyagrodhādīnām | kācid avicitraphalāni | tadyathā yavagodhūmādīnām | ekādhivikasya karmaṇas traiyadhviko vipāko vipacyate |
analyzed: vicitra a vicitra phala tvāt karmaṇaḥ bāhya bīja vat tat yathā bāhyāni bījāni kācid vicitra phalāni bhavanti tat yathā padma dāḍima nyagrodha ādīnām kācid a vicitra phalāni tat yathā yava godhūma ādīnām eka adhivikasya karmaṇaḥ traiyadhvikaḥ vipākaḥ vipacyate

original: na tu dvaiyadhvikasyāpy ekādhiviko mā bhūd atinyūnaṃ hetoḥ nāpy anantaraṃ samanantarapratyayākṛṣṭatvāt samanantarakṣaṇasya | pravāhāpekṣo hi vipākahetuḥ |
analyzed: na tu dvaiyadhvikasya api mā bhūt ati nyūnam hetoḥ na api anantaram samanantara pratyaya ākṛṣṭa tvāt samanantara kṣaṇasya pravāha apekṣaḥ hi vipāka hetuḥ

original: atha ka eṣāṃ hetūnām adhvaniyamaḥ | ukta eṣām arthato 'dhvaniyamaḥ, na tu sūtrita ity ataḥ sūtryate,
analyzed: atha kaḥ eṣām hetūnām adhva niyamaḥ uktaḥ eṣām arthataḥ dhva niyamaḥ na tu sūtritaḥ iti atas sūtryate

original: sarvatragaḥ sabhāgaśca dvyadhvagau (55ab)
analyzed: sarvatragaḥ sabhāgaḥ ca dvi adhvagau

original: atītapratyutpannāv eva anāgatau na staḥ | uktaṃ cātra kāraṇam,
analyzed: atīta pratyutpannau eva anāgatau na staḥ uktam ca atra kāraṇam

original: tryadhvagās trayaḥ | (55b')

original: phalaṃ dharmāḥ | katame | saṃskṛtā dharmāḥ pratisaṃkhyānirodhaś ceti śāstram | evaṃ tarhi phalatvād asaṃkṛtasya hetunā bhavitavyaṃ, yasya tat phalaṃ, hetutvāc ca phalena bhavitavyaṃ yasya tad dhetuḥ | saṃskṛtasyaiva dharmasya hetuphale bhavataḥ |
analyzed: phalam dharmāḥ katame saṃskṛtāḥ dharmāḥ pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ ca iti śāstram evam tarhi phala tvāt asaṃkṛtasya hetunā bhavitavyam yasya tat phalam hetu tvāt ca phalena bhavitavyam yasya tat hetuḥ saṃskṛtasya eva dharmasya hetu phale bhavataḥ

original: nāsaṃskṛtasya te ||55d ||
analyzed: na a saṃskṛtasya te

original: kiṃ kāraṇam | ṣaḍvidhahetvasaṃbhavāt pañcavidhaphalāsaṃbhavāc ca | kasmāt mārgo visaṃyogasya kāraṇahetur neṣyate | yasmāt sa utpādāvighnabhāvena vyavasthāpito na cāsaṃskṛtam utpattimat | kasyedānīṃ tat phalaṃ kathaṃ vā mārgasya phalam | tadbalena prāpteḥ | prāptir eva tarhi mārgasya phalaṃ prāpnoti | ytasyām eva tasya sāmarthyān na visaṃyogaḥ |
analyzed: kim kāraṇam ṣaḍvidha hetu asaṃbhavāt pañcavidha phala asaṃbhavāt ca kasmāt mārgaḥ visaṃyogasya kāraṇa hetuḥ na iṣyate yasmāt saḥ utpāda avighna bhāvena vyavasthāpitaḥ na ca asaṃskṛtam utpattimat kasya idānīm tat phalam katham vā mārgasya phalam tad balena prāpteḥ prāptiḥ eva tarhi mārgasya phalam prāpnoti eva tasya sāmarthyāt na visaṃyogaḥ

original: anyathā hy asya prāptau sāmarthyam anyathā visaṃyhoge | katham asya prāptau sāmarthyam | utpādanāt | kathaṃ visaṃyoge | prāpaṇāt | tasmān na tāvad asya mārgaḥ kathaṃcid api hetuḥ | phalaṃ cāsya visaṃyogaḥ | athāsaty adhipatiphale katham asaṃskṛtaṃ kāraṇahetuḥ | utpattyanāvaraṇabhāvena kāraṇahetuḥ |
analyzed: anyathā hi asya prāptau sāmarthyam anyathā visaṃyhoge katham asya prāptau sāmarthyam utpādanāt katham visaṃyoge prāpaṇāt tasmāt na tāvat asya mārgaḥ kathaṃcid api hetuḥ phalam ca asya visaṃyogaḥ atha asati adhipati phale katham asaṃskṛtam kāraṇa hetuḥ utpatti anāvaraṇa bhāvena kāraṇa hetuḥ

original: na cāsya phalam asty adhvavinirmuktasya phalapratigrahaṇadānāsamarthatvāt | naiva hi kvacid asaṃskṛtaṃ bhagavatā hetur ity uktam | uktaṃ tu paryāyeṇa hetur iti sautrāntikāḥ | katham uktam |
analyzed: na ca asya phalam asti adhva vinirmuktasya phala pratigrahaṇa dāna asamartha tvāt na eva hi kvacid asaṃskṛtam bhagavatā hetuḥ iti uktam uktam tu paryāyeṇa hetuḥ iti sautrāntikāḥ katham uktam

original: ye hetavo ye pratyayā rūpasyotpādāya te 'py anityāḥ |
analyzed: ye hetavaḥ ye pratyayāḥ rūpasya utpādāya te pi anityāḥ

original: anityān khalu hetupratyayān pratītyotpannaṃ rūpaṃ kuto nityaṃ bhaviṣyati
analyzed: anityān khalu hetu pratyayān pratītya utpannam rūpam kutas nityam bhaviṣyati

original: evaṃ tāvad dhi vijñānam iti | evaṃ tarhi vijñānasyālambanapratyayo 'py asaṃskṛtaṃ na prāpnoti | utpādāyety avadhāraṇāt | prāpnoti |
analyzed: evam tāvat hi vijñānam iti evam tarhi vijñānasya ālambana pratyayaḥ a saṃskṛtam na prāpnoti utpādāya iti avadhāraṇāt prāpnoti

original: ye hetavo ye pratyayyā vijñānasyotpādāya te 'py anityāḥ
analyzed: ye hetavaḥ ye pratyayyāḥ vijñānasya utpādāya te pi anityāḥ

original: ity uktaṃ na tūktaṃ ye vijñānasya pratyayāḥ te 'py anityā iti | nanu ca hetavo 'pi ya utpādāya ta evānityā iti vacanād asaṣmskṛtasyānāvaraṇabhāvamātreṇa kāraṇahetutvāpratiṣedhaḥ | ukta ālambanapratyayaḥ sūtre na tv anāvaraṇahetur iti na sūtre sidhyaty asaṃskṛtasya hetubhāvaḥ | yady api nokto na tu pratiṣiddhaḥ |
analyzed: iti uktam na tu uktam ye vijñānasya pratyayāḥ te pi anityāḥ iti nanu ca hetavaḥ ye utpādāya te eva anityāḥ iti vacanāt asaṣmskṛtasya anāvaraṇa bhāva mātreṇa kāraṇa hetu tva apratiṣedhaḥ uktaḥ ālambana pratyayaḥ sūtre na tu anāvaraṇa hetuḥ iti na sūtre sidhyati asaṃskṛtasya hetu bhāvaḥ yadi api na uktaḥ na tu pratiṣiddhaḥ

original: sūtrāṇi ca bahūny antarhitānīti katham etan nirdhāryate, nokta iti |
analyzed: sūtrāṇi ca bahūni antarhitāni iti katham etat nirdhāryate na uktaḥ iti

original: atha ko 'yaṃ visaṃyogo nāma | nanu coktaṃ prāk, pratisaṃkhyānirodha iti | tadānīṃ pratisaṃkhyānirodhaḥ katamo, yo visaṃyoga ity uktam, idānīṃ visaṃyogaḥ katamaḥ | yaḥ [p.92] pratisaṃkhyānirodha ity ucyate | tad idam itaretarāśrayaṃ vyākhyānam asamarthaṃ tatsvabhāvadyotane |
analyzed: atha kaḥ yam visaṃyogaḥ nāma nanu ca uktam prāk pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ iti tadānīm pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ katamaḥ yaḥ visaṃyogaḥ iti uktam idānīm visaṃyogaḥ katamaḥ yaḥ pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ iti ucyate tat idam itaretara āśrayam vyākhyānam asamartham tad svabhāva dyotane

original: tasmād anyathā tatsvabhāvo vaktavyaḥ |āryair evatatsvabhāvaḥ pratyātmavedyaḥ | etāvat tu śakyate vaktuṃ nityaṃ kuśalaṃ cāsti dravyāntaram | tadvisaṃyogaś cocyate pratisaṃkhānirodhaś ceti | sarvam evāsaṃskṛtam adravyam iti sautrāntikāḥ | na hi tad rūpavedanādivat bhāvāntaram asti | kiṃ tarhi | spraṣṭavyābhāvamātram ākāśam |
analyzed: tasmāt anyathā tad svabhāvaḥ vaktavyaḥ āryaiḥ eva tad svabhāvaḥ pratyātma vedyaḥ etāvat tu śakyate vaktum nityam kuśalam ca asti dravya antaram tad visaṃyogaḥ ca ucyate pratisaṃkhā nirodhaḥ ca iti sarvam eva asaṃskṛtam adravyam iti sautrāntikāḥ na hi tat rūpa vedanā ādi vat bhāva antaram asti kim tarhi spraṣṭavya abhāva mātram ākāśam

original: tadyathā hy andhakāre pratighātam avindanta ākāśam ity āhuḥ | utpannānuśayajanmanirodhaḥ pratisaṃkhyābalenānyasyānutpādaḥ pratisaṃkhyānirodhaḥ | vinaiva pratisaṃkhyayā pratyayavaikalyād anutpādo yaḥ so 'pratisaṃkhyānirodhaḥ | tadyathā nikāyasabhāgaśeṣasyāntarāmaraṇe |
analyzed: tat yathā hi andhakāre pratighātam avindantaḥ ākāśam iti āhuḥ utpanna anuśaya janma nirodhaḥ pratisaṃkhyā balena anyasya anutpādaḥ pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ vinā eva pratisaṃkhyayā pratyaya vaikalyāt anutpādaḥ yaḥ saḥ pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ tat yathā nikāya sa bhāga śeṣasya antarā maraṇe

original: nikāyāntarīyāḥ punar āhuḥ |anuśayānām anutpattau prajñāyāḥ sāmarthyam ato 'sau pratisaṃkhyānirodhaḥ | yas tu punaḥ duḥkhasyānutpādaḥ sa utpādakāraṇānuśayavaikalyād eveti na tasmin prajñāyāḥ sāmarthyam asty ato 'sāv apratisaṃkhyā nirodha iti | so 'pi tu nāntareṇa pratisaṃkhyāṃ sidhyatīti pratisaṃkhyānirodha evāsau |
analyzed: nikāya antarīyāḥ punar āhuḥ anuśayānām anutpattau prajñāyāḥ sāmarthyam atas sau pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ yaḥ tu punar duḥkhasya anutpādaḥ saḥ utpāda kāraṇa anuśaya vaikalyāt eva iti na tasmin prajñāyāḥ sāmarthyam asti atas sau apratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ iti tu na antareṇa pratisaṃkhyām sidhyati iti pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ eva asau

original: ya evotpannasya paścādabhāvaḥ sa eva svarasanirodhād apratisaṃkhyānirodha ity apare | asyāṃ tu kalpanāyām anityo 'pratisaṃkhyānirodhaḥ prāpnoty avinaṣṭe tadabhāvāt | nanu ca pratisaṃkhyānirodho 'py anityaḥ prāpnoti | pratisaṃkhyāpūrvakatvāt | na vai sa pratisaṃkhyāpūrvako na hi pūrvaṃ pratisaṃkhyā paścād anutpannānām anutpādaḥ | akiṃ tarhi |
analyzed: yaḥ eva utpannasya paścāt abhāvaḥ saḥ eva sva rasa nirodhāt apratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ iti apare asyām tu kalpanāyām pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ prāpnoti a vinaṣṭe tad abhāvāt nanu ca pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ pi anityaḥ prāpnoti pratisaṃkhyā pūrvaka tvāt na vai sa pratisaṃkhyā pūrvakaḥ na hi pūrvam pratisaṃkhyā paścāt anutpannānām anutpādaḥ akim tarhi

original: pūrvam eva sa teṣām anutpādo 'sti | vinā tu pratisaṃkhyayā ye dharmā utpatsyante, tadutpannāyāṃ pratisaṃkhyāyāṃ unar nopapadyanta iti | etad atra pratisaṃkhyāḥ sāmarthyaṃ yad utākṛtotpattipratibandhānām utpattipratibandhabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: pūrvam eva sa teṣām anutpādaḥ sti vinā tu pratisaṃkhyayā ye dharmāḥ utpatsyante tad utpannāyām pratisaṃkhyāyām unar na upapadyante iti etat atra pratisaṃkhyāḥ sāmarthyam yat uta akṛta utpatti pratibandhānām utpatti pratibandha bhāvaḥ

original: yadi tarhi anutpāda eva nirvāṇam idaṃ sūtrapadaṃ kathaṃ nīyate, pañcemānīndriyāṇi āsevitāni bhāvitāni bahulīkṛtāny atītānāgataprtyutpannasya duḥkhasya prahāṇāya saṃvarttanta iti | prahāṇaṃ hi nirvāṇam anāgatasyaiva cānutpādo nātītapratyutpannasyeti | asty etad evam |
analyzed: yadi tarhi anutpādaḥ eva nirvāṇam idam sūtra padam katham nīyate pañca imāni indriyāṇi āsevitāni bhāvitāni bahulīkṛtāni atīta anāgata prtyutpannasya duḥkhasya prahāṇāya saṃvarttante iti prahāṇam hi nirvāṇam anāgatasya eva ca anutpādaḥ na atīta pratyutpannasya iti asti etat evam

original: kiṃ tu tadālambanakleśaprahāṇāt duḥkhasya prahāṇam uktaṃ bhagavatā, yo rūpe cchandarāgas taṃ prajahīta | cchandarāge prahīṇe evaṃ vas tadrūpaṃ prahīṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, parijñātaṃ vistareṇa yāvad vijñānam iti | evaṃ traiyadhivikasyāpi duḥkhasya prahāṇaṃ yujyate | athāpy atītānāgatapratyutpannasya kleśasya prahāṇāyety ucyeta | atrāpy eṣa nayaḥ |
analyzed: kim tu tad ālambana kleśa prahāṇāt duḥkhasya prahāṇam uktam bhagavatā yaḥ rūpe chanda rāgaḥ tam prajahīta chanda rāge prahīṇe evam vaḥ tat rūpam prahīṇam bhaviṣyati parijñātam vistareṇa yāvat vijñānam iti evam traiyadhivikasya api duḥkhasya prahāṇam yujyate atha api atīta anāgata pratyutpannasya kleśasya prahāṇāya iti ucyeta atra api eṣa nayaḥ

original: athavā 'yam abhiprāyo bhaved atītaḥ kleśaḥ paurvajanmikaḥ pratyutpannaḥ kleśa aihajanmiko yathā tṛṣṇāvicariteṣv aṣṭādaśa tṛṣṇāvicaritāny atītam adhvānam upādāyety atītaṃ janmādhikṛtyoktam evaṃ yāvat pratyutpannam | tgena ca kleśadvayenāsyāṃ santatau bījabhāva [p.93] āhito 'nāgatasyotpattaye | tasya prahāṇāt tad api prahīṇaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: athavā yam abhiprāyaḥ bhavet atītaḥ kleśaḥ paurvajanmikaḥ pratyutpannaḥ kleśaḥ aihajanmikaḥ yathā tṛṣṇā vicariteṣu aṣṭādaśa tṛṣṇā vicaritāni atītam adhvānam upādāya iti atītam janma adhikṛtya uktam evam yāvat pratyutpannam ca kleśa dvayena asyām santatau bīja bhāvaḥ āhitaḥ na agatasya utpattaye tasya prahāṇāt tat api prahīṇam bhavati

original: yathā vipākakṣayāt karma kṣīṇaṃ bhavati | anāgatasya punar duḥkhasya kleśasya vā bījābhāvāt atyantam anutpādaḥ prahāṇam | anyathā hy atītapratyutpannasya kiṃ prahātavyam | na hi niruddhe nirodhābhimukhe ca yatnaḥ sārthako bhavatgīti |
analyzed: yathā vipāka kṣayāt karma kṣīṇam bhavati anāgatasya punar duḥkhasya kleśasya vā bīja abhāvāt atyantam anutpādaḥ prahāṇam anyathā hi atīta pratyutpannasya kim prahātavyam na hi niruddhe nirodha abhimukhe ca yatnaḥ sārthakaḥ bhavatgīti

original: yady asaṃskṛtaṃ nāsty eva, yad uktaṃ bhagavatā, ye kecid dharmāḥ saṃskṛtā vāsaṃskṛtā vā virāgas teṣāṃ agra ākhyāta' iti katham asatām asann agro bhavitum arhati | na vai nāsty evāsasṃskṛtam iti brūmaḥ | etat tu tad īdṛśaṃ yathāsmābhir uktam | tadyathā asti śabdasya prāgabhāvo 'sti paścād abhāva ity ucyate | atha ca punar nābhāvo bhāvaḥ sidhyati |
analyzed: yadi asaṃskṛtam na asti eva yat uktam bhagavatā ye kecid dharmāḥ saṃskṛtāḥ vā asaṃskṛtāḥ vā virāgaḥ teṣām agre ākhyātaḥ iti katham asatām asan agraḥ bhavitum arhati na vai na asti eva a saṃskṛtam iti brūmaḥ etat tu tat īdṛśam yathā asmābhiḥ uktam tat yathā asti śabdasya prāgabhāvaḥ sti paścāt abhāvaḥ iti ucyate atha ca punar na abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ sidhyati

original: evam asaṃskṛtam api draṣṭavyam | abhāvo 'pi ca kaścit praśasyatamo bhavati, yaḥ sakalasyopadravasyātyantam abhāva ity anyeṣāṃ so 'gra iti praśaṃsāṃ labdhum arhati | vineyānāṃ tasminn upacchandanārtham | yady apy asaṃskṛtam abhāvamātraṃ syān nirodha āryasatyaṃ na syāt | na hi tat kiṃcid astīti | kas tāvad ayaṃ satyārthaḥ | nanu cāviparītārthaḥ |
analyzed: evam asaṃskṛtam api draṣṭavyam ca kaścid praśasyatamaḥ bhavati yaḥ sakalasya upadravasya atyantam abhāvaḥ iti anyeṣām saḥ gre iti praśaṃsām labdhum arhati vineyānām tasmin upacchandana artham yadi api asaṃskṛtam abhāva mātram syāt nirodhaḥ ārya satyam na syāt na hi tat kiṃcid asti iti kaḥ tāvat ayam satya arthaḥ nanu ca aviparīta arthaḥ

original: ubhayam api caitad aviparītaṃ dṛṣṭam āryair yad uta duḥkhaṃ ca duḥkham eveti duḥkhābhāvaś cābhāva eveti ko 'syāryasatyatve nirodhaḥ katham abhāvaś ca nāma tṛṭīyaṃ cāryasatyaṃ syāt | uktaṃ yathāryasatyaṃ dvitīyasyānantaraṃ dṛṣṭam uddiṣṭaṃ ceti tṛtīyaṃ bhavati | yady asaṃskṛtam abhāvamātraṃ syād ākāśanirvāṇālambanavijñānam asadālambanaṃ syāt |
analyzed: ubhayam api ca etat aviparītam dṛṣṭam āryaiḥ yat uta duḥkham ca duḥkham eva iti duḥkha abhāvaḥ ca abhāvaḥ eva iti kaḥ sya ārya satya tve nirodhaḥ katham abhāvaḥ ca nāma tṛṭīyam ca ārya satyam syāt uktam yathā ārya satyam dvitīyasya anantaram dṛṣṭam uddiṣṭam ca iti tṛtīyam bhavati yadi asaṃskṛtam abhāva mātram syāt ākāśa nirvāṇa ālambana vijñānam asat ālambanam syāt

original: etad atītānāgatasyāstitvacintāyāṃ cintayiṣyāmaḥ | yadi punar dravyam evāsaṃskṛtam iṣyeta, kiṃ syāt | kiṃ ca punaḥ syāt vaibhāṣikapakṣaḥ pālitaḥ syāt | devatā enaṃ pālayiṣyanti, pālanīyaṃ cet maṃsyate | abhūtaṃ tu parikalpitaṃ syāt | kiṃ kāraṇam | na hi tasya rūpavedanādivat svabhāva upalabhyate, na cāpi cakṣurādivat karma |
analyzed: etat atīta anāgatasya astitva cintāyām cintayiṣyāmaḥ yadi punar dravyam eva asaṃskṛtam iṣyeta kim syāt kim ca punar syāt vaibhāṣika pakṣaḥ pālitaḥ syāt devatāḥ enam pālayiṣyanti pālanīyam ced maṃsyate abhūtam tu parikalpitam syāt kim kāraṇam na hi tasya rūpa vedanā ādi vat svabhāvaḥ upalabhyate na ca api cakṣuḥ ādi vat karma

original: amuṣya ca vastuno 'yaṃ nirodha iti ṣaṣṭhīvyavasthā kathaṃ prakalpyate | na hi tasya tena sārdhaṃ kaścit saṃbandho hetuphalādibhāvāsaṃbhavāt | pratiṣedhamātraṃ tu yujyate amuṣyābhāva iti | bhāvāntaratve 'pi yasya kleśasya prāptivicchedād yo nirodhaḥ prāpyate, sa taseyeti vyavadiśyate | tasya tarhi prāptiniyame ko hetuḥ |
analyzed: amuṣya ca vastunaḥ yam nirodhaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī vyavasthā katham prakalpyate na hi tasya tena sārdham kaścid saṃbandhaḥ hetu phala ādi bhāva asaṃbhavāt pratiṣedha mātram tu yujyate amuṣya abhāvaḥ iti bhāva antara tve pi yasya kleśasya prāpti vicchedāt yaḥ nirodhaḥ prāpyate sa vyavadiśyate tasya tarhi prāpti niyame kaḥ hetuḥ

original: dṛṣṭadharmanirvāṇaprāpto bhikṣur ity uktaṃ sūtre | tatra katham abhāvasya prāptiḥ syāt | pratipakṣalābhena kleśapunarbhavotpādātyantaviruddhāśrayalābhāt prāptaṃ nirvāṇam ity ucyate | āgamaś cāpy abhāvamātraṃ dyotayati | evaṃ hy āha |
analyzed: dṛṣṭadharma nirvāṇa prāptaḥ bhikṣuḥ iti uktam sūtre tatra katham abhāvasya prāptiḥ syāt pratipakṣa lābhena kleśa punarbhava utpāda atyanta viruddha āśraya lābhāt prāptam nirvāṇam iti ucyate āgamaḥ ca api abhāva mātram dyotayati evam hi āha

original: yat khalv asya (Pradhan:svalpasya) duḥkhasyāśeṣaprahāṇaṃ pratiniḥsargo vyaṅgībhāvaḥ kṣayo virāgo nirodho vyupaśamo 'staṃgamaḥ anyasya ca duḥkhasyāprati[p.94]sandhir anutpādo 'prādurbhāvaḥ | etat kāntam etat praṇītaṃ yad uta sarvopādhipratiniḥsargas tṛṣṇākṣayo virāgo nirodho nirvāṇam iti |
analyzed: yat khalu asya duḥkhasya aśeṣa prahāṇam pratiniḥsargaḥ vyaṅgībhāvaḥ kṣayaḥ virāgaḥ nirodhaḥ vyupaśamaḥ staṃgamaḥ anyasya ca duḥkhasya a pratipasandhiḥ anutpādaḥ prādurbhāvaḥ etat kāntam etat praṇītam yat uta sarva upādhi pratiniḥsargaḥ tṛṣṇā kṣayaḥ virāgaḥ nirodhaḥ nirvāṇam iti

original: kim evaṃ neṣyate nāsmin prādurb havatīty ato 'prādurbhāva iti | asamarthām etāṃ saptamīṃ paśsyāmaḥ | kim uktaṃ bhavati | nāsmin prādurbhavatīti yadi satīty abhisaṃbadhyate, nityam evāprādurbhāvaprasaṅgo nirvāṇasya nityatvāt |
analyzed: kim evam neṣyate na asmin prādur havati iti atas prādurbhāvaḥ iti asamarthām etām saptamīm paśsyāmaḥ kim uktam bhavati na asmin prādurbhavati iti yadi sati iti abhisaṃbadhyate nityam eva a prādurbhāva prasaṅgaḥ nirvāṇasya nitya tvāt

original: atha prāpta ity abhisaṃbadhyate, yata eva tatprāptiḥ parikalpyate, tasminn eva saṃmukhībhūte prāpte vā duḥkhasyeṣyatām aprādurbhāvaḥ | ayaṃ ca dṛṣṭānta evaṃ sūpanīto bhavati |
analyzed: atha prāptaḥ iti abhisaṃbadhyate yatas eva tad prāptiḥ parikalpyate tasmin eva saṃmukhībhūte prāpte vā duḥkhasya iṣyatām aprādurbhāvaḥ ayam ca dṛṣṭāntaḥ evam su upanītaḥ bhavati

original: pradyotasyeva nirvāṇaṃ vimokṣas tasya cetasa iti |
analyzed: pradyotasya iva nirvāṇam vimokṣaḥ tasya cetasaḥ iti

original: yathā pradyotasya nirvāṇam abhāva, evaṃ bhagavato 'pi cetaso vimokṣa iti | abhidharme 'pi coktam, avastukā dharmāḥ katame | asaṃskṛtā dharmā iti | avastukā aśarīrā asvabhāvā ity uktaṃ bhavati | nāstyāyam arthaḥ | kas tarhi | pañcavidhaṃ (Pradhan: pañcavidha) vastu | svabhāvavastu yathoktaṃ, yad vastu pratilabdhaṃ samanvāgataḥ, sa tena vastuneti |
analyzed: yathā pradyotasya nirvāṇam abhāvaḥ evam cetasaḥ vimokṣaḥ iti abhidharme ca uktam avastukāḥ dharmāḥ katame a saṃskṛtāḥ dharmāḥ iti avastukāḥ aśarīrāḥ asvabhāvāḥ iti uktam bhavati na asti ayam arthaḥ kaḥ tarhi vastu svabhāva vastu yathā uktam yat vastu pratilabdham samanvāgataḥ sa tena vastunā iti

original: ālambanavastu | yathoktaṃ, sarvadharmajñeyā jñānena yathāvastv iti | saṃyogavastu | yathoktaṃ, yasmin vastuni anunayaḥ saṃyojanena saṃprayuktaḥ pratighagsaṃyojanenāpi tasminn iti | hetuvastu yathoktaṃ, savastukā dharmāḥ katame | saṃskṛtā dharmā iti | parigrahavastu | yathoktaṃ, kṣetravastu gṛhavastv iti |
analyzed: ālambana vastu yathā uktam sarva dharma jñeyāḥ jñānena yathāvastu iti saṃyoga vastu yathā uktam yasmin vastuni anunayaḥ saṃyojanena saṃprayuktaḥ tasmin iti hetu vastu yathā uktam sa vastukāḥ dharmāḥ katame saṃskṛtāḥ dharmāḥ iti parigraha vastu yathā uktam kṣetra vastu gṛha vastu iti

original: tad atra hetur vastuśabdenoktas tasmād asty evāsaṃskṛtaṃ dravyata iti vaibhāṣikāḥ | tasya tu hetuphale na vidyete iti | gataṃ tāvad etat |
analyzed: tat atra hetuḥ vastu śabdena uktaḥ tasmāt asti eva asaṃskṛtam dravyataḥ iti vaibhāṣikāḥ tasya tu hetu phale na vidyete iti gatam tāvat etat

original: athaiṣāṃ phalānāṃ katamat phalaṃ kasya hetoḥ |
analyzed: atha eṣām phalānām katamat phalam kasya hetoḥ

original: vipākaphalam antyasya (56a)
analyzed: vipāka phalam antyasya

original: vipākahetur antye 'bhihitatvāt antyaḥ | tasya vipākaphalam |
analyzed: vipāka hetuḥ antye bhihita tvāt antyaḥ tasya vipāka phalam

original: pūrvasyādhipataṃ phalam | (56b)
analyzed: pūrvasya ādhipatam phalam

original: kāraṇahetuḥ pūrvam uktatvāt pūrvaḥ | tasyādhipajaṃ phalam | anāvaraṇabhāvamātreṇāvasthitasya kim ādhipatyam | etad eva | aṅgībhāvo 'pi cāsti kāraṇahetos tadyathā, pañcasu vijñānakāyeṣu daśānām āyatanānāṃ bhājanaloke ca karmaṇām | śrotrādīnām apy asti cakṣurvijñānotpattau pāraṃparyeṇādhipatyam | śrutvā draṣṭukāmatotpatter ityevamādi yojyam |
analyzed: kāraṇa hetuḥ pūrvam ukta tvāt pūrvaḥ tasya ādhipa jam phalam anāvaraṇa bhāva mātreṇa avasthitasya kim ādhipatyam etat eva ca asti kāraṇa hetoḥ tat yathā pañcasu vijñānakāyeṣu daśānām āyatanānām bhājana loke ca karmaṇām śrotra ādīnām api asti cakṣuḥ vijñāna utpattau pāraṃparyeṇa ādhipatyam śrutvā draṣṭu kāma tā utpatteḥ iti evamādi yojyam

original: sabhāgasarvatragayor niṣyandaḥ (56cd)
analyzed: sa bhāga sarvatragayoḥ nisyandaḥ

original: sadṛśaphalatvād anayor niḥṣyandaphalam | [p.95]
analyzed: sadṛśa phala tvāt anayoḥ niḥṣyanda phalam

original: pauruṣaṃ dvayoḥ ||56d' ||
analyzed: pauruṣam dvayoḥ 56d

original: sahabhūsamprayuktakahetvoḥ puruṣakāraphalam | puruṣabhāvāvyatirekāt puruṣakāraḥ puruṣa eva | tasya phalaṃ pauruṣam | ko 'yaṃ puruṣakāro nāma | yasya dharmasya yat kāritram | puruṣakāra iva hi puruṣakāraḥ | tadyathā kākajaṅghā oṣadhir mattahastī manuṣya iti | kim anyeṣām apy asti puruṣakāraphalam utāho dvayor eva |
analyzed: saha bhū samprayuktaka hetvoḥ puruṣakāra phalam puruṣa bhāva avyatirekāt puruṣakāraḥ puruṣaḥ eva tasya phalam pauruṣam kaḥ yam puruṣakāraḥ nāma yasya dharmasya yat kāritram puruṣakāraḥ iva hi puruṣakāraḥ tat yathā kākajaṅghāḥ oṣadhiḥ matta hastī manuṣyaḥ iti kim anyeṣām api asti puruṣakāra phalam uta aho dvayoḥ eva

original: anyeṣām apy asty anyatra vipākahetoḥ | yasmāt sahotpannaṃ vā samanantarotpannaṃ vā puruṣakāraphalaṃ bhavati | na caivaṃ vipākaḥ | tasyāpy asti viprakṛṣṭapuruṣakāraphalam | yathā karṣakāṇāṃ sasyam ity apare |
analyzed: anyeṣām api asti anyatra vipāka hetoḥ yasmāt saha utpannam vā samanantara utpannam vā puruṣakāra phalam bhavati na ca evam vipākaḥ tasya api asti viprakṛṣṭa puruṣakāra phalam yathā karṣakāṇām sasyam iti apare

original: kiṃ punar idaṃ vipākaphalaṃ nāma, kiṃ yāvad adhipatiphalam |
analyzed: kim punar idam vipāka phalam nāma kim yāvat adhipati phalam

original: vipāko 'vyākṛto dharmaḥ (57a)
analyzed: vipākaḥ vyākṛtaḥ dharmaḥ

original: anivṛtāvyākṛto hi dhamaḥ vipākaḥ | asattvākhyo 'pi syād, ata āha,
analyzed: anivṛta avyākṛtaḥ hi dhamaḥ vipākaḥ syāt atas āha

original: sattvākhyaḥ (57b)
analyzed: sattva ākhyaḥ

original: aupacayiko 'pi syāt naiḥṣyandiko 'py ata āha,
analyzed: aupacayikaḥ pi syāt naiḥṣyandikaḥ pi atas āha

original: avyākṛtodbhavaḥ | (57b')
analyzed: avyākṛta udbhavaḥ

original: kuśalākuśalaṃ hi vipākaṃ prati vyākaraṇād vyākṛtam | tasmād ya uttarakālaṃ bhavati, na saha nānantaraṃ sa vipākaḥ | etad vipākasya lakṣaṇam | tasmād asattvākhyo 'rthaḥ karmajo na vipākaḥ sādhāraṇatvāt | anyo 'pi hi tat tathaiva paribhoktuṃ samarthaḥ | asādhāraṇas tu vipākaḥ | na hy anyakṛtasya karmaṇo 'nyo vipākaṃ pratisaṃvedayate |
analyzed: kuśala akuśalam hi vipākam prati vyākaraṇāt vyākṛtam tasmāt yaḥ uttara kālam bhavati na saha na anantaram sa vipākaḥ etat vipākasya lakṣaṇam tasmāt asattva ākhyaḥ rthaḥ karma jaḥ na vipākaḥ sādhāraṇa tvāt hi tat tathā eva paribhoktum samarthaḥ asādhāraṇaḥ tu vipākaḥ na hi anya kṛtasya karmaṇaḥ nyaḥ vipākam pratisaṃvedayate

original: adhipatiphalaṃ kasmāt pratisaṃvedayate | sādhāraṇakarmasaṃbhūtatvāt |
analyzed: adhipati phalam kasmāt pratisaṃvedayate sādhāraṇa karma saṃbhūta tvāt

original: niḥṣyando hetusadṛśaḥ (57c)
analyzed: niḥṣyandaḥ hetu sadṛśaḥ

original: hetor yaḥ sadṛśo dharmaḥ, sa niṣyandaphalam | tadyathā sabhāgasarvatragahetvoḥ | yadi sarvatragahetor api samānaṃ phalaṃ kasmān na sabhāgahetor eveṣyate | yasmāt bhūmitaḥ klisṭatayā cāsya sādṛśyaṃ na tu prakārataḥ | yasya tu prakārato 'pi sādṛśyaṃ so 'bhyupagamyata eva sabhāgahetuḥ |
analyzed: hetoḥ yaḥ sadṛśaḥ dharmaḥ sa nisyanda phalam tat yathā sabhāga sarvatraga hetvoḥ yadi sarvatraga hetoḥ api samānam phalam kasmāt na sabhāga hetoḥ eva iṣyate yasmāt bhūmitaḥ ca asya sādṛśyam na tu prakārataḥ yasya tu sādṛśyam saḥ abhyupagamyate eva sabhāga hetuḥ

original: ata eva yo yasya sabhāgahetuḥ sarvatragahetur api sa tasyeti catuṣkoṭikaḥ kriyate | prathamā koṭir asarvatragaḥ sabhāgahetuḥ | dvitīyānyanaikāyikaḥ sarvatragahetuḥ | tṛtīyaikanaikāyikaḥ sarvatragahetuḥ | caturthy etān ākārān sthāpayitveti | [p.96] 		visaṃyogaḥ kṣayo dhiyā ||57d ||
analyzed: atas eva yaḥ yasya sa bhāga hetuḥ sarvatraga hetuḥ api sa tasya iti catuṣkoṭikaḥ kriyate prathamā koṭiḥ asarvatragaḥ sa bhāga hetuḥ dvitīyā anya aikāyikaḥ sarvatraga hetuḥ tṛtīyā eka naikāyikaḥ sarvatraga hetuḥ caturthī etān ākārān sthāpayitvā iti p96 visaṃyogaḥ kṣayaḥ dhiyā

original: kṣayo nirodhaḥ | dhīḥ prajñā | tena pratisaṃkhyānirodho visaṃyogaphalam ity uktaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: kṣayaḥ nirodhaḥ dhīḥ prajñā tena pratisaṃkhyā nirodhaḥ visaṃyoga phalam iti uktam bhavati

original: yadbalāj jāyate yat tat phalaṃ puruṣakārajam | (58ab)

original: sakala eva kalāpaḥ sakalasya kalāpāntarasya samanantarapratyayo na tv alpakād vedanādidravyāt prabhūtaṃ vedanādi dravyam utpadyata ity etāvad evātroktam | santānasabhāgikās tu manyante, svajāter eva samanantaraprtyayaḥ | tadyathā cittaṃ cittasyaiva vedanā vedanāyā eveti vistaraḥ |

original: yadā tv akliṣṭāntaraṃ kliṣṭam utpadyate tasya kleśasya pūrvaniruddhaḥ kleśaḥ samanatarapratyayas tadyathā nirodhasamāpatticittaṃ vyutthānacittasyeti | tad etan na vartsyate | prathamānāsravacittanutpattiprasaṅgāt cittaviprayuktā api saṃskārāḥ |

original: ata eva vyākulasaṃmukhibhāvān na samanantarapratyayas traidhātukāpratisaṃyuktānāṃ yugapat saṃmukhībhāvāt | kasmād anāgato neṣyate samanantarapratyayaḥ | vyākulatvād anāgatasyādhvanaḥ [p.99] pūrvottarābhāvāt | kathaṃ tarhi bhagavān jānāti amuṣyānāgatasyānantaram idam anāgataṃ bhavatīti | atītasāṃpratānumānāt |

original: atītaṃ kilādhvānaṃ paśyati bhagavān evaṃjātīyakāt karmaṇaḥ evaṃjātīiyako vipākaḥ utpanno dharmād vā dharmaḥ | idaṃ cāpi saṃpraty evamjātīyakaṃ karma | tasmād ato 'py evaṃjātīyako vipāka utpatsyate dharmād vā dharma iti jānāti | na cānyat jñānam ānumānikaṃ bhavati |

original: yasmād atītasāṃpratānumānena bhagavān vikīrṇāny anāgatāni dravyāṇi pratyakṣam īkṣitvā jānāty anena pudgalenaivaṃvidhaṃ karma kurvatedam anāgataṃ phalaṃ parigṛhītam iti | evaṃ tarhi bhagavān pūrvāntam adṛṣṭvāparāntaṃ na jānīyāt | anye punar āhuḥ |
analyzed: yasmāt atīta sāṃprata anumānena bhagavān vikīrṇāni anāgatāni dravyāṇi pratyakṣam īkṣitvā jānāti anena pudgalena evaṃvidham karma kurvatā idam anāgatam phalam parigṛhītam iti evam tarhi bhagavān pūrva antam a dṛṣṭvā apara antam na jānīyāt anye punar āhuḥ

analyzed: svāni eva anyatra prāyogika abhijñāphalābhyām tat punar sapta anantaram svebhyaḥ eva anyatra abhijñāphalāt abhijñāphala anantaram dve svam ca abhijñāphalam eva rūpāvacaram ca prāyogikam tat api asmāt eva dvayāt

original: rūpāvacarāṇām idānīṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ vakṣyāmaḥ (vakṣāmaḥ) | prāyogikānantaraṃ dvādaśa | kāmāvacare kuśale abhijñāphalaṃ (bhalaṃ) ca svāni ṣaṭ ārūpyāvacaraṃ ca prāyogikaṃ śaikṣam aśaikṣaṃ ca | tat punar daśacittānantaram |
analyzed: rūpāvacarāṇām idānīm ṣaṇṇām vakṣyāmaḥ vakṣāmaḥ prāyogika anantaram dvādaśa kāmāvacare kuśale abhijñā phalam bhalam ca svāni ṣaḍ ārūpyāvacaram ca prāyogikam śaikṣam aśaikṣam ca tat punar daśa citta anantaram

original: kāmāvacarābhyāṃ prāyogikābhijñāphalābhyāṃ svebhyaś caturbhyo 'nyatrairyāpathikavipākajābhyām ārūpyāvacarābhyāṃ prāyogikakliṣṭābhyāṃ śaikṣāśaikṣābhyāṃ ca | upapattipratilambhikānantaram aṣṭau | kāmāvacare kliṣṭe svāni pañcānyatrābhijñāphalāt ārūpyāvacaraṃ kliṣṭam | tat punaḥ pañcabhyaḥ svebhyaḥ evānyatrābhijñāphalāt | kliṣṭānantaraṃ nava |
analyzed: kāmāvacarābhyām prāyogika abhijñā phalābhyām svebhyaḥ caturbhyaḥ nya trairyāpathika vipāka jābhyām ārūpyāvacarābhyām prāyogika kliṣṭābhyām śaikṣa aśaikṣābhyām ca upapatti pratilambhika anantaram aṣṭau kāmāvacare kliṣṭe svāni pañca anyatra abhijñā phalāt ārūpyāvacaram kliṣṭam tat punar pañcabhyaḥ svebhyaḥ eva anyatra abhijñā phalāt kliṣṭa anantaram nava

original: kāmāvacarāṇi catvāri kuśalakliṣṭāni svāni pañcānyatrābhijñāphalāt | tat punar ekādaśacittānantaram | kāmāvacarebhya utpattipratilambhikairyāpathikavipākajebhyaḥ svebhyaḥ pañcabhyo 'nyatrābhijñāphalāt ārūpyāvacarebhyas tribhyo 'nyatra prāyogikāt | airyāpathikānantaraṃ sapta |
analyzed: kāmāvacarāṇi catvāri kuśala kliṣṭāni svāni pañca anyatra abhijñā phalāt tat punar ekādaśa citta anantaram kāmāvacarebhyaḥ utpatti pratilambhi kairyāpathika vipāka jebhyaḥ svebhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ nyatra abhijñā phalāt ārūpyāvacarebhyaḥ tribhyaḥ nyatra prāyogikāt airyāpathika anantaram sapta

original: kāmāvacare kliṣṭe svāni catvāry anyatra prāyogikābhijñāphalābhyām ārūpyāvacaraṃ ca kliṣṭam | tat punaḥ pañcānantaraṃ svebhya evānyatrābhijñāphalāt | evaṃ vipākajaṃ vaktavyam | abhijñāphalānantaraṃ dve | sve eva prāyogikābhijñāphale tad apy ābhyām eva |
analyzed: kāmāvacare kliṣṭe svāni catvāri anyatra prāyogika abhijñā phalābhyām ārūpya avacaram ca kliṣṭam tat punar pañca anantaram svebhyaḥ eva anyatra abhijñā phalāt evam vipāka jam vaktavyam abhijñā phala anantaram dve sve eva prāyogika abhijñā phale tat api ābhyām eva

original: ārūpyāvacarāṇām idānīṃ caturṇāṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | prāyogikānantaraṃ sapta | rūpāvacaraṃ prāyogikaṃ svāni catvāri śaikṣam aśaikṣaṃ ca | tat punaḥ ṣaṭcittānantaram | rūpāvacarāt prāyogikāt svebhyas tribhyo 'nyatra vipākajāt śaikṣāśaikṣābhyāṃ ca | upapattiprātilambhikānantaraṃ sapta | svāni catvāry adharabhūmikāni ca kliṣṭāni |
analyzed: ārūpyāvacarāṇām idānīm caturṇām vakṣyāmaḥ prāyogika anantaram sapta rūpāvacaram prāyogikam svāni catvāri śaikṣam aśaikṣam ca tat punar ṣaṣ citta anantaram rūpāvacarāt prāyogikāt svebhyaḥ tribhyaḥ nyatra vipāka jāt śaikṣa aśaikṣābhyām ca upapatti prātilambhika anantaram sapta svāni catvāri adharabhūmikāni ca kliṣṭāni

original: tat punaś caturbhya svebhya eva | kliṣṭānantaram aṣṭau | svāni catvāri rūpāvacare prāyogikakliṣṭe kāmāvacare kliṣṭe | tat punar daśāanantaram | svebhyaś caturbhyaḥ kāmāvacararūpāvacarebhyaś copapattiprātilambhikairyāpathikavipākajebhyaḥ | vipākajānantaraṃ ṣaṭ | svāni trīṇy anyatra prāyogikād adharāṇi trīṇi kliṣṭāni |
analyzed: tat punar caturbhyaḥ svebhyaḥ eva kliṣṭa anantaram aṣṭau svāni catvāri rūpāvacare prāyogika kliṣṭe kāmāvacare kliṣṭe tat punar daśā anantaram svebhyaḥ caturbhyaḥ kāmāvacara rūpāvacarebhyaḥ ca upapatti prātilambhika airyāpathika vipāka jebhyaḥ vipāka ja anantaram ṣaḍ svāni trīṇi anyatra prāyogikāt adharāṇi trīṇi kliṣṭāni

original: tat punaś caturbhyaḥ svebhya eva | śaikṣānantaraṃ ṣaṭ | traidhātukāni prāyogikāṇi kāmāvacaram upapattipratilambhikaṃ śaikṣam aśaikṣaṃ ca | tat punaś caturbhyaḥ | prāyogikebhyaḥ tribhyaḥ śaikṣāc ca | aśaikṣānantaraṃ pañca | yathā śaikṣānantaraṃ śaikṣam ekaṃ hitvā | tat punaḥ pañcabhyaḥ | tribhyaḥ prāyogikebhyaḥ śaikṣāśaikṣābhyāṃ ceti | [p.108]
analyzed: tat punar caturbhyaḥ svebhyaḥ eva śaikṣa anantaram ṣaḍ traidhātukāni prāyogikāṇi kāmāvacaram upapatti pratilambhikam śaikṣam aśaikṣam ca tat punar caturbhyaḥ prāyogikebhyaḥ tribhyaḥ śaikṣāt ca aśaikṣa anantaram pañca yathā śaikṣa anantaram śaikṣam ekam hitvā tat punar pañcabhyaḥ tribhyaḥ prāyogikebhyaḥ śaikṣa aśaikṣābhyām ca iti p108

original: kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ prāyogikacittānantaraṃ vipākajairyāpathikaśailpastshānikāni cittāny utpadyante, na punar ebhyaḥ prāyogikam | īryāpathaśilpābhisaṃskaraṇapravṛttatvāt durlabhānabhisaṃskāravāhitvāc caittāni na prāyogikānukūlāni | niṣkramaṇacittaṃ tv anabhisaṃskāravāhīti yukto 'sya prāyogikacittānantaram utpādaḥ |
analyzed: kim punar kāraṇam prāyogika citta anantaram vipāka ja eryāpathika śailpa stshānikāni cittāni utpadyante na punar ebhyaḥ prāyogikam īryāpatha śilpa abhisaṃskaraṇa pravṛtta tvāt durlabha an abhisaṃskāra vāhi tvāt caittāni na prāyogika anukūlāni niṣkramaṇa cittam tu an abhisaṃskāra vāhi iti yuktaḥ sya prāyogika citta anantaram utpādaḥ

original: evaṃ tarhi kliṣṭebhyo 'pi prāyogikaṃ notpadyate | viguṇatvāt | tathāpi kleśasamudācāraparikhinnasya tatparijñānād yuktaḥ prāyogikasaṃmukhībhāvaḥ | kāmāvacaram upapattipratilambhikaṃ paṭutvāt śaikṣssāśaikṣābhyāṃ rūpāvacāraprāyogikāc cānantaram utpadyate | anabhisaṃskāravāhitvāt tasmād etāni notpadyante |
analyzed: evam tarhi kliṣṭebhyaḥ pi prāyogikam na utpadyate viguṇa tvāt tathā api kleśa samudācāra parikhinnasya tad parijñānāt yuktaḥ prāyogika saṃmukhībhāvaḥ kāmāvacaram upapatti pratilambhikam paṭu tvāt śaikṣs sāśaikṣābhyām rūpa avacāra prāyogikāt ca anantaram utpadyate an abhisaṃskāra vāhi tvāt tasmāt etāni na utpadyante

original: rūpāvacarakliṣṭānantaraṃ kāmāvacaram upapattipratilambhikam utpadyate | paṭutvāt | ārūpyāvacarakliṣṭānantaraṃ tu rūpāvacaram upapattipratilambhikaṃ notpadyate 'paṭutvād iti ||
analyzed: rūpāvacara kliṣṭa anantaram kāmāvacaram upapatti pratilambhikam utpadyate paṭu tvāt ārūpyāvacara kliṣṭa anantaram tu rūpāvacaram upapatti pratilambhikam na utpadyate paṭu tvāt iti

original: trayo manaskārāḥ | svalakṣaṇamanaskāraḥ | tadyathā rūpaṇālakṣaṇaṃ rūpam ityevamādi | smāmānyalakṣaṇamanaskāraḥ | ṣoḍaśākārasaṃprayuktaḥ | adhimuktimanaskāraḥ | aśubhāpramāṇārūpyavimokṣābhibhvāyatanakṛtsnāyatanādiṣu |
analyzed: trayaḥ manaskārāḥ sva lakṣaṇa manaskāraḥ tat yathā rūpaṇā lakṣaṇam rūpam iti evamādi sma āmānya lakṣaṇa manaskāraḥ ṣoḍaśa ākāra saṃprayuktaḥ adhimukti manaskāraḥ aśubha apramāṇa ārūpya vimokṣa abhibhva āyatana kṛtsna āyatana ādiṣu

original: trividhamanaskārānantaram āryamārgaṃ saṃmukhīkaroti tasmād api trividhaṃ manaskāram evaṃ sati yuktam idaṃ bhavati, aśubhasahagataṃ smṛtisaṃbodhyaṅgaṃ bhāvayatīti | sāmānyamanaskārānantaram evāryamārgaṃ saṃmukhīkaroti | tasmāt tu trividham ity apare | aśubhayā tu cittaṃ damayitvā sāmānyamanaskārānantaraṃ mārgaṃ saṃmukhīkaroti |
analyzed: trividha manaskāra anantaram ārya mārgam saṃmukhīkaroti tasmāt api trividham manaskāram evam sati yuktam idam bhavati aśubha sahagatam smṛti saṃbodhi aṅgam bhāvayati iti sāmānya manaskāra anantaram eva ārya mārgam saṃmukhīkaroti tasmāt tu trividham iti apare aśubhayā tu cittam damayitvā sāmānya manaskāra anantaram mārgam saṃmukhīkaroti

original: ataḥ pāraṃparyam abhisaṃdhāyoktam, aśubhāsahagataṃ smṛtisaṃbodhyaṅgaṃ bhāvayatīti | āryamārgānantaram api sāmānyamanaskāram evety apare | syāt tāvad anāgamyāditribhūmisaṃniḥśrayeṇa niyāmāvakrāntau tanmārgānantaraṃ kāmāvacaraṃ sāmānyamanaskāraṃ saṃmukhīkuryād | atha dvitīyādidhyānasaṃniḥśrayeṇa niyāmāvakrāntau katham |
analyzed: atas pāraṃparyam abhisaṃdhāya uktam aśubhā sahagatam smṛti saṃbodhi aṅgam bhāvayati iti ārya mārga anantaram api sāmānya manaskāram eva iti apare syāt tāvat anāgamya ādi tribhūmi saṃniḥśrayeṇa niyāma avakrāntau tad mārga anantaram kāma avacaram sāmānya manaskāram saṃmukhīkuryāt atha dvitīya ādi dhyāna saṃniḥśrayeṇa niyāma avakrāntau katham

original: na hi kāmāvacaraḥ śakyo 'tiviprakṛṣṭatvāt | na ca tadbhūmikaḥ pratilabdho 'nyatra nirvedhabhāgīyāt | na cāryo nirvedhabhāgīyaṃ punaḥ saṃmukhīkaroti | na hi prāptaphalasya tatprayogasaṃmukībhāvo yukta iti anyo 'py asya tajjātīyaḥ sāmānyamanaskāro bhāvanāṃ gacchati |
analyzed: na hi kāmāvacaraḥ śakyaḥ u ti viprakṛṣṭa tvāt na ca tad bhūmikaḥ pratilabdhaḥ nyatra nirvedhabhāgīyāt na ca āryaḥ nirvedhabhāgīyam punar saṃmukhīkaroti na hi prāpta phalasya tad prayoga saṃmukībhāvaḥ yuktaḥ iti anyaḥ pi asya tad jātīyaḥ sāmānya manaskāraḥ bhāvanām gacchati

original: tadyathā, sarvasaṃskārā anityāḥ, sarvadharmā anātmānaḥ śāntaṃ nirvāṇam iti tatsaṃmukhīkariṣyati | tad etan na varṇayanti | anāgamyaṃ niśrityārhattvaṃ prāpnuvataḥ tadbhūmikaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ vā vyutthānaṃ cittam (vyutthānacittam) | āciṃcanyāyatanaṃ niśritya tadbhūmikaṃ bhāvāgrikaṃ vā | śeṣāsu svabhūmikam eva |
analyzed: tat yathā sarva saṃskārāḥ anityāḥ sarva dharmāḥ anātmānaḥ śāntam nirvāṇam iti tat saṃmukhīkariṣyati tat etat na varṇayanti anāgamyam niśritya arhat tvam prāpnuvataḥ tad bhūmikam kāmāvacaram vā vyutthānam cittam vyutthāna cittam āciṃcanī āyatanam niśritya tad bhūmikam bhāva agrikam vā śeṣāsu sva bhūmikam eva

original: kāmadhātau trayo manaskārāḥ śritacintāmayopapattipratilambhikāḥ | bhāvanāmayo nāsti | rūpadhātau trayaḥ śrutabhāvanāmayopapattipratilambhikāḥ | cintāmayo nāsti | yadā cintayitum ārabhante tadaiṣāṃ samādhir evopatiṣṭhate | ārūpyadhātau bhāvanāmayopapattiprati[p.109]lambhikau |

original: tatra pañcavidhamanaskārānantaram āryamārgasaṃmukhībhāvo 'nyatropapattipratilambhikebhyaḥ | prayogapratibaddhatvāt | mārgānantaraṃ tūpapattipratilambhikasyāpi kāmāvacarasya saṃmukhībhāvaḥ | paṭutvād iti ||
analyzed: tatra pañcavidha manaskāra anantaram ārya mārga saṃmukhībhāvaḥ nyatra upapatti pratilambhikebhyaḥ prayoga pratibaddha tvāt mārga anantaram tu upapatti pratilambhikasya api kāmāvacarasya saṃmukhībhāvaḥ paṭu tvāt iti

original: kāmāvacare kliṣṭe citte saṃmukhībhūte ṣaṇṇāṃ cittānāṃ lābhaḥ | tair asamanvāgatasya kāmāvacarasya kuśalasya | vicikitsayā kuśalamūlapratisaṃdhānād dhātupratyāgamanāc ca | akuśalanivṛtāvyākṛtayoḥ rūpāvacarasya ca kliṣṭasya dhātupratyāgamanāt parihaṇitaś ca ārūpyāvacarasya kliṣṭasya parihāṇitaḥ śaikṣasya ca | rūpāvacare 'pi kliṣṭe ṣaṇṇāṃ lābhaḥ |

original: rūpāvcarāṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ kāmāvacarasya cānivṛtāvyākṛtasya dhātupratyāgamanāt | ārūpyāvacarasya kliṣṭasya śaikṣasya ca parihāṇitaḥ | ārūpyāvacare tu kliṣṭe dvayor lābhaḥ | parihāṇitas tasyaiva kliṣṭasya śaikṣasya ca |

original: saty api ca pañcaskandhake 'rhataḥ (6) saṃskārā na bhavanti pañcaskandhahetukāḥ / kiṃ tarhi / avidyāhetukā eva / tathā puṇyāpuṇyāneñjyopagaṃ (7) ca vijñānaṃ tṛṣṇādayaś ceti / yathānirdeśam ava sūtrārthaḥ / yad apy uktaṃ hetur atra samutpādaḥ samutpannaṃ (8) phalaṃ yāvac catuṣkoṭika iti / etad apy utsūtram / sūtre 'nyathā nirdeśāt /
analyzed: sati api ca pañca skandhake ṛhataḥ saṃskārāḥ na bhavanti pañca skandha hetukāḥ kim tarhi avidyā hetukāḥ eva tathā ca vijñānam tṛṣṇā ādayaḥ ca iti yathānirdeśam sūtra arthaḥ yat api uktam hetuḥ atra samutpādaḥ samutpannam phalam yāvat catuṣkoṭikaḥ iti etat api utsūtram sūtre nyathā nirdeśāt

original: pratītyasamutpādaḥ (9) katamaḥ / yad utāsmin satīdaṃ bhavatīti vistareṇoktvā iti yātra dharmatā dharmasthititā (10) yāvad aviparyastatā ayam ucyate pratītyasamutpāda iti / dharmatā ca nāma dharmajātiḥ dharmāṇāṃ śailiḥ / (11) ato yeyaṃ dharmatā ya eṣa niyamaḥ / avidyāyām eva satyāṃ saṃskārā bhavanti nonyathā /
analyzed: pratītyasamutpādaḥ katamaḥ yat uta asmin sati idam bhavati iti vistareṇa uktvā iti yā atra dharma tā dharma sthiti tā yāvat aviparyasta tā ayam ucyate pratītyasamutpādaḥ iti dharma tā ca nāma dharma jātiḥ dharmāṇām śailiḥ atas yā iyam dharma tā yaḥ eṣa niyamaḥ avidyāyām eva satyām saṃskārāḥ bhavanti na unyathā

original: eṣa (12) pratītyasamutpādo na hetur eva / yad apy catuṣkoṭikam uktaṃ tatra yady anāgatāḥ (13) dharmā na pratītyasamutpannāḥ sūtraṃ virudhyate / pratītyasamutpannā dharmāḥ katame / avidyā yāvaj jātiḥ (14) jarāmaraṇam / tayor anāgatādhvavyavasthānaṃ naiṣṭavyam iti trikāṇḍavyavasthā bhidyate / asaṃskṛtaḥ (15) pratītyasamutpāda iti nikāyāntarīyāḥ /
analyzed: eṣa pratītyasamutpādaḥ na hetuḥ eva yat api catuṣkoṭikam uktam tatra yadi anāgatāḥ 13 dharmāḥ na pratītyasamutpannāḥ sūtram virudhyate pratītyasamutpannāḥ dharmāḥ katame avidyā yāvat jātiḥ jarā maraṇam tayoḥ anāgata adhva vyavasthānam na eṣṭavyam iti tri kāṇḍa vyavasthā bhidyate asaṃskṛtaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ iti nikāya antarīyāḥ

original: utpādād vā tathāgatānām anutpādād vā sthitaiveyaṃ (16) dharmateti vacanāt / tad etad abhiprāyavaśād evaṃ ca na caivam / kathaṃ tāvad evaṃ kathaṃ vā (17) naivam /

analyzed: yadi ayam abhiprāyaḥ utpādāt vā tathāgatānām anutpādāt vā nityam avidyā ādīn pratītya sa sṃkāra ādīnām anutpādaḥ na kadācid a pratītya anyat vā pratītya atas nityaḥ iti evam etat iti pratigrāhyam atha ayam abhiprāyaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ nāma kiṃcid bhāva antaram nityam asti iti na etat evam iti pratiṣeddhavyam kim kāraṇam

original: utpādasya saṃskṛtalakṣaṇatvāt / na ca nityaṃ bhāvāntaram anityasya lakṣaṇaṃ yujyate / (21) utpādaś ca nāmotpattur bhavatīti ko 'syāvidyādibhir abhaṃbandho yatas teṣāṃ pratītyasamutāda ity ucyate / (22) padārthaś cāsamartho bhavatīti nityaś ca nāma pratītyasamutpādaś ceti / [p.138]
