original: atha pratītyasamutpāda iti kaḥ padārthaḥ / pratiḥ prāptyartha, eti gatyarthaḥ / (2) upasargavaśena dhātvarthapariṇāmāt prāpyeti yo 'rthaḥ so 'rthaḥ pratītyeti / padi sattārthaḥ samutpūrvaḥ (3) prādurbhāvārthaḥ / tena pratyayaṃ prāpya samudbhavaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ / na yukta eṣa padārthaḥ / (4) kiṃ kāraṇam /
analyzed: atha pratītyasamutpādaḥ iti kaḥ padārthaḥ pratiḥ prāpti arthaḥ ā iti gati arthaḥ upasarga vaśena dhātvartha pariṇāmāt prāpya iti yaḥ rthaḥ saḥ rthaḥ pratītya iti padi sattā arthaḥ samutpūrvaḥ 3 prādurbhāva arthaḥ tena pratyayam prāpya samudbhavaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ na yuktaḥ eṣa padārthaḥ kim kāraṇam

original: ekasya hi karttur dvayoḥ kriyayoḥ pūrvakālāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ ktvāvidhir bhavati / (5) tadyathā snātvā bhuṅkta iti / na cāsau pūrvam utpādāt paścid asti yaḥ ūrvaṃ pratītyottarakālam utpadyate / (6) na cāpy akartṛkāasti kriyeti / āha cātra (7)
analyzed: ekasya hi karttuḥ dvayoḥ kriyayoḥ pūrva kālāyām kriyāyām ktvā vidhiḥ bhavati tat yathā snātvā bhuṅkte iti na ca asau pūrvam utpādāt paścid asti yaḥ ūrvam pratītya uttara kālam utpadyate na ca api akartṛkā asti kriyā iti āha ca atra 7

original: ''pratyeti pūrvam utpādād yad yady asattvān na yujyate / (8)
analyzed: pratyeti pūrvam utpādāt yat yadi asattvāt na yujyate

original: saha cet ktvā na siddho 'tra pūrvakālavidhānata iti /'' (9)
analyzed: saha ced ktvā na siddhaḥ tra pūrva kāla vidhānataḥ iti

original: naiṣa doṣaḥ / idaṃ tāvad ayaṃ praṣṭavyaḥ śābdikaḥ / kimavastho dharmaḥ utpadyate, varttamāna utāho 'nāgata (10) iti / kiṃ cātaḥ / yadi varttamāna utpadyate / kathaṃ varttamāno yadi notpannaḥ / utpannasya (11) vā punar utpattāv anavasthāprasaṅgaḥ / athānāgata utpadyate katham asataḥ kartṛtvaṃ siddhaty (sidhyati') akkartṛkā vā kriyeti /
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ idam tāvat ayam praṣṭavyaḥ śābdikaḥ kimavasthaḥ dharmaḥ utpadyate varttamānaḥ uta aho nāgataḥ iti kim ca atas yadi varttamānaḥ utpadyate katham vartamānaḥ yadi na utpannaḥ utpannasya vā punar utpattau anavasthā prasaṅgaḥ atha anāgataḥ utpadyate katham asataḥ kartṛ tvam sidhyati a kartṛkā vā kriyā iti

original: (12) ato yadavastha utpadyate tadavastha eva pratyeti / kimavasthaś cotpadyate / utpādābhimukho 'nāgataḥ / (13) tadavastha eva pratyayaṃ pratyetīty ucyate / aniṣpannaṃ cedaṃ yad uta śābdikīyaṃ kartṛkriyāvvyavasthānaṃ (14) bhavatīty eṣa karttābhūtir ity eṣā kriyā / na cātra bhavitur arthāt bhūtim anyāṃ (15) kriyāṃ paśyāmaḥ /
analyzed: atas yad avasthaḥ utpadyate tad avasthaḥ eva pratyeti kimavasthaḥ ca utpadyate utpāda abhimukhaḥ na agataḥ tad avasthaḥ eva pratyayam pratyeti iti ucyate aniṣpannam ca idam yat uta śābdikīyam kartṛ kriyau vyavasthānam bhavati iti eṣa karttā ābhūtiḥ iti eṣā kriyā na ca atra bhavituḥ arthāt bhūtim anyām kriyām paśyāmaḥ

original: tasmād acchalaṃ vyavahāreṣu / eṣa tu vākyārthaḥ / asmin saty asya bhāvaḥ (16) asyotpādād idam utpadyata iti yo 'rthaḥ so 'rthaḥ pratītyasamutpāda iti / āha cātra (17)
analyzed: tasmāt acchalam vyavahāreṣu eṣa tu vākya arthaḥ asmin sati asya bhāvaḥ asya utpādāt idam utpadyate iti yaḥ rthaḥ saḥ rthaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ iti āha ca atra 17

original: anye punar asya codyasya parihārārtham anyathā parikalpayanti / pratir vīpsāarthaḥ / iatau (22) sādhava ityā anavasthāyinaḥ / utpūrvaḥ padiḥ prādurbhāvārthaḥ / tāṃ tāṃ kāraṇasāmagrīṃ (23) prati ityānāṃ samavāyenotpādaḥ pratītyasamutpāda iti / eṣā tu kalpanātraiva kalpyate /
analyzed: anye punar asya codyasya parihāra artham anyathā parikalpayanti pratiḥ vīpsā arthaḥ sādhavaḥ ityāḥ anavasthāyinaḥ ut pūrvaḥ padiḥ prādurbhāva arthaḥ tām tām kāraṇa sāmagrīm prati ityānām samavāyena utpādaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ iti eṣā tu kalpanā atra eva kalpyate

original: (24) iha kathaṃ bhaviṣyati cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpāṇi cotpadyate cakṣurvijñānam iti / kim arthaṃ punar bhagavān [p.139] paryāyadvayam āha ( /) asmin satīdaṃ bhavati asyotpādād idam utpadyate iti ' avadhāraṇārtham / (2) yathānyatrāha: avidyāyāṃ satyāṃ saṃskārā bhavanti nānyatrāvidyāyaḥ saṃskārā iti / aṅgaparaṃparāṃ (3) vā darśayitum /
analyzed: iha katham bhaviṣyati cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpāṇi ca utpadyate cakṣuḥ vijñānam iti kim artham punar bhagavān paryāya dvayam āha asmin sati idam bhavati asya utpādāt idam utpadyate iti avadhāraṇa artham yathā anyatra āha avidyāyām satyām saṃskārāḥ bhavanti na anyatra avidyā ayaḥ saṃskārāḥ iti aṅga paraṃparām vā darśayitum

original: asminn aṅge satīdaṃ bhavati, asya punar aṅgasyotpādād idam utpadyata iti / (4) janmaparaṃparāṃ vā / pūrvānte sati madhyānto bhavati, madhyāntasyotpādād aparānta utpadyata iti / (5) sākṣāt pāraṃparyeṇa pratyayabhāvaṃ darśayati / kadācid dhi samanantaram avidyāyāḥ saṃskārā (6) bhavanti kadācit pāraṃparyeṇeti /

original: ahetunityahetuvādapratiṣedhartham ity apare / nāstati hetau (7) bhāvo bhavati, na cānutpattimato nityāt prakṛtipuruṣādikāt kiṃcid utpadyata iti / asyāṃ tu (8) kalpanāyāṃ pūrvapadasya grahaṇam anarthakaṃ prāṇoti / asyotpādād idam utpadyata ity anenāvnobhayavāda(9)pratiṣedhasiddheḥ /

original: santi tarhi kecid ya ātmani saty āśrayabhūte saṃskārādīnāṃ bhāvaṃ parikalpayanti (10) avidyādīnāṃ cotpādāt tadutpattim / atas tāṃ palpanāṃ paryudāsayitum idaṃ nirdhārayāṃ babhūva (11) yasyaivotpādād yad utpadyate, tasminn eva sati tat bhavati nānyasmin /
analyzed: santi tarhi kecid ye ātmani sati āśraya bhūte saṃskāra ādīnām bhāvam parikalpayanti avidyā ādīnām ca utpādāt tad utpattim atas tām palpanām paryudāsayitum idam babhūva 11 yasya eva utpādāt yat utpadyate tasmin eva sati tat bhavati na anyasmin

original: yadutāvidyāpratyayāḥ saṃskārāḥ (12) yāvad evam asya kevalasya mahato duḥkhaskandhasya samudayo bhavatīti / aprahīṇotpattijñāpanārtham ity ācāryāḥ / avidyāyām aprahīṇāyāṃ saṃskārā na prahīyante / tasyā evotpādād utpadyanta (14) iti vistaraḥ / sthityutpattisaṃdarśanārtham ity apare / yāvat kāraṇasrotas (15) tāvat kāryasroto bhavati /
analyzed: yat uta avidyā pratyayāḥ saṃskārāḥ yāvat evam asya kevalasya mahataḥ duḥkha skandhasya samudayaḥ bhavati iti aprahīṇa utpatti jñāpana artham iti ācāryāḥ avidyāyām aprahīṇāyām saṃskārāḥ na prahīyante tasyāḥ eva utpādāt utpadyante iti vistaraḥ sthiti utpatti saṃdarśana artham iti apare yāvat kāraṇa srotaḥ tāvat kārya srotaḥ bhavati

original: kāraṇasyaiva cotpādāt kāryam utpadyata iti / utpāde tv adhikṛte (16) kaḥ prasaṅgaḥ sthitivacanasya ( /) bhinnakramaṃ ca bhagavān kimartham ācakṣīta prāk sthitiṃ paścād utpādam / (17) punar āha asmin satīdaṃ bhavatīti kārye sati kāraṇasya vināśo bhavatīti / syān matam ahetukaṃ (18) tarhi kāryam utpadyata ity ata āha nāhetukam /
analyzed: kāraṇasya eva ca utpādāt kāryam utpadyate iti utpāde tu adhikṛte kaḥ prasaṅgaḥ sthiti vacanasya bhinnakramam ca bhagavān kimartham ācakṣīta prāk sthitim paścāt utpādam punar āha asmin sati idam bhavati iti kārye sati kāraṇasya vināśaḥ bhavati iti syāt matam ahetukam tarhi kāryam utpadyate iti atas āha na ahetukam

original: yasmād asyotpādād idam utpadyata iti / eṣa (19) cet sūtrārtho 'bhaviṣyad asmin satīdaṃ na bhavatīty evācakṣata / pūrvaṃ ca tāvat kāryasyotpādane (20) vācakṣata paścād asmin satīdaṃ na bhavatīti / evaṃ hi sādhu kramo bhavati / itarathā tu (21) pratītyasamutpādaḥ katama ity āder arthe kaḥ prakramo vināśavacanasya / tasmān naiṣa sūtrārthaḥ /
analyzed: yasmāt asya utpādāt idam utpadyate iti eṣa 19 ced sūtra arthaḥ bhaviṣyat asmin sati idam na bhavati iti eva ācakṣata pūrvam ca tāvat kāryasya utpādane vā ācakṣata paścāt asmin sati idam na bhavati iti evam hi sādhu kramaḥ bhavati itarathā tu pratītyasamutpādaḥ katamaḥ iti ādeḥ arthe kaḥ prakramaḥ vināśa vacanasya tasmāt na eṣa sūtra arthaḥ

original: (22) kathaṃ punar avidyāpratyayāḥ saṃskārā yāvat jātipratyayaṃ jarāmaraṇam iti / abhisaṃbandhamātraṃ (23) darśayiṣyāmaḥ /

original: bālo hi pratītyasamutpannaṃ sasṃkāramātram idam ity aprajānan ātmadṛṣṭyasmimānā(24)bhiniviṣṭa ātmanaḥ sukhārtham asukhārthaṃ (') vā kāyadibhis trividhaṃ karmārabhate āyatisukhārthaṃ puṇyaṃ [p.140] sukhādhuḥkhāsukhārtham ānaiñjam aihikasukhārtham apuṇyaṃ tasyāvidyāpratyayāḥ (2) sasṃkārāḥ karmākṣepavaśāc ca vijñānasaṃtatis tāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ gacchati /
analyzed: bālaḥ hi pratītyasamutpannam sa sṃkāra mātram idam iti a prajānan ātma dṛṣṭi asmimāna abhiniviṣṭaḥ ātmanaḥ sukha artham asukha artham vā kāya ādibhiḥ trividham karma ārabhate āyati sukha artham puṇyam ānaiñjam aihika sukha artham apuṇyam tasya avidyā pratyayāḥ sa sṃkārāḥ karma ākṣepa vaśāt ca vijñāna saṃtatiḥ tām tām gatim gacchati

original: jvālāgamanayogenāntarābhava(3)saṃbanmdhāt / tadanyasaṃskārāpratyayaṃ vijñānam / evaṃ ca kṛtvā tadupapannaṃ bhavati, vijñānāṅganirdeśe vijñānaṃ katamat / ṣaḍ vijñānakāyā iti / vijñānapūrvakaṃ punas tasyāṃ tasyāṃ gatau nāmarūpaṃ (5) jāyate pañcaskandhakaṃ kṛtsyajanmānugatam / vibhaṅge mahānidānaparyāye caivaṃ nirdeśāt /

original: tasya tat kāmarāgaparyavasthānaṃ sthāmaśaḥ samyak samavahataṃ sānuśayaṃ prahīyata'' iti / kāmarāgasyānuśayaś ced viprayuktānuśayaprasaṅgād abhidharmavirodhaḥ / ''kāmarāgānuśayas tribhir indriyaiḥ saṃprayukta'' iti / kāmarāga evānuśaya iti vaibhāṣikāḥ / evaṃ yāvad vicikitsaivānuśaya iti /
analyzed: tasya tat kāma rāga paryavasthānam sthāmaśas samyak samavahatam sa anuśayam prahīyate iti kāma rāgasya anuśayaḥ ced viprayukta anuśaya prasaṅgāt abhidharma virodhaḥ kāma rāga anuśayaḥ tribhiḥ indriyaiḥ saṃprayuktaḥ iti kāma rāgaḥ eva anuśayaḥ iti vaibhāṣikāḥ evam yāvat vicikitsā eva anuśayaḥ iti

original: nanu coktam evaṃ sūtravirodha iti / nāsti virodhaḥ / sānuśayaṃ sānubandham ity arthaḥ / aupacāriko vā sūtre 'nuśayaśabdaḥ prāptau / yathā duḥkho 'gnir iti / lākṣaṇikas tv abhidharme kleśa evānuśayaśabdaḥ / tasmāt saṃprayuktā evānuśayāḥ /
analyzed: nanu ca uktam evam sūtra virodhaḥ iti na asti virodhaḥ sa anuśayam sa anubandham iti arthaḥ aupacārikaḥ vā sūtre nuśaya śabdaḥ prāptau yathā duḥkhaḥ gniḥ iti lākṣaṇikaḥ tu abhidharme kleśaḥ eva anuśaya śabdaḥ tasmāt saṃprayuktāḥ eva anuśayāḥ

original: katham idaṃ gamyate anuśayānāṃ ''cittakleśakaratvād āvaraṇatvāc chubhair viruddhatvāt'' /
analyzed: katham idam gamyate anuśayānām citta kleśa kara tvāt āvaraṇa tvāt śubhaiḥ viruddha tvāt

original: yasmād anuśayaiḥ kliṣṭaṃ cittaṃ bhavaty apūrvaṃ kuśalaṃ notpadyate utpannāc ca parihīyate tasmān na viprayuktāḥ / atha viprayuktair apy evaṃ syāt / kuśalaṃ na kadācid upalabhyeta / teṣāṃ nityaṃ saṃnihitatvāt / upalabhyate ca / ataḥ,
analyzed: yasmāt anuśayaiḥ kliṣṭam cittam bhavati apūrvam kuśalam na utpadyate utpannāt ca parihīyate tasmāt na viprayuktāḥ atha viprayuktaiḥ api evam syāt kuśalam na kadācid upalabhyeta teṣām nityam saṃnihita tvāt upalabhyate ca atas

original: ''kuśalasya copalambhād aviprayuktaḥ atha ihānuśayāḥ'' iti /
analyzed: kuśalasya ca upalambhāt a viprayuktaḥ atha iha anuśayāḥ iti

original: tad idam ajñāpakaṃ yasmād yo viprayuktam anuśayam icchati sa etat sarvam anuśayakṛtaṃ necchati / kleśakṛtam evecchati /
analyzed: tat idam ajñāpakam yasmāt yaḥ viprayuktam anuśayam icchati saḥ etat sarvam anuśaya kṛtam na icchati kleśa kṛtam eva icchati

original: evaṃ tu sādhu yathā sautrāntikānām / kathaṃ ca sautrāntikānām / kāmarāgasyānuśayaḥ kāmarāgānuśaya iti / na cānuśayaḥ saṃprayukto na viprayuktas tasyādravyāntaratvāt / prasupto hi kleśo 'nuśaya ucyate / prabuddhaḥ paryavasthānam / kā ca tasya prasuptiḥ / asaṃmukhībhūtasya bījabhāvānubandhaḥ / kaḥ prabodhaḥ / saṃmukhībhāvaḥ /
analyzed: evam tu sādhu yathā sautrāntikānām katham ca sautrāntikānām kāma rāgasya anuśayaḥ kāma rāga anuśayaḥ iti na ca anuśayaḥ saṃprayuktaḥ na viprayuktaḥ tasya a dravya antara tvāt prasuptaḥ hi kleśaḥ nuśayaḥ ucyate prabuddhaḥ paryavasthānam kā ca tasya prasuptiḥ a saṃmukhībhūtasya bīja bhāva anubandhaḥ kaḥ prabodhaḥ saṃmukhībhāvaḥ

original: ko 'yaṃ bījabhāvo nāma / ātmabhāvasya kleśajā kleśotpādanaśaktiḥ / yathānubhavajñānajā smṛṭyutpādanaśaktir yathā cāṅkurādīnāṃ śāliphalajā śāliphalotpādanaśaktir iti / yas tu kleśānāṃ bījārtham arthāntaraṃ viprayuktam [p.279] anuśayaṃ kalpayati tena smṛtibījam apy arthāntaraṃ kalpayitavyaṃ jāyate /
analyzed: kaḥ yam bīja bhāvaḥ nāma ātma bhāvasya kleśa jā kleśa utpādana śaktiḥ yathā anubhava jñāna jā smṛṭi utpādana śaktiḥ yathā ca aṅkura ādīnām śāli phala jā śāli phala utpādana śaktiḥ iti yaḥ tu kleśānām bīja artham artha antaram viprayuktam anuśayam kalpayati tena smṛti bījam api artha antaram kalpayitavyam jāyate

original: yat tarhi sūtre kleśa evānuśaya uktaḥ ṣaṭṣaṭke ''so 'sya bhavati sukhāyāṃ vedanāyāṃ rāgānuśaya'' iti / bhavatīti vacanān nāsau tad evānuśayaḥ / kadā tarhi bhavati / yadā prasupto bhavati / haitau vā tadupacāra eṣa draṣṭavyaḥ / tiṣṭhatu prasangaḥ / śāstraṃ pravartatām /
analyzed: yat tarhi sūtre kleśaḥ eva anuśayaḥ uktaḥ ṣaṣ ṣaṭke saḥ sya bhavati sukhāyām vedanāyām rāga anuśayaḥ iti bhavati iti vacanāt na asau tat eva anuśayaḥ kadā tarhi bhavati yadā prasuptaḥ bhavati ha etau vā tad upacāraḥ eṣa draṣṭavyaḥ tiṣṭhatu prasangaḥ śāstram pravartatām

original: ya eṣa sūtre rāgasya bhedaḥ kṛtaḥ kāmarāgo bhavarāga iti / ko 'yaṃ bhavarāgaḥ /
analyzed: yaḥ eṣa sūtre rāgasya bhedaḥ kṛtaḥ kāma rāgaḥ bhava rāgaḥ iti kaḥ yam bhava rāgaḥ

original: bhavarāgo dvidhātujaḥ / (2b)

original: rūpārūpyadhātujo rāgo bhavarāgaḥ kṛtaḥ / kiṃ kāraṇam evaṃ kṛtaḥ /
analyzed: rūpa ārūpya dhātu jaḥ rāgaḥ bhava rāgaḥ kṛtaḥ kim kāraṇam evam kṛtaḥ

original: antarmukhatvāt tanmokṣasaṃjñāvyāvṛttaye kṛtaḥ //2cd //
analyzed: antar mukha tvāt tad mokṣa saṃjñā vyāvṛttaye kṛtaḥ

original: samāpattirāgo hi teṣāṃ prāyeṇa / sa cāntarmukhapravṛttas tasmāt bhavarāgaḥ / uktas tayoḥ kila dhātvor mokṣasaṃjñāvyāvartanārtham ekeṣām iti / ātmabhāva eva tu bhavaḥ / te ca sattvāḥ samāpattiṃ sāśrayām āsvādayanta ātmabhāvam evāsvādayanti kāmavītarāgatvāt ataḥ sa rāgo bhavarāga ity uktaḥ /
analyzed: samāpatti rāgaḥ hi teṣām prāyeṇa sa ca antar mukha pravṛttaḥ tasmāt bhava rāgaḥ uktaḥ tayoḥ kila dhātvoḥ mokṣa saṃjñā vyāvartana artham ekeṣām iti ātma bhāvaḥ eva tu bhavaḥ te ca sattvāḥ samāpattim sāśrayām āsvādayantaḥ ātma bhāvam eva āsvādayanti kāma vīta rāga tvāt atas sa rāgaḥ bhava rāgaḥ iti uktaḥ

original: punar ete ṣaḍ anuśayā abhidharme daśa kriyante / kathaṃ kṛtvā /
analyzed: punar ete ṣaṭ anuśayāḥ abhidharme daśa kriyante katham kṛtvā

original: dṛṣṭayaḥ pañca satkāyamithyāntagrāhadṛṣṭayaḥ /
analyzed: dṛṣṭayaḥ pañca sat kāya mithyā anta grāha dṛṣṭayaḥ

original: dṛṣṭiśīlavrataparāmarśāv iti punar daśa //3//
analyzed: dṛṣṭi śīla vrata parāmarśau iti punar daśa

original: ṣaṇṇām anuśayānāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ pañcadhā kṛtvā daśa bhavanti / pañca dṛṣṭisvabhāvāḥ satkāyadṛṣṭir antagrāhadṛṣṭir mithyādṛṣṭir dṛṣṭiparāmarśaḥ śīlavprataparāmarśaś ca /yathādṛṣṭisvabhāvāḥ rāgaḥ pratigho māno 'vidyā vicikitsā /
analyzed: ṣaṇṇām anuśayānām dṛṣṭim pañcadhā kṛtvā daśa bhavanti pañca dṛṣṭi svabhāvāḥ satkāya dṛṣṭiḥ anta grāha dṛṣṭiḥ mithyā dṛṣṭiḥ dṛṣṭi parāmarśaḥ ca yathā dṛṣṭi svabhāvāḥ rāgaḥ pratighaḥ mānaḥ vidyā vicikitsā

original: ete punar ete daśānuśayā abhidharme 'ṣṭānavatiḥ kriyante / kāmāvacarāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśad rūpāvacarā ekaviṃśat ārūpyāvacarā ekatriṃśat /
analyzed: ete punar ete daśa anuśayāḥ abhidharme ṣṭānavatiḥ kriyante kāmāvacarāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśat rūpāvacarāḥ ekaviṃśat ārūpyāvacarāḥ ekatriṃśat

original: kathaṃ kṛtvā / samāsato hy ete 'nuśayās traidhātukā darśanaprahātavyā bhāvanāprahātavyāś ca / tatra tāvat kāmāvacarā darśanaprahātavyā dvātriṃśat / katame ta ity āha, [p.280]

original: ya ete daśānuśayā uktā ete kāmadhātau daśāpi duḥkhadarśanaheyāḥ santi / ebhya eva sapta samudayadarśanapraheyāḥ / sapta nirodhadarśanaheyāḥ satkāyadṛṣtim antagrāhadṛṣṭiṃ śīlavrataparāmarśaṃ ca varjayitvā / aṣṭau mārgadarśanaheyāḥ / satkāyadṛṣṭim antagrāhadṛṣṭiṃ ca varjayitvā / kty ete kāmāvacarā dvātriṃśad anuśayā darśanaprahātavyaḥ /
analyzed: ye ete daśa anuśayāḥ uktāḥ ete kāmadhātau daśa api duḥkha darśana heyāḥ santi ebhyaḥ eva sapta samudaya darśana praheyāḥ sapta nirodha darśana heyāḥ satkāya dṛṣtim anta grāha dṛṣṭim śīla vrata parāmarśam ca varjayitvā aṣṭau mārga darśana heyāḥ satkāya dṛṣṭim anta grāha dṛṣṭim ca varjayitvā ete kāmāvacarāḥ dvātriṃśat anuśayāḥ darśana prahātavyaḥ

analyzed: tat yathā rāgaḥ pratighaḥ mānaḥ vidyā ca dṛṣṭa satyasya paścāt mārga abhyāsena prahāṇāt tat evam satkāya dṛṣtiḥ eka prakārā bhavati duḥkha darśana heyā evam anta grāha dṛṣṭiḥ mithyādṛṣṭiḥ catuṣprakārā bhavati duḥkha samudaya nirodha mārga darśana heyā evam dṛṣṭi parāmarśaḥ vicikitsā ca śīla vrata parāmarśaḥ dvi prakāraḥ duḥkha mārga darśana heyaḥ

original: rāgapratighamānāvidyāḥ pañcaprakārāś catuḥsatyadarśanaheyā bhāvanāheyāś ca / kīdṛśā ete duḥkhadarśanaheyāḥ kīdṛśā yāvad bhāvanāheyāḥ / ye yaddarśanaheyālambanās te taddarśanaheyā aviśiṣṭā bhāvanāheyāḥ /

original: tā eva dvādaśa dṛṣṭayo bhavanti catasro vicikitsāḥ pañca rāgāḥ pañca pratighāḥ pañca mānāḥ pañcāvidyā ity ete kāmāvacarāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśad anuśayā bhavanti /

original: ātmadṛṣṭir ātmīyadṛṣṭir vā satkāyadṛṣṭiḥ / sīdatīti sat / cayaḥ kāyaḥ saṃghātaḥ skandha ity arthaḥ / sac cāyaṃ kāyaś ceti satkāyaḥ pañcopādānaskandhāḥ / nityasaṃjñāṃ piṇḍasaṃjñāṃ ca tyājayitum evaṃ dyotitā / etatpūrviko hi teṣv ātmagrahaḥ / satkāye dṛṣṭiḥ satkāyadṛṣṭiḥ / sarvaiva sāsravālambanā dṛṣṭiḥ satkāye /
analyzed: ātma dṛṣṭiḥ ātmīya dṛṣṭiḥ vā sat kāya dṛṣṭiḥ sīdati iti sat cayaḥ kāyaḥ saṃghātaḥ skandhaḥ iti arthaḥ sat ca ayam kāyaḥ ca iti sat kāyaḥ pañca upādāna skandhāḥ nitya saṃjñām piṇḍa saṃjñām ca tyājayitum evam dyotitāḥ etad pūrvikaḥ hi teṣu ātma grahaḥ sat kāye dṛṣṭiḥ sat kāya dṛṣṭiḥ sarvā eva sa āsrava ālambanā dṛṣṭiḥ sat kāye

original: tathāgato bhagavān arhan samyaksambuddhaḥ, svākhyāto 'sya dharmaḥ, supratipannaḥ śrāvakasaṃghaḥ, rūpam anityaṃ yāvad vijñānaṃ, duḥkhaprajñaptir yāvan mārgaprajñaptir ekāṃśena vyākarttavyam arthopasaṃhitatvāt /

original: vibhajyavyākaraṇaṃ nāma yadi kaścid brūyād ''dharmaṃ vade''ti sa vaktavyo ''bahavo dharmā atītā anāgatāḥ pratyutpannāḥ, katamān vadāmī''ti / yadi brūyād ''atītān'' iti / sa vaktavyo '''tītā api bahavo dharmā rūpaṃ yāvad vijñānam'' iti / atha brūyād ''''rūpam'''' iti / sa vaktavyo ''rūpam api trividham kuśalam akuśalam avyākṛtañ ca'' /

original: yadi āha ''''kuśalam'''' iti / ''tad api saptaprakāraṃ prāṇātipātād viratir yāvat saṃbhinnapralāpād'' iti / yady āha ''prāṇātipātād viratim'' iti / ''sāpi triprakārā alobhajādveṣajāmohajā'' / yady āhā''lobhajām'' iti / ''alobhajāpi dvividhā vijñāptyavijñaptibhedād'' ity evaṃ vibhajya vaktavyam iti /

original: etad eva ca śaṭhasya paripṛcchya vyākaraṇanm / tasya vaktavyaṃ ''dharmā bahava'' iti / na tu vibhaktavyā yāvat tūṣṇīṃ vā tiṣṭhati, svayaṃ vā vyākarotīti /

original: yadā tau na kiṃcit pṛcchataḥ, kevalam adhyeṣayataḥ, tayoś ca na kiṃcit vyākriyate kevalaṃ parippraśnyete, tat katham anayoḥ praśno bhavati, kathaṃ vā vyākāraṇam /

original: sthāpanīyas tu yathā ''antavān loko 'nantavān '' ity evamādi [ /] sūtrantād eva tu praśnavyākaraṇānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam /

original: iti hi bhikṣavaś cakṣur abhūtvā bhavati, bhūtvā ca prativigacchati'' iti / yadi cānāgataṃ cakṣuḥ syān noktaṃ syād abhutvā bhavatīti / vartamāne 'dhvany abhūtvā bhavatīti cet / na / adhvano bhāvād anarthāntaratvāt / atha svātmany abhūtvā bhavati / siddham idam anāgataṃ cakṣur nāstīti /

original: yad apy uktaṃ ''dvayaṃ pratītya vijñānasyotpādād'' iti [ /] idaṃ tāvad iha saṃpradhāryam / yan manaḥ pratītya dharmāṃś cotpadyate manovijñānaṃ kiṃ tasyayathā mano janakaḥ pratyaya evaṃ dharmā āhosvid ālaṃbanamātraṃ dharmā iti /

original: yadi tāvad janakaḥ pratyayo dharmāḥ kathaṃ yad anāgataṃ kalpasahasreṇa bhaviṣyati vā na vā tad idānīṃ vijñānaṃ janayiṣyati / nirvāṇaṃ ca sarvapravṛttinirodhāj janakaṃ nopapadyate / athālaṃbanamātraṃ dharmā bhavanti / atītānāgatam apy ālaṃbanaṃ bhavatīti brūmaḥ /
analyzed: yadi tāvat janakaḥ pratyayaḥ dharmāḥ katham yat anāgatam kalpa sahasreṇa bhaviṣyati vā na vā tat idānīm vijñānam janayiṣyati nirvāṇam ca sarva pravṛtti nirodhāt janakam na upapadyate atha ālaṃbana mātram dharmāḥ bhavanti atīta anāgatam api ālaṃbanam bhavati iti brūmaḥ

original: yadi nāsti katham ālaṃbanam /

original: kathaṃ tadālaṃbanam abhūd bhaviṣyati ceti / na hi kaścid atītaṃ rūpaṃ vedanāṃ vā smarann astīti paśyati / kiṃ tarhi / abhūd iti / yathā khalv api vartamānaṃ rūpam anubhūtaṃ tathā tad atītaṃ smaryate / yathā cānāgataṃ vartamānaṃ prāpnoti / atha nāsti / asad apy ālaṃbanaṃ bhavatīti siddham /
analyzed: katham tat ālaṃbanam abhūt bhaviṣyati ca iti na hi kaścid atītam rūpam vedanām vā smaran asti iti paśyati kim tarhi abhūt iti yathā khalu api vartamānam rūpam anubhūtam tathā tat atītam smaryate yathā ca anāgatam vartamānam prāpnoti atha na asti asat api ālaṃbanam bhavati iti siddham

original: tad eva tadvikīrṇam iti cet / [p.300] na / vikīrṇasyāgrahaṇāt / yadi ca tat tad eva rūpaṃ kevalaṃ paramānuśo vibhaktam / evaṃ sati paramāṇavo nityāḥ prāpnuvanti / paramāṇusaṃcayavibhāgamātraṃ caivaṃ sati prāpnoti / na tu kiṃcid utpadyate nāpi nirudhyata ity ājīvikavāda ālaṃbito bhavati /

original: sūtraṃ cāpaviddhaṃ bhavati ''cakṣur utpadyamānaṃ na kutaścid āgacchati'' iti vistaraḥ / aparamāṇusaṃcitānāṃ vedanādīnāṃ kathaṃ vikīrṇatvam / te 'pi ca yathotpannānubhūtāḥ smaryante / yadi ca te tathaiva santi nityāḥ prāpnuvanti / atha na santi, asad apy ālaṃbanam iti siddham /

original: vitarko vicāraḥ prītiḥ sukhaṃ cittaikāgratā cety etāni pañcāṅgāni samādhiḥ' kilāṅgaṃ dhyānaṃ ca / śeṣāṇy aṅgānīti / yathā caturaṅgā senā evaṃ pañcāṅgaṃ dhyānam / [p.438]
analyzed: vitarkaḥ vicāraḥ prītiḥ sukham citta ekāgra tā ca iti etāni pañca aṅgāni samādhiḥ kila aṅgam dhyānam ca śeṣāṇi aṅgāni iti yathā catur aṅgā senā evam pañca aṅgam dhyānam

original: prītyādayaḥ prasādaś ca, dvitīye 'ṅgacatuṣṭayam //7cd //
analyzed: prīti ādayaḥ prasādaḥ ca dvitīye ṅga catuṣṭayam

original: dvitīye dhyāne catvāry aṅgāni / adhyātmasaṃprasādaḥ prītiḥ sukhaṃ cittaikāgratā ca /
analyzed: dvitīye dhyāne catvāri aṅgāni adhyātma saṃprasādaḥ prītiḥ sukham citta ekāgra tā ca

original: tṛtīye pañca tūpekṣā, smṛtiḥ prajñā sukhaṃ sthitiḥ / (8ab)
analyzed: tṛtīye pañca tu upekṣā smṛtiḥ prajñā sukham sthitiḥ

original: tṛtīye tu dhyāne pañcāṅgāni / upekṣā smṛtiḥ saṃprajñānaṃ sukhaṃ samādhiś ca / samādhiparyāyo hi sthitiḥ / "samyaksamādhiḥ katamaḥ / yā cittasya sthitir" iti sūtre vacanāt /
analyzed: tṛtīye tu dhyāne pañcāṅgāni upekṣā smṛtiḥ saṃprajñānam sukham samādhiḥ ca samādhi paryāyaḥ hi sthitiḥ samyaksamādhiḥ katamaḥ yā cittasya sthitiḥ iti sūtre vacanāt

original: catvāry ante 'sukhāduḥkhopekṣāsmṛtisamādhayaḥ //8cd //
analyzed: catvāri ante sukha aduḥkha upekṣā smṛti samādhayaḥ

original: caturthaṃ dhyānam antyam / tatra catvāry aṅgāni / aduḥkhāsukhā vedanā upekṣāpariśuddhiḥ smṛtipariśuddhiḥ samādhiś ca / tāny etāny aṣṭādaśa dhyānāṅgāni bhavanti / prathamatṛtīyayoḥ pañcāṅgatvāt / dvitīyacaturthayorś caturaṅgatvāt / nāmata evam /
analyzed: caturtham dhyānam antyam tatra catvāri aṅgāni aduḥkha asukhā vedanā upekṣā pariśuddhiḥ smṛti pariśuddhiḥ samādhiḥ ca tāni etāni aṣṭādaśa dhyāna aṅgāni bhavanti prathama tṛtīyayoḥ pañca aṅga tvāt dvitīya caturthayoḥ catur aṅga tvāt nāmataḥ evam

original: dravyato daśa caikaṃ ca, (9a)
analyzed: dravyataḥ daśa ca ekam ca 9a

original: dravyata etāny ekādaśa bhavanti / prāthamadhyānikāni pañca / dvitīye 'dhyātmasaṃprasādo vardhate / tṛtīye upekṣāsmṛtisaṃprajñānasukhāni / caturthe 'duḥkhāsukhā vedaneti / ata evocyate yāny aṅgāni prathame dhyāne dvitīye 'pi tānīti catuṣkoṭikam / prathamā koṭir vitarkavicārau / dvitīyā adhyātmasaṃprasādaḥ / tṛtīyā prītiḥ sukhaṃ cittaikāgratā ca /
analyzed: dravyataḥ etāni ekādaśa bhavanti prāthamadhyānikāni pañca dvitīye dhyātma saṃprasādaḥ vardhate tṛtīye upekṣā smṛti saṃprajñāna sukhāni caturthe duḥkha asukhā vedanā iti atas eva ucyate yāni aṅgāni prathame dhyāne dvitīye tāni iti catuṣkoṭikam prathamā koṭiḥ vitarka vicārau dvitīyā adhyātma saṃprasādaḥ tṛtīyā prītiḥ sukham citta ekāgra tā ca

original: caturthī koṭir uktanirmuktā dharmā iti / evaṃ sarvāṇi dhyānāṅgāni parasparaṃ yojyāni / kasmāt tṛtīye dhyāne sukhaṃ dravyāntaram ucyate / yasmāt tad vedanāsukhaṃ dhyānayos tu,
analyzed: caturthī koṭiḥ ukta nirmuktāḥ dharmāḥ iti evam sarvāṇi dhyāna aṅgāni parasparam yojyāni kasmāt tṛtīye dhyāne sukham dravya antaram ucyate yasmāt tat vedanā sukham dhyānayoḥ tu

original: prasrabdhisukham ādyayoḥ / (9b)
analyzed: prasrabdhi sukham ādyayoḥ 9a

original: prathamadvitīyayos tu dhyānayoḥ prasrabdhisukham ity uktam / iha prasrabdhisukhaṃ tatra vedanāsukham iti kuta etat / dvayor dhyānasamāpattyoḥ sukhendiryāyogāt / na hi tat tayoḥ kāyikaṃ yujyate / samāpannasya vijñānakāyābhāvāt / nāpi caitasikaṃ prītivacanāt / prītir hi saumanasyam / na ca sukhasaumanasyayor yaugapadyam asti /
analyzed: prathama dvitīyayoḥ tu dhyānayoḥ prasrabdhi sukham iti uktam iha prasrabdhi sukham tatra vedanā sukham iti kutas etat dvayoḥ dhyāna samāpattyoḥ sukha indirya ayogāt na hi tat tayoḥ kāyikam yujyate samāpannasya vijñāna kāya abhāvāt na api caitasikam prīti vacanāt prītiḥ hi saumanasyam na ca sukha saumanasyayoḥ yaugapadyam asti

original: na cāpi tayoḥ paryāyeṇa dhyāne vṛttir yuktā pañcāṅgavacanād iti / [p.439]
analyzed: na ca api tayoḥ paryāyeṇa dhyāne vṛttiḥ yuktā pañcāṅga vacanāt iti

original: apare punar āhuḥ / nāsty eva caitasikaṃ sukendriyaṃ triṣv api hi dhyāneṣu / kāyikam eva sukham aṅgaṃ vyavasthāpitam iti / yat tarhi sūtra uktaṃ "sukhendriyaṃ katamat / yat sukhavedanīyena sparśena spṛṣṭasyotpadyate kāyikaṃ caitasikaṃ sātaṃ veditaṃ vedanāgatam idam ucyate sukhendriyam" iti / adhyāropita eṣa pāṭhaḥ /
analyzed: apare punar āhuḥ na asti eva caitasikam suka indriyam triṣu api hi dhyāneṣu kāyikam eva sukham aṅgam vyavasthāpitam iti yat tarhi sūtre uktam sukha indriyam katamat yat sukha vedanīyena sparśena spṛṣṭasya utpadyate kāyikam caitasikam sātam veditam vedanā gatam idam ucyate sukha indriyam iti adhyāropitaḥ eṣa pāṭhaḥ

original: kenāpi sarvanikāyāntareṣu kāyikam ity eva pāṭhāt / "sukhaṃ ca kāyena pratisaṃvedayata" iti svaśabdena vacanāc ca / manaskāyeneti cet / evam uktvā ko guṇaḥ / caturthe dhyāne prasrabdhibhūyastve 'pi sukhāvacanāc ca / sukhavedanānukūlā prasrabdhiḥ sukham iti cet / tṛtīye prasrabdhisukhāvacanaṃ kasmāt / upekṣopahatatvād iti cet / na /
analyzed: kena api sarva nikāya antareṣu kāyikam iti eva pāṭhāt sukham ca kāyena pratisaṃvedayate iti sva śabdena vacanāt ca manaskāyena iti ced evam uktvā kaḥ guṇaḥ caturthe dhyāne prasrabdhi bhūyas tve sukha a vacanāt ca sukha vedanā anukūlā prasrabdhiḥ sukham iti ced tṛtīye prasrabdhi sukha a vacanam kasmāt upekṣā upahata tvāt iti ced na

original: upekṣayaiva tadvṛddhiḥ / pūrvikābhyas tadviṣeṣāt / "yasmin samaye āryaśrāvakaḥ pravivekajāṃ prītiṃ kāyena sākṣātkṛtvopasaṃpadya viharatī"ty atra sūtre prasrabdhisukhayoḥ pṛthagvacanān na prasrabdhir eva sukham / samāpannasya kathaṃ kāyavijñānam iti cet / samādhiviśeṣajena prasrabdhisaṃjñakena sukhavedanīyena vāyunā kāyaspharaṇāt /
analyzed: upekṣayā eva tad vṛddhiḥ pūrvikābhyaḥ tad viṣeṣāt yasmin samaye ārya śrāvakaḥ praviveka jām prītim kāyena sākṣātkṛtvā upasaṃpadya viharati iti atra sūtre prasrabdhi sukhayoḥ pṛthak vacanāt na prasrabdhiḥ eva sukham samāpannasya katham kāya vijñānam iti ced samādhi viśeṣa jena prasrabdhi saṃjñakena sukha vedanīyena vāyunā kāya spharaṇāt

original: bahirvikṣepāt samādhibhraṃśa iti cet / na / samādhijasyāntaḥkāyasaṃbhūtasya kāyasukhasya samādhyanukūlatvāt / kāyavijñānakāle vyutthitaḥ syād iti cet / na / ata eva kāmāvacareṇa kāyendriyeṇa rūpāvacaraspraṣṭavyavijñānānutpattir iti cet / na / prasrabdhivijñānasyotpatteḥ / anāsrave api spraṣṭavyakāyavijñāne syātām /
analyzed: bahis vikṣepāt samādhi bhraṃśaḥ iti ced na samādhi jasya antaḥkāya saṃbhūtasya kāya sukhasya samādhi anukūla tvāt kāya vijñāna kāle vyutthitaḥ syāt iti ced na atas eva kāmāvacareṇa kāya indriyeṇa rūpāvacara spraṣṭavya vijñāna anutpattiḥ iti ced na prasrabdhi vijñānasya utpatteḥ anāsrave api spraṣṭavya kāya vijñāne syātām

original: mābhūt kiṃcid aṅgaṃ sāsravaṃ kiṃcid anāsravam iti cet / kāyikaprasrabdhibodhyaṅgavacanāt / iṣṭe bodhyaṅgānukūlatvād iti cet / anāsravatvam apy evam / "sāsravā dharmāḥ katame / cakṣur yāvad eva spraṣṭavyam" ity asya sūtrasya virodhād iti cet / na / anyaspraṣṭavyakāyavijñānābhisaṃdhivacanāt /
analyzed: mā abhūt kiṃcid aṅgam sa āsravam kiṃcid anāsravam iti ced kāyika prasrabdhi bodhyaṅga vacanāt iṣṭe bodhyaṅga anukūla tvāt iti ced anāsrava tvam api evam sa āsravāḥ dharmāḥ katame cakṣuḥ yāvat eva spraṣṭavyam iti asya sūtrasya virodhāt iti ced na anya spraṣṭavya kāya vijñāna abhisaṃdhi vacanāt

original: na cānāsrave kiṃcid aṅgaṃ sāsravaṃ kiṃcid anāsravaṃ syād iti cet / ayaugapadyāt ko doṣaḥ / sukhaprītyasamavadhānān na pañcāṅgaṃ syād iti cet / na saṃbhavaṃ praty upadeśād vitarkavicāravat / sādhyam iti cet / siddhaṃ cittasyaudārikasūkṣmatayor virodhāt doṣāvacanāc ca /
analyzed: na ca anāsrave kiṃcid aṅgam sa āsravam kiṃcid anāsravam syāt iti ced ayaugapadyāt kaḥ doṣaḥ sukha prīti asamavadhānāt na pañca aṅgam syāt iti ced na saṃbhavam prati upadeśāt vitarka vicāra vat sādhyam iti ced siddham cittasya audārika sūkṣmatayoḥ virodhāt doṣa avacanāt ca

original: tasmād yāny eva prathamadhyāne pañcāṅgāni teṣāṃ dvitricaturaṅgāpakarṣeṇa dvitīyādidhyānavyavasthānam / [p.440] ata eva ca prathame dhyāne pañcāṅgam aṅgatvam uktam / tad-apakarṣeṇottaradhyānavyavasthāpanāt / na tu sasṃjñādīnām aṅgatvam uktam / kim arthaṃ vā pañcānām evāngatvam uktam / upakārakatvād iti cet / na /
analyzed: tasmāt yāni eva prathama dhyāne pañcāṅgāni teṣām dvi tri catur aṅga apakarṣeṇa dvitīya ādi dhyāna vyavasthānam atas eva ca prathame dhyāne pañcāṅgam aṅga tvam uktam tad apakarṣeṇa uttara dhyāna vyavasthāpanāt na tu sasṃjñā ādīnām aṅga tvam uktam kim artham vā pañcānām eva anga tvam uktam upakāraka tvāt iti ced na

original: vitarka-vicārābhyāṃ smṛti-prajñayor upakārakataratvāt / asty eṣa ekeṣāṃ vādaḥ / naiva tu pūrvācāryā evaṃ nirdiśanti sma yāvantaḥ prajñāntam / tasmād vicāryam etat / adhyātma-saṃprasādo nāma ka eṣa dharmaḥ / vitarka-vicāra-kṣobha-virahāt praśāntavāhitā saṃtater adhyātmasaṃprasādaḥ /
analyzed: vitarka vicārābhyām smṛti prajñayoḥ upakārakatara tvāt asti eṣaḥ ekeṣām vādaḥ na eva tu pūrva ācāryāḥ evam nirdiśanti sma yāvantaḥ prajñāntam tasmāt vicāryam etat adhyātma saṃprasādaḥ nāma kaḥ eṣa dharmaḥ vitarka vicāra kṣobha virahāt praśānta vāhi tā saṃtateḥ adhyātma saṃprasādaḥ

original: sormikeva hi nadī vitarkavicāra-kṣobhitā saṃtatir aprasannā vartate iti / na tarhi sa dravyāntaram iti kathaṃ dravyata ekādaśāṅgāni bhavanti / tasmāt tarhi
analyzed: sa ūrmikā iva hi nadī vitarka vicāra kṣobhitā saṃtatiḥ aprasannā vartate iti na tarhi sa dravya antaram iti katham dravyataḥ ekādaśa aṅgāni bhavanti tasmāt tarhi

original: śraddhā prasādaḥ_ (9c)
analyzed: śraddhā prasādaḥ

original: tasya hi dvitīya-dhyāna-lābhāt samāhitabhūminiḥsaraṇe saṃpratyaya utpadyate / so 'trādhyātma-saṃprasāda iti / naiva hi vitarkavicārasamādhayo nāpy adhyātmasaṃprasādo dravyāntarāṇīty apare / katham asati dravyāntaratve caitasikatvaṃ sidhyati / avasthāviśeṣo hi nāma cetasaś caitasiko bhavati / na tv eṣa śāstra-siddhāntaḥ /
analyzed: tasya hi dvitīya dhyāna lābhāt samāhita bhūmi niḥsaraṇe saṃpratyayaḥ utpadyate saḥ trā adhyātma saṃprasādaḥ iti nā eva hi vitarka vicāra samādhayaḥ nā api adhyātma saṃprasādaḥ dravya antarāṇi iti apare katham asati dravya antara tve caitasika tvam sidhyati avasthā viśeṣaḥ hi nāma cetasaḥ caitasikaḥ bhavati na tu eṣa śāstra siddhāntaḥ

original: yad uktaṃ "prītir hi saumanasyam" iti / katham idaṃ gamyate / kim anyat bhavatu / yathecchanti nikāyāntarīyāḥ / dharmāntaram eva caitasikaṃ prītḥ saumanasyaṃ tu triṣv api dhyāneṣu sukham iti / na vai sukhaṃ dhyāneṣu saumanasyaṃ yujyate /
analyzed: yat uktam prītiḥ hi saumanasyam iti katham idam gamyate kim anyat bhavatu yathā icchanti nikāya antarīyāḥ dharma antaram eva caitasikam prītḥ saumanasyam tu triṣu api dhyāneṣu sukham iti na vai sukham dhyāneṣu saumanasyam yujyate

original: prītis tu, saumanasyaṃ dvidhāgamāt //9cd //
analyzed: prītiḥ tu saumanasyam dvidhā āgamāt

original: uktaṃ hi bhagavatā aviparītaka-sūtre tṛtīyaṃ dhyānam uktvā "atrāsyotpannaṃ saumanasyendiryam apariśeṣaṃ nirudhyata iti / caturthe ca dhyāne sukhendriyaṃ nirudhyata" ity uktam / punaś coktaṃ "sukhasya ca prahāṇāt duḥkhasya ca prahāṇāt pūrvam eva ca saumanasya-daurmanasyayor astaṃgamād" ity ato 'pi na tṛtīye dhyāne saumanasyendiryam asti /
analyzed: uktam hi bhagavatā aviparītaka sūtre tṛtīyam dhyānam uktvā atra asya utpannam saumanasya indiryam apariśeṣam nirudhyate iti caturthe ca dhyāne sukha indriyam nirudhyate iti uktam punar ca uktam sukhasya ca prahāṇāt duḥkhasya ca prahāṇāt pūrvam eva ca saumanasya daurmanasyayoḥ astaṃgamāt iti atas na tṛtīye dhyāne saumanasya indiryam asti

original: tasmāt prītir eva saumanasyaṃ na sukham / [p.441]
analyzed: tasmāt prītiḥ eva saumanasyam na sukham

original: kiṃ punaḥ kliṣteṣv api dhyāneṣu yathāvihitāny angāni bhavanti / na hi / kiṃ teṣu na vidyate /
analyzed: kim punar kliṣteṣu api dhyāneṣu yathā vihitāni angāni bhavanti na hi kim teṣu na vidyate

original: kliṣṭeṣv asat prītisukhaṃ prasādaḥ saṃpradhīḥ smṛtiḥ /
analyzed: kliṣṭeṣu asat prīti sukham prasādaḥ saṃpradhīḥ smṛtiḥ

original: upekṣāsmṛtiśuddhiś ca (10abc)
analyzed: upekṣā smṛti śuddhiḥ ca

original: prathame dhyāne vivekajaṃ prītisukhaṃ nāsti / kleśāviviktatvāt / dvitīye dhyāne 'dhyātmasaṃprasādo nāsti / kleśāvilatvāt / tṛtīye smṛtisaṃprajanyaṃ nāsti / kliṣṭasukhasaṃbhramitatvāt / caturthe upekṣāsmṛtipariśuddhir nāsti / kleśamalinatvāt /evaṃ tāvat kecid āhuḥ /
analyzed: prathame dhyāne viveka jam prīti sukham nā asti kleśa a vivikta tvāt dvitīye dhyāne dhyā ātma saṃprasādaḥ nā asti kleśa āvila tvāt tṛtīye smṛti saṃprajanyam nā asti kliṣṭa sukha saṃbhramita tvāt caturthe upekṣā smṛti pariśuddhiḥ nā asti kleśa malina tvāt evam tāvat kecid āhuḥ

original: kecit prasrabdhyupekṣaṇe //10d //
analyzed: kecid prasrabdhi upekṣaṇe

original: kecit punaḥ prathamadvitīyayoḥ kliṣṭayoḥ prasrabdhir nāsti / tṛtīyacaturthayor upekṣā nāsti / kuśalamahābhūmikatvād anayor iti / trīṇi ca dhyānāni señjitāni uktāni bhagavatā / sāpakṣālatvāt /
analyzed: kecid punar prathama dvitīyayoḥ kliṣṭayoḥ prasrabdhiḥ nā asti tṛtīya caturthayoḥ upekṣā nā asti kuśala mahābhūmika tvāt anayoḥ iti trīṇi ca dhyānāni sa iñjitāni uktāni bhagavatā sa apakṣāla tvāt

original: aṣṭāpakṣālam uktatvād āniñjaṃ tu caturthakam / (11ab)
analyzed: ukta tvāt āniñjam tu caturthakam

original: ke punas te 'pakṣālāḥ /
analyzed: ke punar te pakṣālāḥ

original: vitarkacārau śvāsau ca sukhādi ca catuṣṭayam //11cd //
analyzed: vitarka cārau śvāsau ca sukha ādi ca catuṣṭayam

original: vitarkavicārau sukhaduḥkhe saumanasyadaurmanasye śvāsapraśvāsāś ca / eṣām aṣṭānām eko 'py apakṣālaś caturthe nāsty atas tad āneñjyam uktam / vitarkavicāraprītisukhair akampanīyatvād āneñjyaṃ caturthaṃ dhyānaṃ sūtre nirvātapradīpanidarśanād ity apare /
analyzed: vitarka vicārau sukha duḥkhe saumanasya daurmanasye śvāsa praśvāsāḥ ca eṣām aṣṭānām ekaḥ pi apakṣālaḥ caturthe na asti atas tat āneñjyam uktam vitarka vicāra prīti sukhaiḥ akampanīya tvāt āneñjyam caturtham dhyānam sūtre nirvāta pradīpa nidarśanāt iti apare

original: dvayor dhyānayoḥ saumanasyam uktaṃ prītivacanāt / tṛtīye sukhaṃ caturthe upekṣā / tat kiṃ yā dhyānasamāpattiṣu vedanās tā eva dhyānopapattiṣu / nety āha / kiṃ tarhi / [p.442]
analyzed: dvayoḥ dhyānayoḥ saumanasyam uktam prīti vacanāt tṛtīye sukham caturthe upekṣā tat kim yāḥ dhyāna samāpattiṣu vedanāḥ tāḥ eva dhyāna upapattiṣu na iti āha kim tarhi

original: saumanasyasukhopekṣā upekṣāsumanaskate /
analyzed: saumanasya sukha upekṣāḥ upekṣā sumanaska te

original: atha vā ka evaṃ viparītatve doṣaḥ / akuśalatvam iti cet / na / kuśalamūlatvād vyāpādādipratipakṣatvāc ca / ukta eṣām ākāraḥ /

analyzed: maula dhyāna bhūmika tvāt adhimukti manaskāra tvāt sattva ālambana tvāt ca tad prayogeṇa tu vyāpāda ādi viṣkambhaṇāt tad pratipakṣa tvam uktam prahāṇa dūrīkaraṇāt ca kāmadhātu anāgamya bhūmikāni hi maitrī ādīni maula apramāṇa sadṛśāni saṃvidyante taiḥ tān viṣkambhya prahāṇa mārgaiḥ prajahāti tatas vīta rāga avasthāyām maula apramāṇa lābhāt

original: valavatpratyayalābhe 'pi tair anādhṛṣyo bhavati /

original: kathaṃ punar ādikarmiko maitryāṃ prayujyate / yathā sukhitam ātmānaṃ manyate parān vā śṛṇoti buddhabodhisattvāryaśrāvakāṃs tathā sattvānāṃ tatsukham adhimucyate, evaṃ "sukhitā vata santu sattvā" iti / na cec chaknoti kleśasyodbhūtavṛttitvāt sa mitrapakṣaṃ tridhā bhittvādhimātre tatsukham adhimucyate / tato madhye mṛdau ca /
analyzed: katham punar ādi karmikaḥ maitryām prayujyate yathā sukhitam ātmānam manyate parān vā śṛṇoti buddha bodhisattva ārya śrāvakān tathā sattvānām tat sukham adhimucyate evam sukhitāḥ vata santu sattvāḥ iti na ced śaknoti kleśasya udbhūta vṛtti tvāt sa mitra pakṣam tridhā bhittvā adhimātre tat sukham adhimucyate tatas madhye mṛdau ca

original: teṣu cet samāṃ maitrīṃ labhate tata udāsīnapakṣe / tataḥ śatrupakṣaṃ tridhā bhittvā mṛdau tat sukham adhimucyate / tato madhye 'dhimātre ca / tataś ced adhimātra iva mitrapakṣe sukhādhimokṣo na vyāvartate / tataḥ krameṇa grāmarāṣṭrasukhādhimokṣo yāvad ekāṃ diśaṃ yāvat sarvaṃ lokaṃ maitryā spharati /
analyzed: teṣu ced samām maitrīm labhate tatas udāsīna pakṣe tatas śatru pakṣam tridhā bhittvā mṛdau tat sukham adhimucyate tatas madhye dhimātre ca tatas ced adhimātre iva mitra pakṣe sukha adhimokṣaḥ na vyāvartate tatas krameṇa grāma rāṣṭra sukha adhimokṣaḥ yāvat ekām diśam yāvat sarvam lokam maitryā spharati

original: yas tu sarvaguṇagrāhī sa maitrīṃ kṣipram utpādayati / śakyaṃ hi samucchinnakuśalamūle 'pi guṇagrāhiṇā bhavituṃ pratyekabuddhe ca doṣagrāhiṇā pūrvaṃ puṇyāpuṇyaphalasaṃdarśanāt /
analyzed: yaḥ tu sarva guṇa grāhī sa maitrīm kṣipram utpādayati śakyam hi samucchinna kuśala mūle guṇa grāhiṇā bhavitum pratyekabuddhe ca doṣa grāhiṇā pūrvam puṇya apuṇya phala saṃdarśanāt

original: evaṃ karuṇāyāṃ muditāyāṃ ca prayujyate amī sattvā bahuvidhavyasanaughanimagnā apy evaṃ duḥkhād vimucyeran apy evātipramoderann ity adhimucyamāna upekṣāṃ tūdāsīnapakṣād ārabhate / etāni cāpramāṇāni,
analyzed: evam karuṇāyām muditāyām ca prayujyate amī sattvāḥ bahuvidha vyasana ogha nimagnāḥ api evam duḥkhāt vimucyeran api eva atipramoderan iti adhimucyamānaḥ upekṣām tu udāsīna pakṣāt ārabhate etāni ca apramāṇāni

original: kāraṇaṃ cāsya vaktavyam | asaṃskṛto vā | atas tīrthikadṛṣṭiprasaṅgo niṣprayojanatvaṃ ca | atha prajñaptitaḥ vayam apy evaṃ brūmaḥ | naiva hi dravyato 'sti nāpi prajñaptitaḥ | kiṃ tarhi | ādhyātmikānupāttān varttamānān skandhān upādāya pudgalaḥ prajñapyate | tad idam andhavacanam anunmīlitārthaṃ na budhyāmahe | kim idam upādāyeti |

original: yady ayam arthaḥ skandhānāṃ lakṣyate, teṣv eva pudgalaprajñaptiḥ prāpnoti | yathā rūpādīn ālambya teṣv eva kṣīraprajñaptiḥ | athāyam arthaḥ skandhān pratītyeti | skandhāṇāṃ pugalaprajñaptikāraṇāt | sa eva doṣaḥ | na sa evaṃ prajñapyate | kathaṃ tarhi | yatendhanam upādāyāgniḥ | [p.462] kathaṃ cendhanam upādāyāgniḥ prajñapyate |

original: na hi vinendhanenāgniḥ prajñapyate na cānya indhanād agniḥ śakyate prajñapayituṃ nāpy ananyaḥ | yadi hy anyaḥ syād anuṣṇam indhanaṃ syāt | athānanyaḥ syād dāhyam eva dāhakaṃ syāt | evaṃ na ca vinā skandhaiḥ pudgalaḥ prajñapyate | na cānyaḥ skandhebhyaḥ śakyate pratijñātuṃ śāśvataprasaṅgāt | nāpy ananya ucchedaprasaṅgād iti |
analyzed: na hi vinā indhanena agniḥ prajñapyate na ca anyaḥ indhanāt agniḥ śakyate prajñapayitum na api ananyaḥ yadi hi anyaḥ syāt anuṣṇam indhanam syāt atha ananyaḥ syāt dāhyam eva dāhakam syāt evam na ca vinā skandhaiḥ pudgalaḥ prajñapyate na ca anyaḥ skandhebhyaḥ śakyate pratijñātum śāśvata prasaṅgāt na api ananyaḥ uccheda prasaṅgāt iti

original: aṅga tāvad brūhi kim indhanaṃ ko 'gnir iti | tato jñāsyāmaḥ katham indhanam upādāyāgniḥ prajñapyata iti | kim atra vaktavyaṃ dāhyam indhanam dāhako 'gniḥ | etad evātra vaktavyaṃ kiṃ dāhyaṃ ko dāhaka iti | loke hi tāvad apradīptaṃ kāṣṭhādikam indhanam ucyate dāhyaṃ ca |pradīptam agnir dāhakaś ca |

original: yadi caivaṃ pudgalaḥ skandhān pratītyotpadyate sa tebhyo 'nyaś cānityaś ca prāpnoti | atha punas tatraiva kāṣṭhādau pradīpte yad auṣṇyaṃ tad agnis tat sahajātāni trīṇi bhūtānīndhanam iṣyante | tayor api siddham anyatvaṃ lakṣaṇabhedāt |
analyzed: yadi ca evam pudgalaḥ skandhān pratītya utpadyate sa tebhyaḥ nyaḥ ca anityaḥ ca prāpnoti atha punar tatra eva kāṣṭha ādau pradīpte yat auṣṇyam tat agniḥ tat sahajātāni trīṇi bhūtāni indhanam iṣyante tayoḥ api siddham anya tvam lakṣaṇa bhedāt

original: upādāyārthas tu vaktavyaḥ | kathaṃ tad indhanam upādāya so 'gniḥ prajñyapyata iti | na hi tat tasya kāraṇaṃ nāpi tatprajñapteḥ | agnir eva hi tatprajñapteḥ kāraṇam | yady āśrayārtha upādāyārthaḥ sahabhāvārtho vā | skandhā apy evaṃ pudgalasyāśrayasahabhūtāḥ prāpnuvantīti vispaṣṭam anyatvaṃ pratijñāyate | tadabhāve ca pudgalābhāvaḥ prāpnoti |

original: indhanābhāva ivāgnyabhāvaḥ |

analyzed: yat tu tat uktam yadi indhanāt anyaḥ gniḥ syāt anuṣṇam eva indhanam anya bhūta svabhāva tvāt atha yat auṣṇya vat anyat api tad uṣṇa svabhāvāt agneḥ uṣṇam sidhyati auṣṇya yogāt iti na asti anya tve doṣaḥ atha punar sarvam eva tat pradīptam kāṣṭha ādikam indhanam ca agniḥ ca iṣyate

original: tadupādāyārthaś ca vaktavyaḥ | skandhā eva ca pudgalā ity ananyatvam anivāryaṃ prāpnoti | tasmān na sidhyaty etat | yathendhanam upādāyāgniḥ prajñapyate evaṃ skandhān upādāya pudgalaḥ iti | yadi [p.463] cāyam anyaḥ skandhebhyo na vaktavyaḥ ''pañcavidhaṃ jñeyam atītānāgataṃ pratyutpannam asaṃskṛtam avaktavyam'' iti na vaktavyaṃ prāpnoti |
analyzed: tad upādāya arthaḥ ca vaktavyaḥ skandhāḥ eva ca pudgalāḥ iti ananyatvam anivāryam prāpnoti tasmāt na sidhyati etat yathā indhanam upādāya agniḥ prajñapyate evam skandhān upādāya pudgalaḥ iti yadi ca ayam anyaḥ skandhebhyaḥ na vaktavyaḥ pañcavidham jñeyam atīta anāgatam pratyutpannam asaṃskṛtam avaktavyam iti na vaktavyam prāpnoti

original: naiva hi tad atītādibhyaḥ pañcamaṃ nāpañcamaṃ vaktavyam | yadā ca pudgalaḥ prajñapyate kiṃ tāvat skandhān upalabhya prajñapyate āhosvit pudgalam | yadi tāvat skandhāṃs teṣv eva pudgalaprajñaptiḥ prāpnoti | pudgalasyānupalambhāt | atha pudgalaṃ katham asya skandhān upādāya prajñaptir bhavati | pudgala eva hi tasyā upādānaṃ prāpnoti |
analyzed: na eva hi tat atīta ādibhyaḥ pañcamam na apañcamam vaktavyam yadā ca pudgalaḥ prajñapyate kim tāvat skandhān upalabhya prajñapyate āhosvit pudgalam yadi tāvat skandhān teṣu eva pudgala prajñaptiḥ prāpnoti pudgalasya anupalambhāt atha pudgalam katham asya skandhān upādāya prajñaptiḥ bhavati pudgalaḥ eva hi tasyāḥ upādānam prāpnoti

original: atha mataṃ satsu skandheṣu pudgala upalabhyate, tataḥ skandhān upādāyāsya prajñaptir ucyata iti | tad evaṃ rūpasyāpi cakṣurmanaskārālokeṣu satsūpalambhāt tān upādāya prajñaptir vaktavyā | rūpavac ca pudgalasyānyatvaṃ spaṣṭam |
analyzed: atha matam satsu skandheṣu pudgalaḥ upalabhyate tatas skandhān upādāya asya prajñaptiḥ ucyate iti tat evam rūpasya api cakṣuḥ manaskāra ālokeṣu satsu upalambhāt tān upādāya prajñaptiḥ vaktavyā rūpa vat ca pudgalasya anya tvam spaṣṭam

original: idaṃ tāvad vaktavyam | ṣaṇṇāṃ vijñānānāṃ katamena pudgalo vijñeyaḥ | ṣaḍbhir apīty ucyate | kathaṃ kṛtvā | cakṣurvijñeyāni ced rūpāṇi pratītya pudgalaṃ pratibhāvayati cakṣurvijñeyaḥ pudgalo vaktavyaḥ no tu vaktavyo rūpāṇi vā no vā |
analyzed: idam tāvat vaktavyam ṣaṇṇām vijñānānām katamena pudgalaḥ vijñeyaḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ api iti ucyate katham kṛtvā cakṣuḥ vijñeyāni ced rūpāṇi pratītya pudgalam pratibhāvayati cakṣuḥ vijñeyaḥ pudgalaḥ vaktavyaḥ no tu vaktavyaḥ rūpāṇi vā no vā

original: evaṃ yāvat manovijñeyān ced dharmān pratītya pudgalaṃ prativibhāvayati manovijñeyaḥ pudgalo vaktavyo no tu vaktavyo dharmā vā no vā | evaṃ tarhi kṣīrādibhiḥ samānaḥ prāpnoti | cakṣurvijñeyāni cedr rūpāṇi pratītya kṣīraṃ vibhāvayaty udakaṃ vā cakṣurvijñeyaṃ kṣīram udakaṃ ceti vaktavyaṃ no tu vaktavyaṃ rūpāṇi vā no vā |
analyzed: evam yāvat manaḥ vijñeyān ced dharmān pratītya pudgalam prativibhāvayati manaḥ vijñeyaḥ pudgalaḥ vaktavyaḥ no tu vaktavyaḥ dharmāḥ vā no vā evam tarhi kṣīra ādibhiḥ samānaḥ prāpnoti cakṣuḥ vijñeyāni ced rūpāṇi pratītya kṣīram vibhāvayati udakam vā cakṣuḥ vijñeyam kṣīram udakam ca iti vaktavyam no tu vaktavyam rūpāṇi vā no vā

original: evaṃ ghrāṇajihvākāyavijñeyaṃ vaktavyaṃ no tu vaktavyaṃ spraṣṭavyāni vā no vā | mā bhūt kṣīrodakayoś catuṣṭvaprasa~ga iti | ato yathā rūpādīny eva kṣīram udakaṃ vā prajñapyate samastāny evaṃ skandhāḥ pudgala iti siddham |
analyzed: evam ghrāṇa jihvā kāya vijñeyam vaktavyam no tu vaktavyam spraṣṭavyāni vā no vā mā bhūt kṣīra udakayoḥ catuṣṭva prasagaḥ iti atas yathā rūpa ādīni eva kṣīram udakam vā prajñapyate samastāni evam skandhāḥ pudgalaḥ iti siddham

original: yac cocyate cakṣurvijñeyāni rūpāṇi pratītya pudgalaṃ prativibhāvayatīti | ko 'sya vākyasyārthaḥ | kiṃ tāvad rūpāṇi pudgalopalabdheḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavatīti āhosvid rūpāṇy upalabhamānaḥ pudgalam upalabhata iti | yadi rūpāṇi pudgalopalabdheḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavanti sa ca tebhyo 'nyo na vaktavyaḥ |
analyzed: yat ca ucyate cakṣuḥ vijñeyāni rūpāṇi pratītya pudgalam prativibhāvayati iti kaḥ sya vākyasya arthaḥ kim tāvat rūpāṇi pudgala upalabdheḥ kāraṇam bhavati iti āhosvit rūpāṇi upalabhamānaḥ pudgalam upalabhate iti yadi rūpāṇi pudgala upalabdheḥ kāraṇam bhavanti sa ca tebhyaḥ nyaḥ na vaktavyaḥ

original: evaṃ tarhi rūpam apy ālokacakṣurmanaskārebhyo 'nyan na vaktavyam | teṣāṃ tadupalabdhikāraṇatvāt | atha rūpāṇy upalabhamānaḥ pudgalam upalabhate | kiṃ tayaivopalbdhyopalabhate āhosvid anyayā | yadi tayaiva | rūpād abhinnasvabhāvaḥ pudgalaḥ prāṇoti rūpa eva vā tatprajñaptiḥ | idaṃ ca rūpam ayaṃ pudgalaḥ katham idaṃ gamyate |
analyzed: evam tarhi rūpam api āloka cakṣuḥ manaskārebhyaḥ na vaktavyam teṣām tad upalabdhi kāraṇa tvāt atha rūpāṇi upalabhamānaḥ pudgalam upalabhate kim tayā eva upalbdhyā upalabhate āhosvit anyayā yadi tayā eva rūpāt abhinna svabhāvaḥ pudgalaḥ prāṇoti rūpe eva vā tad prajñaptiḥ idam ca rūpam ayam pudgalaḥ katham idam gamyate

original: athaivaṃ na paricchidyate | katham idaṃ pratijñāyate [p.464] rūpam apy asti pudgalo 'py astīti | upalabdhivaśena hi tasyāstitvaṃ pratijñāyate | evaṃ yāvad dharmebhyo vaktavyam | athanyayā bhinnakālopalambhād anyo rūpāt prāpnoti | nīlād iva pītaṃ kṣaṇād iva ca kṣaṇāntaram | evaṃ yāvad dharmebhyo vaktavyam |
analyzed: atha evam na paricchidyate katham idam pratijñāyate rūpam api asti asti iti upalabdhi vaśena hi tasya astitvam pratijñāyate evam yāvat dharmebhyaḥ vaktavyam atha anyayā bhinna kāla upalambhāt anyaḥ rūpāt prāpnoti nīlāt iva pītam kṣaṇāt iva ca kṣaṇa antaram evam yāvat dharmebhyaḥ vaktavyam

original: atha rūpapudgalavat tadupalabhdhyor apy anyānanyatvam avaktavyam | tena tarhi saṃskṛte 'py avaktavyaṃ bhavatīti siddhantabhedaḥ | yadi cāyam asti no tu vaktavyo rūpāṇi vā no vā | kiṃ tarhi bhagavatoktaṃ ''rūpam anātmā yāvad vijñānam nātme''ti |
analyzed: atha rūpa pudgala vat tad upalabhdhyoḥ api anya ananyatvam avaktavyam tena tarhi saṃskṛte pi avaktavyam bhavati iti siddhanta bhedaḥ yadi ca ayam asti no tu vaktavyaḥ rūpāṇi vā no vā kim tarhi bhagavatā uktam rūpam anātmā yāvat vijñānam na ātmā iti

original: yena cāyaṃ cakṣurvijñānena pudgala upalabhyate | kiṃ tad rūpāṇi pratītyotpadyate āhosvit pudgalam ubhayaṃ vā | yadi rūpāṇi pratītyotpadyate | notsahiṣyate pudgalaṃ vijñātuṃ śabdādivat | yam eva hi viṣayaṃ cakṣurjñāneṣu pratītyotpadyate vijñānaṃ sa eva tasyālambanapratyayaḥ | atha pudgalaṃ pratītyotpadyate ubhayaṃ vā | idam utsūtram |
analyzed: yena ca ayam cakṣuḥ vijñānena pudgalaḥ upalabhyate kim tat rūpāṇi pratītya utpadyate āhosvit pudgalam ubhayam vā yadi rūpāṇi pratītya utpadyate na utsahiṣyate pudgalam vijñātum śabda ādi vat yam eva hi viṣayam cakṣuḥ jñāneṣu pratītya utpadyate vijñānam saḥ eva tasya ālambana pratyayaḥ atha pudgalam pratītya utpadyate ubhayam vā idam utsūtram

original: sūtre hi nirdhāritaṃ dvayaṃ pratītya vijñānasyotpādo bhavatīti | tathā ''cakṣur bhikṣo hetū rūpāṇi pratyayaś cakṣurvijñānasyotpādāya | tat kasya hetoḥ | yat kiṃcit bhikṣo cakṣurvijñānaṃ sarvaṃ tac cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpāṇi ce''ti | anityaś ca pudgala evaṃ prāpnoti | ''ye hi hetavo ye pratyayā vijñānasyotpādāya te 'py anityā'' iti sūtre vacanāt |
analyzed: sūtre hi nirdhāritam dvayam pratītya vijñānasya utpādaḥ bhavati iti tathā cakṣuḥ bhikṣo hetuḥ rūpāṇi pratyayaḥ cakṣuḥ vijñānasya utpādāya tat kasya hetoḥ yat kiṃcid bhikṣo cakṣuḥ vijñānam sarvam tat cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpāṇi ca iti anityaḥ ca pudgalaḥ evam prāpnoti ye hi hetavaḥ ye pratyayāḥ vijñānasya utpādāya te pi anityāḥ iti sūtre vacanāt

original: atha pudgalo na tasyālambanaṃ na tarhi tena vijñeyaḥ |
analyzed: atha pudgalaḥ na tasya ālambanam na tarhi tena vijñeyaḥ

original: yadi ca pudgalaḥ ṣaḍvijñānavijñeyaḥ pratijñāyate | sa śrotravijñānavijñeyatvād rūpādanyaḥ prāṇoti śabdavat | cakṣurvijñānavijñeyatvāc chabdād anyaḥ prāpnoti rūpavat | evam anyebhyo 'pi yojyam | idaṃ ca sūtrapadaṃ vādhitaṃ bhavati | ''yānīmāni brāhmaṇa pañcendriyāṇi nānāgocarāṇi nānāviṣayāṇi svaṃ svaṃ gocaraviṣayaṃ pratyanubhavanti |
analyzed: yadi ca pudgalaḥ ṣaṣ vijñāna vijñeyaḥ pratijñāyate sa śrotra vijñāna vijñeya tvāt rūpāt anyaḥ prāṇoti śabda vat cakṣuḥ vijñāna vijñeya tvāt śabdāt anyaḥ prāpnoti rūpa vat evam anyebhyaḥ yojyam idam ca sūtra padam vādhitam bhavati yāni imāni brāhmaṇa pañca indriyāṇi nānā gocarāṇi nānā viṣayāṇi svam svam gocara viṣayam pratyanubhavanti

original: nānyad anyasya gocaraviṣayaṃ pratyanubhavati | tadyathā cakṣurindriyaṃ śrotrendriyaṃ ghrāṇendriyaṃ jihvendriyaṃ kāyendriyam | mana eṣāṃ pañcānām indriyāṇāṃ gocaraviṣayaṃ pratyanubhavati manaś caiṣāṃ pratisaraṇam'' iti | na vā pudgalo viṣayaḥ | na ced viṣayo na tarhi vijñeyaḥ | yady evaṃ manaindriyasyāpy avyabhicāraḥ prāpnoti |
analyzed: na anyat anyasya gocara viṣayam pratyanubhavati tat yathā cakṣuḥ indriyam śrotra indriyam ghrāṇa indriyam jihvā indriyam kāya indriyam manaḥ eṣām pañcānām indriyāṇām gocara viṣayam pratyanubhavati manaḥ ca eṣām pratisaraṇam iti na vā pudgalaḥ viṣayaḥ na ced viṣayaḥ na tarhi vijñeyaḥ yadi evam manaḥ indriyasya api avyabhicāraḥ prāpnoti

original: ''ṣaḍ imānīndriyāṇi nānāgocarāṇi nānāviṣayāṇi svaṃ svaṃ gocaraviṣayam ākāṅkṣantī''ty uktaṃ ṣaṭprāṇakopame | na tatrendriyam evendriyaṃ kṛtvoktam | pañcānāṃ [p.465] darśanādy ākāṅkṣaṇāsaṃbhavāt tadvijñānānāṃ ca | atas tadādhipatyādhyākṛtam atra manovijñānendriyaṃ kṛtvoktam |
analyzed: ṣaḍ imāni indriyāṇi nānā gocarāṇi nānā viṣayāṇi svam svam gocara viṣayam ākāṅkṣanti iti uktam ṣaṭprāṇakopame na tatra indriyam eva indriyam kṛtvā uktam pañcānām darśana ādi ākāṅkṣaṇa asaṃbhavāt tad vijñānānām ca atas tad ādhipatya adhyākṛtam atra manaḥ vijñāna indriyam kṛtvā uktam

original: yac ca tat kevalaṃ manāadhipatyādhyākṛtaṃ manovijñānaṃ naiva tadanyeṣāṃ viṣayam ākāṅkṣaty ato nāsty eṣa doṣaḥ | uktaṃ ca bhagavatā ''sarvābhijñeyaṃ vo bhikṣavo dharmaparyāyaṃ deśayiṣyāmī''ty uktvā cakṣrabhijñeyaṃ rūpāṇi cakṣurvijñānaṃ cakṣuḥsaṃsparśo yad api tac cakṣuḥsaṃsparśapratyayam adhyātmam utpadyate veditaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā aduḥkhāsukhaṃ
analyzed: yat ca tat kevalam manaḥ adhipatya adhyākṛtam manaḥ vijñānam na eva tat anyeṣām viṣayam ākāṅkṣati atas na asti eṣa doṣaḥ uktam ca bhagavatā sarva abhijñeyam vaḥ bhikṣavaḥ dharmaparyāyam deśayiṣyāmi iti uktvā cakṣuḥ abhijñeyam rūpāṇi cakṣuḥ vijñānam cakṣuḥ saṃsparśaḥ yat api tat cakṣuḥ saṃsparśa pratyayam adhyātmam utpadyate veditam sukham duḥkham vā aduḥkha asukham

original: vā yāvat manaḥsaṃsparśapratyayam | ayam ucyate sarvābhijñeyaparijñeyo dharmaparyāyaḥ'' iti | ata etāvad evābhijñeyaṃ pratijñeyaṃ cety avadhāryate na pudgalaḥ | tasmād vijñeyo 'py asau na bhavati | prajñāvijñānayoḥ samānaviṣayatvāt | cakṣuṣā ca pudgalaṃ paśyāma iti paśyantaḥ paudgalikā anātmanā ātmānaṃ paśyāma iti dṛṣṭisthānam āpannā bhavanti |
analyzed: vā yāvat manaḥ saṃsparśa pratyayam ayam ucyate sarva abhijñeya parijñeyaḥ dharmaparyāyaḥ iti atas etāvat eva abhijñeyam pratijñeyam ca iti avadhāryate na pudgalaḥ tasmāt vijñeyaḥ pi asau na bhavati prajñā vijñānayoḥ samāna viṣaya tvāt cakṣuṣā ca pudgalam paśyāmaḥ iti paśyantaḥ paudgalikāḥ anātmanā ātmānam paśyāmaḥ iti dṛṣṭi sthānam āpannāḥ bhavanti

original: sūtre ca bhagavatā nītam etat | ''skandheṣv eva pudgalākhye''ti mānuṣyakasūtram | ''cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpāṇi cotpadyate cakṣurvijñānaṃ trayāṇāṃ saṃnipātaḥ sparśaḥ sparśasahajātā vedanā saṃjñā cetanā itīme catvāro rūpiṇaḥ skandhāś cakṣurindriyaṃ ca rūpam etāvan manuṣyatvam ucyate |
analyzed: sūtre ca bhagavatā nītam etat skandheṣu eva pudgala ākhyā iti mānuṣyaka sūtram cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpāṇi ca utpadyate cakṣuḥ vijñānam trayāṇām saṃnipātaḥ sparśaḥ sparśa sahajātā vedanā saṃjñā cetanā iti ime catvāraḥ rūpiṇaḥ skandhāḥ cakṣuḥ indriyam ca rūpam etāvat manuṣya tvam ucyate

original: atreyaṃ saṃjñā sattvo naro manuṣyo mānavaś ca poṣaḥ puruṣaḥ pudgalo jīvo jantur iti | atreyaṃ pratijñā ahaṃ cakṣuṣā rūpāṇi paśyāmīti | atrāyaṃ vyavahāra ity api sa āyuṣmān evaṃnāmā evaṃjātya evaṃgotra evamāhāra evaṃsukhaduḥkhapratisaṃvedī evaṃdīrghāyur evaṃcirasthitika evamāyuḥparyanta iti |
analyzed: atrā iyam saṃjñā sattvaḥ naraḥ manuṣyaḥ mānavaḥ ca poṣaḥ puruṣaḥ pudgalaḥ jīvaḥ jantuḥ iti atrā iyam pratijñā aham cakṣuṣā rūpāṇi paśyāmi iti atrā ayam vyavahāraḥ iti api saḥ āyuṣmān evaṃnāmā evaṃjātyaḥ evaṃgotraḥ evam āhāraḥ evam sukha duḥkha pratisaṃvedī evam dīrgha āyuḥ evam cirasthitikaḥ evam āyuḥ paryantaḥ iti

original: iti hi bhikṣavaḥ saṃjñāmātrakam evaitad vyavahāramātrakam evaitat | sarva ime dharmāḥ anityāḥ saṃskṛtāś ceti tāḥ pratītyasamutpannā iti | nītārthaṃ ca sūtraṃ pratisaraṇam uktaṃ bhagavatā | tasmān na punaṇ parīkṣyate | tathā coktaṃ ''sarvam astīti brāhmaṇa yāvad eva dvādaśāyatanānī''ti | yadi cāyaṃ pudgalo nāyatanaṃ na so 'stīti siddham |
analyzed: iti hi bhikṣavaḥ saṃjñā mātrakam eva etat vyavahāra mātrakam eva etat sarve ime dharmāḥ anityāḥ saṃskṛtāḥ ca iti tāḥ pratītyasamutpannāḥ iti nīta artham ca sūtram pratisaraṇam uktam bhagavatā tasmāt na punar parīkṣyate tathā ca uktam sarvam asti iti brāhmaṇa yāvat eva dvādaśa āyatanāni iti yadi ca ayam pudgalaḥ na āyatanam na saḥ sti iti siddham

original: athāyatanaṃ na tarhy avaktavyaḥ | teṣām api caivaṃ paśyato ''yāvatā bhikṣo cakṣur yāvatā rūpāṇi vistareṇa etāvatā bhikṣo tathāgataḥ sarvaṃ ca prajñāpayati sarvaprajñaptiṃ ce'' ti |
analyzed: atha āyatanam na tarhi a vaktavyaḥ teṣām api ca evam paśyataḥ yāvatā bhikṣo cakṣuḥ yāvatā rūpāṇi vistareṇa etāvatā bhikṣo tathāgataḥ sarvam ca prajñāpayati sarva prajñaptim ca iti

original: bimbisārasūtre coktam ''ātmā ātmeti bhikṣavo bālo 'śrutavān pṛthagjanaḥ prajñaptim anupatito na tv atrātmā vā ātmīyaṃ vā duḥkham idam utpadyamānam utpadyate'' iti vistaraḥ | śailayāpy arhantyā māram ārabhyoktaṃ, [p.466]
analyzed: bimbisārasūtre ca uktam ātmā ātmā iti bhikṣavaḥ śrutavān pṛthagjanaḥ prajñaptim anupatitaḥ na tu atra ātmā vā ātmīyam vā duḥkham idam utpadyamānam utpadyate iti vistaraḥ śailayā api arhantyā māram ārabhya uktam

original: manyase kiṃ nu sattveti,
analyzed: manyase kim nu sattva iti

original: māradṛṣṭigataṃ hi te |
analyzed: māra dṛṣṭi gatam hi te

original: śūnyaḥ saṃskārapuñjo 'yaṃ,
analyzed: śūnyaḥ saṃskāra puñjaḥ yaṃ

original: na hi sattvo 'tra vidyate ||
analyzed: na hi vidyate

original: yathaiva hy aṅgasaṃbhārāt,
analyzed: yathā eva hi aṅga saṃbhārāt

original: saṃjñā ratha iti smṛtā |
analyzed: saṃjñā rathaḥ iti smṛtā

original: evaṃ skandhān upādāya,
analyzed: evam skandhān upādāya

original: kasmāt bhagavatāpi noktaṃ nāsty eveti | praṣṭur āśayāpekṣayā | sa hi yasyāpi skandhasaṃtānasya jīva ity ākhyā tasyāpy abhavaṃ pratīyād iti mithyādṛṣṭiṃ pātitaḥ syāt | pratītyasamutpādasyājñānāt | [p.470] sa ca taddeśanāyā akṣamaḥ | itaś caitad evaṃ niścīyate |
analyzed: kasmāt bhagavatā api nā uktam na asti eva iti praṣṭuḥ āśaya apekṣayā sa hi yasya api skandha saṃtānasya jīvaḥ iti ākhyā tasya api abhavam pratīyāt iti mithyādṛṣṭim pātitaḥ syāt pratītyasamutpādasya ajñānāt sa ca tad deśanāyāḥ akṣamaḥ itas ca etat evam niścīyate

original: yat bhagavatoktam ''asty ātmety ānanda vatsasagotrāya parivrājakāya praśnaṃ pṛṣṭo vyākuryāṃ nanv akalpaṃ syād vacanāya sarvadharmā anātmāna iti | nāsty ātmety ānanda vatsasagotrāya parivrājakāya praśnaṃ pṛṣṭo vyākuryāṃ nanu vatsasagotraḥ parivrājakaḥ pūrvam eva saṃmūḍho bhūyasyā mātrayā saṃmoham āpadyeta abhūt me ātmā sa me etarhi nāstīti |
analyzed: yat bhagavatā uktam asti ātmā iti ānanda vatsa sagotrāya parivrājakāya praśnam pṛṣṭaḥ vyākuryām nanu akalpam syāt vacanāya sarva dharmāḥ anātmānaḥ iti na asti ātmā iti ānanda vatsa sagotrāya parivrājakāya praśnam pṛṣṭaḥ vyākuryām nanu vatsa sagotraḥ parivrājakaḥ pūrvam eva saṃmūḍhaḥ bhūyasyā mātrayā saṃmoham āpadyeta abhūt me ātmā sa me etarhi na asti iti

original: śāśvatalokādīnām apy avyākaraṇaṃ praṣṭur āśayāpekṣayā | yadi hi tāvad ātmā loka iṣṭaḥ syāt tasyābhāvād ayuktaṃ caturdhā vyākaraṇam | atha sarva eva saṃsāro lokas tasyāpy ayuktam | [p.471] śāśvate loke" na kasyacit parinirvāṇaṃ prāpnuyāt | aśāśvate sarveṣām ucchedaḥ prāpnuyāt | ubhayathātve niyamata ekeṣāṃ parinirvāṇaṃ prāpnuyāt ekeṣāṃ na |
analyzed: śāśvata loka ādīnām api avyākaraṇam praṣṭuḥ āśaya apekṣayā yadi hi tāvat ātmā lokaḥ iṣṭaḥ syāt tasya abhāvāt ayuktam caturdhā vyākaraṇam atha sarvaḥ eva saṃsāraḥ lokaḥ tasya api ayuktam śāśvate loke na kasyacid parinirvāṇam prāpnuyāt aśāśvate sarveṣām ucchedaḥ prāpnuyāt ubhayathātve niyamataḥ ekeṣām parinirvāṇam prāpnuyāt ekeṣām na ayuktam

original: anubhayathatve naiva parinirvāṇaṃ nāparinirvāṇaṃ prāpnuyāt | ato mārgādhīinatvāt parinirvāṇasya caturdhāpi niyamo na vyākriyate nirgranthaśrāvakacaṭakavat | ata evāntavān loka iti catuṣkāvyākaraṇam | tulyārtho hy eṣa catuṣkaḥ |
analyzed: na eva parinirvāṇam na aparinirvāṇam prāpnuyāt atas parinirvāṇasya caturdhā api niyamaḥ na vyākriyate nirgrantha śrāvaka caṭaka vat atas eva antavān lokaḥ iti catuṣka avyākaraṇam tulya arthaḥ hi eṣa catuṣkaḥ

original: tathā hi muktikaḥ parivrājaka eva catuṣkaṃ pṛṣṭvā punaḥ pṛṣṭavān kiṃ nu sarvo loko 'nena mārgeṇa niryāty āhosvid ekadeśo lokasyeti | sthavira ānanda āha ''yam eva tvaṃ muktika tatprathamato bhagavantaṃ praśnaṃ pṛṣṭavāṃs tam evaitarhi pṛcchasy anena paryāyeṇe''ti sarvam |
analyzed: tathā hi muktikaḥ parivrājakaḥ eva catuṣkam pṛṣṭvā punar pṛṣṭavān kim nu sarvaḥ lokaḥ nena mārgeṇa niryāti āhosvit eka deśaḥ lokasya iti sthaviraḥ ānandaḥ āha yam eva tvam muktika tad prathamatas bhagavantam praśnam pṛṣṭavān tam eva etarhi pṛcchasi anena paryāyeṇa iti sarvam

original: bhavati tathāgataḥ paraṃ maraṇād ity api catuṣkaḥ praṣṭur āśayāpekṣayā na vyākṛtaḥ | sa hi muktvāmānaṃ' tathāgataṃ kṛtvā pṛṣṭavān |
analyzed: bhavati tathāgataḥ param maraṇāt iti api catuṣkaḥ praṣṭuḥ āśaya apekṣayā na vyākṛtaḥ sa hi muktvā amānam tathāgatam kṛtvā pṛṣṭavān

original: paudgalikas tu paryanuyojyaḥ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ bhagavān jīvantaṃ pudgalam astīti vyākaroti paraṃ maraṇān na vyākarotīti | śāśvatadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ | idaṃ tarhi kasmād vyākaroti ''bhaviṣyasi tvaṃ maitreyānāgate 'dhvani tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddha'' iti | kasmāc ca śrāvakam abhyatītaṃ kālagatam upapattau vyākaroty amuko 'mutropapanna iti |
analyzed: paudgalikaḥ tu paryanuyojyaḥ kim kāraṇam bhagavān jīvantam pudgalam asti iti vyākaroti param maraṇāt na vyākaroti iti śāśvata doṣa prasaṅgaḥ idam tarhi kasmāt vyākaroti bhaviṣyasi tvam maitreya anāgate dhvani tathāgataḥ rhan samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ iti kasmāt ca śrāvakam abhyatītam kālagatam upapattau vyākaroti amukaḥ mutrā upapannaḥ iti

original: evam api hi śāśvatatvaprasaṅgaḥ | yadi ca bhagavān pūrvaṃ pudgalaṃ dṛṣṭvā parinirvṛtaṃ punaḥ na paśyaty ajñānān na vyākarotīti sarvajñatvaṃ śāstur utpāditaṃ bhavati na vā so 'stīty abhyupagantavyam | atha paśyaty anucyamāno 'py asāv asti śāśvataś ceti siddhaṃ bhavati | athaitad api na vaktavyaṃ paśyati vā na veti |
analyzed: evam api hi śāśvata tva prasaṅgaḥ yadi ca bhagavān pūrvam pudgalam dṛṣṭvā parinirvṛtam punar na paśyati ajñānāt na vyākaroti iti sarvajña tvam śāstuḥ utpāditam bhavati na vā saḥ u sti iti abhyupagantavyam atha paśyati anucyamānaḥ pi asau asti śāśvataḥ ca iti siddham bhavati atha etat api na vaktavyam paśyati vā na vā iti

original: evaṃ tarhi idam api śanaiḥ śanair avaktavyaṃ kriyatāṃ sarvajño vā na vā bhagavān na veti | asty eva pudgalo yasmāt satyataḥ sthitito nāsti me ātmeti dṛṣṭisthānam uktam | astīty api dṛṣṭisthānam uktam | tasmād ajñāpakam etat | ubhayam api tv etad antagrāhadṛṣṭiśāśvatocchedadṛṣṭisaṃgṛhītam ity ābhidhārmikāḥ | tathaiva ca yuktam |
analyzed: evam tarhi idam api śanais śanais avaktavyam kriyatām sarvajñaḥ vā na vā bhagavān na vā iti asti eva pudgalaḥ yasmāt satyataḥ sthititaḥ na asti me ātmā iti dṛṣṭi sthānam uktam asti iti api dṛṣṭi sthānam uktam tasmāt ajñāpakam etat ubhayam api tu etat anta grāha dṛṣṭi śāśvata uccheda dṛṣṭi saṃgṛhītam iti ābhidhārmikāḥ tathā eva ca yuktam

original: ''asty ātmety ānanda śāśvatāya paraiti nāsty ātmety ānandocchedāya paraitī''ti | vātsyasūtre vacanāt |
analyzed: asti ātmā iti ānanda śāśvatāya paraiti na asti ātmā iti ānanda ucchedāya paraiti iti vātsyasūtre vacanāt

original: yadi tarhi pudgalo nāsti ka eṣa saṃsarati | na hi saṃsāra eṣa saṃsaratīti yuktam | uktaṃ ca bhagavatā ''avidyanivaraṇānāṃ sattvānāṃ saṃdhāvatāṃ saṃsaratām'' iti | [p.472] atha pudgalaḥ kathaṃ saṃsarati | skandhāntaratyāgopādānāt | uttarottara eṣa pakṣaḥ |
analyzed: yadi tarhi pudgalaḥ na asti kaḥ eṣa saṃsarati na hi saṃsāre eṣa saṃsarati iti yuktam uktam ca bhagavatā avidya nivaraṇānām sattvānām saṃdhāvatām saṃsaratām iti atha pudgalaḥ katham saṃsarati skandha antara tyāga upādānāt uttarottaraḥ eṣa pakṣaḥ

original: yathā tu kṣaṇiko 'gniḥ saṃtatyā saṃsaratīty ucyate tathā sattvākhyaḥ skandhasamudāyas tṛṣṇopādānaṇ saṃsaratīty ucyate | yadi skandhamātram idaṃ kasmād āha bhagavān ''aham eva sa tena kālena tena samayena sunetro nāma śāstābhūvam'' iti | kasmān na vaktavyaṃ syāt | anyatvāt skandhānām | atha kiṃ pudgalaḥ | sa evāsau | śāśvato hi syāt |
analyzed: yathā tu kṣaṇikaḥ gniḥ saṃtatyā saṃsarati iti ucyate tathā sattva ākhyaḥ skandha samudāyaḥ saṃsarati iti ucyate yadi skandha mātram idam kasmāt āha bhagavān aham eva sa tena kālena tena samayena sunetraḥ nāma śāstā abhūvam iti kasmāt na vaktavyam syāt anyatvāt skandhānām atha kim pudgalaḥ saḥ eva asau śāśvataḥ hi syāt

original: tasmād aham eva sa ity ekasaṃtānatām darśayati | yathā sa evāgnir dahann āgata iti | yadi cātmā bhavet tathāgatā eva suvyaktaṃ paśyeyuḥ | paśyatāṃ cātmagrāho dṛḍhataraḥ syād ātmasnehaś ca | ''ātmani ca saty ātmīyaṃ bhavatī''ti sūtre vacanād ātmagrāho 'py eṣāṃ skandheṣv adhikaṃ pravarteta | saiṣā syāt satkāyadṛṣṭiḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt aham eva saḥ iti eka saṃtānatām darśayati yathā saḥ eva agniḥ dahan āgataḥ iti yadi ca ātmā bhavet tathāgatāḥ eva su vyaktam paśyeyuḥ paśyatām ca ātma grāhaḥ dṛḍhataraḥ syāt ātma snehaḥ ca ātmani ca sati ātmīyam bhavati iti sūtre vacanāt ātma grāhaḥ u pi eṣām skandheṣu adhikam pravarteta sā eṣā syāt satkāyadṛṣṭiḥ

original: ātmīyadṛṣṭau ca satyām ātmīyasnehaḥ | evam eṣāṃ dṛḍhatarātmātmīyasnehaparsāditabandhanānāṃ mokṣo dūrataribhavet | atha mataṃ naivātmani pravartate sneha iti | tat ka idānīm eṣa yogo yad anātmany ātmāadhimokṣāt sneha utpadyate ātmany eva tu notpadyate |
analyzed: ātmīya dṛṣṭau ca satyām ātmīya snehaḥ evam eṣām dṛḍhatara ātma ātmīya sneha parsādita bandhanānām mokṣaḥ dūratari bhavet atha matam na eva ātmani pravartate snehaḥ iti tat kaḥ idānīm eṣa yogaḥ yat anātmani ātma adhimokṣāt snehaḥ utpadyate ātmani eva tu na utpadyate

original: tasmāt dṛṣṭyarvudam etasmin śāsane utpannaṃ ya eṣa ekeṣāṃ pudgalagrāha ekeṣāṃ sarvanāstitāgrāhaḥ | ye 'pi ca dravyāntaram evātmānaṃ manyante tīrthakarās teṣām eva mokṣābhāvadoṣo niṣkampaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt dṛṣṭi arvudam etasmin śāsane utpannam yaḥ eṣaḥ ekeṣām pudgala grāhaḥ ekeṣām sarva nāstitā grāhaḥ ye ca dravya antaram eva ātmānam manyante tīrthakarāḥ teṣām eva mokṣa abhāva doṣaḥ niṣkampaḥ

original: yadi tarhi sarvathāpi nāsty ātmā kathaṃ kṣaṇikeṣu citteṣu cirānubhūtasyārthasya smaraṇaṃ bhavati pratyabhijñānaṃ vā | smṛtiviṣayasaṃjñānvayāc cittaviśeṣāt | kīdṛśāt cittaviśeṣāt yato 'nantaraṃ smṛtir bhavati | tadābhogasadṛśasambandhisaṃjñādimato 'nupahata prabhāvād āśrayaviśeṣaśokavyākṣepādibhiḥ |
analyzed: yadi tarhi sarvathā api na asti ātmā katham kṣaṇikeṣu citteṣu cira anubhūtasya arthasya smaraṇam bhavati pratyabhijñānam vā smṛti viṣaya saṃjñā anvayāt citta viśeṣāt kīdṛśāt citta viśeṣāt yatas nantaram smṛtiḥ bhavati tad ābhoga sadṛśa sambandhi saṃjñā ādimataḥ prabhāvāt āśraya viśeṣa śoka vyākṣepa ādibhiḥ

original: tādṛśo 'pi hy atad anvayaś cittaviśeṣo na samarthaḥ tāṃ smṛtiṃ bhāvayituṃ tadanvayo 'pi cānyādrśo na samarthas tāṃ smṛtiṃ bhāvayitum | ubyayathā tu samartha ity evaṃ smṛtir bhavaty anyasyāṃ sāmarthyādarśanāt | katham idānīm anyena cetasā dṛṣṭam anyat smarati | evaṃ hi devadattacetasā dṛṣṭaṃ yajñadattacetaḥ smaret | nāsambandhāt |
analyzed: tādṛśaḥ u pi hi a tat anvayaḥ citta viśeṣaḥ na samarthaḥ tām smṛtim bhāvayitum tad anvayaḥ u pi ca anya ādrśaḥ na samarthaḥ tām smṛtim bhāvayitum ubyayathā tu samarthaḥ iti evam smṛtiḥ bhavati anyasyām sāmarthya adarśanāt katham idānīm anyena cetasā dṛṣṭam anyat smarati evam hi devadatta cetasā dṛṣṭam yajñadatta cetaḥ smaret na asambandhāt

original: na hi tayoḥ saṃbandho 'sti akāryakāraṇabhāvād yathaikasaṃtānikayoḥ | na ca brūmo 'nyena cetasā dṛṣṭam anyat smaratīti | api tu darśanacittāt smṛticittam anyad utpadyate | saṃtatipariṇatyā yathoktam iti ka evaṃ sati doṣaḥ | smaraṇād eva ca pratyabhijñānaṃ bhavati | asaty ātmani ka eṣa smarati | smaratīti ko 'rthaḥ | smṛtyā viṣayaṃ gṛhṇāti |
analyzed: na hi tayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ u sti akārya kāraṇa bhāvāt yathā eka saṃtānikayoḥ na ca brūmaḥ nyena cetasā dṛṣṭam anyat smarati iti api tu darśana cittāt smṛti cittam anyat utpadyate saṃtati pariṇatyā yathā uktam iti kaḥ evam sati doṣaḥ smaraṇāt eva ca pratyabhijñānam bhavati asati ātmani kaḥ eṣa smarati smarati iti kaḥ rthaḥ smṛtyā viṣayam gṛhṇāti

original: kiṃ tad grahaṇam anyat smaraṇāt | smṛtiṃ tarhi kaḥ karoti | uktaḥ sa yas tāṃ [p.473] karoti smṛtihetucittaviśeṣaḥ | yat tarhi caitraḥ smaratīty ucyate | tato hi caitrākhyāt saṃtānāt tāṃ bhavantīṃ dṛṣṭvocyate caitraḥ smaratīti | asaty ātmani kasyeyaṃ smṛtiḥ | kimarthaiṣā ṣaṣṭhī" | svāmyarthā | yathā kasya kaḥ svāmī | yathā goś caitraḥ |
analyzed: kim tat grahaṇam anyat smaraṇāt smṛtim tarhi kaḥ karoti uktaḥ sa yaḥ tām karoti smṛti hetu citta viśeṣaḥ yat tarhi caitraḥ smarati iti ucyate tatas hi caitra ākhyāt saṃtānāt tām bhavantīm dṛṣṭvā ucyate caitraḥ smarati iti asati ātmani kasya iyam smṛtiḥ kimarthā eṣā ṣaṣṭhī svāmi arthā yathā kasya kaḥ svāmī yathā goḥ caitraḥ

original: katham asau tasyāḥ svāmī | tadadhīno hi tasyā vāhadohādiṣu viniyogaḥ | kva ca punaḥ smṛtir viniyoktavyā ya evaṃ tasyāḥ svāmī mṛgyate | smartavye 'rthe | kim arthaṃ viniyoktavyā | smaraṇārtham | aho sūktāni sukhaidhitānām | saiva hi nāma tadarthaṃ viniyoktavyeti | kathaṃ ca viniyoktavyā | utpādanata āhosvit saṃpreṣaṇataḥ |
analyzed: katham asau tasyāḥ svāmī tad adhīnaḥ hi tasyāḥ vāha doha ādiṣu viniyogaḥ kva ca punar smṛtiḥ viniyoktavyā yaḥ evam tasyāḥ svāmī mṛgyate smartavye rthe kim artham viniyoktavyā smaraṇa artham aho sūktāni sukha edhitānām sā eva hi nāma tad artham viniyoktavyā iti katham ca viniyoktavyā utpādanataḥ āhosvit saṃpreṣaṇataḥ

original: smṛtigatyayogād utpādanataḥ | hetur eva tarhi svāmī prāpnoti phalam eva ca svam | yasmād dhetor ādhipatyaṃ phale phalena ca tadvān hetur iti | yo hy eva hetuḥ smṛtes tasyaivāsau |
